---
# =============================================================================
# ntfy User Provisioning Playbook
# =============================================================================
# This playbook sets up ntfy users and access control.
# Generated by OpenTofu - do not edit manually.
# =============================================================================

- name: Provision ntfy users and ACL
  hosts: monitoring
  gather_facts: false
  vars:
    ntfy_container: ntfy
    users:
      - name: "${ntfy_admin_user}"
        password: "${ntfy_admin_password}"
        role: admin
      - name: darshan
        password: "${ntfy_darshan_password}"
        role: user
      - name: alertmanager
        password: "${ntfy_alertmanager_password}"
        role: user
      - name: pbs-backup
        password: "${ntfy_pbs_backup_password}"
        role: user
      - name: n8n
        password: "${ntfy_n8n_password}"
        role: user
    access_rules:
      - user: darshan
        topic: "*"
        permission: ro  # Subscribe only - no publishing needed
      - user: alertmanager
        topic: "homelab-alerts"
        permission: wo
      - user: pbs-backup
        topic: "backup-alerts"
        permission: wo
      - user: n8n
        topic: "docker-updates"
        permission: rw  # n8n workflows may need to publish to various topics
      - user: everyone
        topic: "*"
        permission: deny

  tasks:
    - name: Wait for ntfy container to be running
      ansible.builtin.command:
        cmd: docker inspect -f '{{ "{{" }}.State.Running{{ "}}" }}' {{ ntfy_container }}
      register: container_check
      until: container_check.stdout == "true"
      retries: 30
      delay: 2
      changed_when: false

    - name: Create ntfy users
      ansible.builtin.shell: |
        echo "{{ item.password }}" | docker exec -i {{ ntfy_container }} ntfy user add \
          {% if item.role == 'admin' %}--role=admin{% endif %} \
          "{{ item.name }}"
      loop: "{{ users }}"
      loop_control:
        label: "{{ item.name }}"
      register: user_result
      failed_when: false
      changed_when: "'user' in user_result.stdout or user_result.rc == 0"

    - name: Report user creation results
      ansible.builtin.debug:
        msg: "User '{{ item.item.name }}': {{ 'created' if item.rc == 0 else 'already exists or failed' }}"
      loop: "{{ user_result.results }}"
      loop_control:
        label: "{{ item.item.name }}"

    - name: Set access control rules
      ansible.builtin.command:
        cmd: >
          docker exec {{ ntfy_container }} ntfy access
          "{{ item.user }}" "{{ item.topic }}" "{{ item.permission }}"
      loop: "{{ access_rules }}"
      loop_control:
        label: "{{ item.user }} -> {{ item.topic }}: {{ item.permission }}"
      register: acl_result
      failed_when: false
      changed_when: acl_result.rc == 0

    - name: Display current users
      ansible.builtin.command:
        cmd: docker exec {{ ntfy_container }} ntfy user list
      register: users_list
      changed_when: false

    - name: Display current ACL
      ansible.builtin.command:
        cmd: docker exec {{ ntfy_container }} ntfy access
      register: acl_list
      changed_when: false

    - name: Show final configuration
      ansible.builtin.debug:
        msg:
          - "=== ntfy Users ==="
          - "{{ users_list.stdout_lines }}"
          - "=== ntfy ACL ==="
          - "{{ acl_list.stdout_lines }}"

# =============================================================================
# ntfy User Provisioning Playbook
# =============================================================================
# This playbook sets up ntfy users and access control.
# Generated by OpenTofu - do not edit manually.
# =============================================================================

- name: Provision ntfy users and ACL
  hosts: monitoring
  gather_facts: false
  vars:
    ntfy_container: ntfy
    users:
      - name: "${ntfy_admin_user}"
        password: "${ntfy_admin_password}"
        role: admin
      - name: darshan
        password: "${ntfy_darshan_password}"
        role: user
      - name: alertmanager
        password: "${ntfy_alertmanager_password}"
        role: user
      - name: pbs-backup
        password: "${ntfy_pbs_backup_password}"
        role: user
      - name: n8n
        password: "${ntfy_n8n_password}"
        role: user
    access_rules:
      - user: darshan
        topic: "*"
        permission: ro  # Subscribe only - no publishing needed
      - user: alertmanager
        topic: "homelab-alerts"
        permission: wo
      - user: pbs-backup
        topic: "backup-alerts"
        permission: wo
      - user: n8n
        topic: "docker-updates"
        permission: rw  # n8n workflows may need to publish to various topics
      - user: everyone
        topic: "*"
        permission: deny

  tasks:
    - name: Wait for ntfy container to be running
      ansible.builtin.command:
        cmd: docker inspect -f '{{ "{{" }}.State.Running{{ "}}" }}' {{ ntfy_container }}
      register: container_check
      until: container_check.stdout == "true"
      retries: 30
      delay: 2
      changed_when: false

    # Restart ntfy to ensure it picks up latest server.yml config (including auth settings)
    - name: Restart ntfy container to load latest config
      ansible.builtin.command:
        cmd: docker restart {{ ntfy_container }}
      changed_when: true

    - name: Wait for ntfy container to be healthy after restart
      ansible.builtin.command:
        cmd: docker inspect -f '{{ "{{" }}.State.Running{{ "}}" }}' {{ ntfy_container }}
      register: container_healthy
      until: container_healthy.stdout == "true"
      retries: 30
      delay: 2
      changed_when: false

    - name: Create ntfy users
      ansible.builtin.shell: |
        echo "{{ item.password }}" | docker exec -i {{ ntfy_container }} ntfy user add \
          {% if item.role == 'admin' %}--role=admin{% endif %} \
          "{{ item.name }}"
      loop: "{{ users }}"
      loop_control:
        label: "{{ item.name }}"
      register: user_result
      failed_when: false
      changed_when: "'user' in user_result.stdout or user_result.rc == 0"

    - name: Report user creation results
      ansible.builtin.debug:
        msg: "User '{{ item.item.name }}': {{ 'created' if item.rc == 0 else 'already exists or failed' }}"
      loop: "{{ user_result.results }}"
      loop_control:
        label: "{{ item.item.name }}"

    - name: Set access control rules
      ansible.builtin.command:
        cmd: >
          docker exec {{ ntfy_container }} ntfy access
          "{{ item.user }}" "{{ item.topic }}" "{{ item.permission }}"
      loop: "{{ access_rules }}"
      loop_control:
        label: "{{ item.user }} -> {{ item.topic }}: {{ item.permission }}"
      register: acl_result
      failed_when: false
      changed_when: acl_result.rc == 0

    - name: Display current users
      ansible.builtin.command:
        cmd: docker exec {{ ntfy_container }} ntfy user list
      register: users_list
      changed_when: false

    - name: Display current ACL
      ansible.builtin.command:
        cmd: docker exec {{ ntfy_container }} ntfy access
      register: acl_list
      changed_when: false

# =============================================================================
# Monitoring LXC - Loki + Alloy + Prometheus + Grafana + Uptime Kuma + ntfy
# =============================================================================
# Container ID: 500
#
# Uses the docker-lxc module - the gold standard pattern for Docker apps.
# Observability stack for logs, metrics, dashboards, and alerting.
# =============================================================================

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Variables
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

variable "container_id" {
  type    = number
  default = 500
}

variable "cores" {
  type    = number
  default = 4
}

variable "memory" {
  type    = number
  default = 4096
}

variable "rootfs_size" {
  type    = number
  default = 32
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Monitoring Container
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "monitoring" {
  source = "../../modules/docker-lxc"

  name         = "monitoring"
  container_id = var.container_id
  proxmox_node = var.proxmox_node

  # Network (container network only)
  container_ip = "${local.ip_registry.monitoring.monitoring}${local.network.container_netmask}"

  # Resources
  cores  = var.cores
  memory = var.memory
  swap   = 1024

  rootfs_storage = "tank"
  rootfs_size    = var.rootfs_size

  # Unprivileged container (security hardened)
  unprivileged = true

  # Deployment
  deploy_dir  = "${path.module}/deploy"
  target_path = "/config"

  # SSH
  ssh_public_key       = local.ssh_public_key
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path
  proxmox_ssh_host     = local.proxmox_ssh_host

  # Template with Docker pre-installed
  template = var.lxc_template_docker

  # Proxmox Notes
  service_name        = "Monitoring"
  service_description = "Observability stack with Loki, Alloy, Prometheus, Grafana, and alerting"

  service_urls = {
    grafana           = "https://grafana.${var.domain_internal}"
    prometheus        = "https://prometheus.${var.domain_internal}"
    alertmanager      = "https://alertmanager.${var.domain_internal}"
    uptime_kuma       = "https://status.${var.domain_internal}"
    ntfy              = "https://ntfy.${var.domain_internal}"
    direct_loki       = "http://${local.lan_ips.monitoring}:3100"
    direct_alloy_grpc = "http://${local.lan_ips.monitoring}:4317"
    direct_alloy_http = "http://${local.lan_ips.monitoring}:4318"
  }

  services = [
    { name = "Loki", port = 3100, info = "Log aggregation" },
    { name = "Alloy (gRPC)", port = 4317, info = "OTLP gRPC receiver" },
    { name = "Alloy (HTTP)", port = 4318, info = "OTLP HTTP receiver" },
    { name = "Alloy UI", port = 12345, info = "Alloy debug UI" },
    { name = "Prometheus", port = 9090, info = "Metrics storage and alerting" },
    { name = "Grafana", port = 3000, info = "Dashboards and visualization" },
    { name = "Alertmanager", port = 9093, info = "Alert routing" },
    { name = "Uptime Kuma", port = 3001, info = "HTTP monitoring and status page" },
    { name = "ntfy", port = 8080, info = "Push notifications" }
  ]

  custom_notes = <<-EOT
## Alloy OTLP Endpoints (for Proxmox/Immich)

**OTLP gRPC:** ${local.lan_ips.monitoring}:4317
**OTLP HTTP:** ${local.lan_ips.monitoring}:4318

Configure Proxmox metrics server:
```bash
pvesh create /cluster/metrics/server \
  --id homelab-alloy \
  --type opentelemetry \
  --server ${local.lan_ips.monitoring} \
  --port 4317 \
  --proto grpc
```

## Loki Endpoint (for Alloy sidecars)

**Loki URL:** http://${local.lan_ips.monitoring}:3100

## Grafana

Default login: admin / (password in 1Password)

## ntfy Topics

- `homelab-alerts` - Prometheus alerts
- `homelab-status` - Uptime Kuma notifications

Subscribe via mobile app or web UI.

## Quick Commands

```bash
# View Alloy logs
docker logs -f alloy

# View Loki logs
docker logs -f loki

# Query logs via Loki API
curl -s "http://localhost:3100/loki/api/v1/labels" | jq

# Reload Prometheus config
curl -X POST http://localhost:9090/-/reload

# Test ntfy notification
curl -d "Test notification" http://localhost:8080/homelab-alerts
```

## Managed by OpenTofu

Run `task tofu:apply APP=monitoring` to update.
EOT

  tags = ["monitoring", "loki", "alloy", "prometheus", "grafana"]

  # Pass env content to module - synced BEFORE docker compose runs
  env_content = templatefile("${path.module}/deploy/.env.tpl", {
    grafana_admin_password = local.op.grafana_admin_password
    uptime_kuma_username   = local.op.uptime_kuma_username
    uptime_kuma_password   = local.op.uptime_kuma_password
    discord_webhook_url    = local.op.discord_webhook_url
    # Grafana OAuth/OIDC via Authentik
    grafana_oauth_client_id     = authentik_provider_oauth2.grafana.client_id
    grafana_oauth_client_secret = random_password.grafana_oidc_secret.result
    grafana_oauth_auth_url      = "https://auth.${var.domain_public}/application/o/authorize/"
    grafana_oauth_token_url     = "https://auth.${var.domain_public}/application/o/token/"
    grafana_oauth_api_url       = "https://auth.${var.domain_public}/application/o/userinfo/"
    grafana_oauth_signout_url   = "https://auth.${var.domain_public}/application/o/grafana/end-session/"
    # ntfy credentials for Alertmanager
    ntfy_alertmanager_password = local.op.ntfy_alertmanager_password
  })
}

# Note: .env file is now handled by the docker-lxc module via env_content
# This ensures the .env is synced BEFORE docker compose runs

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# ntfy User Provisioning (Ansible)
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Provisions ntfy users and ACL after container deployment

resource "ansible_navigator_run" "ntfy_provision" {
  triggers = {
    container_id = module.monitoring.container_id
    container_ip = module.monitoring.ip_address
    # Re-run if credentials change
    credentials_hash = sha256(join(",", [
      local.op.ntfy_admin_password,
      local.op.ntfy_darshan_password,
      local.op.ntfy_alertmanager_password,
      local.op.ntfy_pbs_backup_password,
      local.op.ntfy_n8n_password,
    ]))
  }

  execution_environment = {
    enabled = false
  }

  ansible_options = {
    private_keys = [{
      name = "homelab"
      data = file(var.ssh_private_key_path)
    }]
  }

  playbook = templatefile("${path.module}/deploy/ntfy/provision-users.yml.tpl", {
    ntfy_admin_user            = local.op.ntfy_admin_user
    ntfy_admin_password        = local.op.ntfy_admin_password
    ntfy_darshan_password      = local.op.ntfy_darshan_password
    ntfy_alertmanager_password = local.op.ntfy_alertmanager_password
    ntfy_pbs_backup_password   = local.op.ntfy_pbs_backup_password
    ntfy_n8n_password          = local.op.ntfy_n8n_password
  })

  inventory = yamlencode({
    monitoring = {
      hosts = {
        "monitoring" = {
          ansible_host = module.monitoring.ip_address
          ansible_user = "root"
        }
      }
    }
  })

  depends_on = [module.monitoring]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Traefik Routes - Self-Service Route Registration
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "grafana_route" {
  source = "../../modules/traefik-route"

  app_name    = "grafana"
  backend_url = "http://${module.monitoring.ip_address}:3000"

  # Internal route (HTTPS via Let's Encrypt)
  internal_domain = "grafana.${var.domain_internal}"

  # Traefik config
  traefik_host         = local.traefik_ip
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  # Middlewares
  internal_middlewares = ["security-headers"]

  depends_on = [module.monitoring]
}

module "prometheus_route" {
  source = "../../modules/traefik-route"

  app_name    = "prometheus"
  backend_url = "http://${module.monitoring.ip_address}:9090"

  internal_domain = "prometheus.${var.domain_internal}"

  traefik_host         = local.traefik_ip
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  # Middlewares - authentik provides SSO authentication
  internal_middlewares = ["security-headers", "authentik"]

  depends_on = [module.monitoring]
}

module "alertmanager_route" {
  source = "../../modules/traefik-route"

  app_name    = "alertmanager"
  backend_url = "http://${module.monitoring.ip_address}:9093"

  internal_domain = "alertmanager.${var.domain_internal}"

  traefik_host         = local.traefik_ip
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  # Middlewares - authentik provides SSO authentication
  internal_middlewares = ["security-headers", "authentik"]

  depends_on = [module.monitoring]
}

module "uptime_kuma_route" {
  source = "../../modules/traefik-route"

  app_name    = "status"
  backend_url = "http://${module.monitoring.ip_address}:3001"

  internal_domain = "status.${var.domain_internal}"

  traefik_host         = local.traefik_ip
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  internal_middlewares = ["security-headers", "authentik"]

  depends_on = [module.monitoring]
}

module "ntfy_route" {
  source = "../../modules/traefik-route"

  app_name    = "ntfy"
  backend_url = "http://${module.monitoring.ip_address}:8080"

  internal_domain = "ntfy.${var.domain_internal}"

  traefik_host         = local.traefik_ip
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  # ntfy has its own ACL-based authentication - no Authentik middleware
  internal_middlewares = ["security-headers"]

  depends_on = [module.monitoring]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Backup Configuration - PBS Client
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "monitoring_sidecars" {
  source = "../../modules/lxc-sidecars"

  container_id   = module.monitoring.container_id
  container_ip   = module.monitoring.ip_address
  container_name = "monitoring"

  proxmox_ssh_host             = local.proxmox_ssh_host
  proxmox_ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  backup = {
    enabled   = true
    schedule  = "Sun 03:00"  # Weekly backup
    retention = "4"          # Keep 4 weekly backups
    namespace = "lxc-500"

    pre_backup_commands = []  # No database - config only

    include_paths = ["/config"]
    exclude_paths = ["/var/lib/docker/overlay2"]

    ntfy_priority = "default"
    ntfy_tags     = "backup,monitoring"
    ntfy_user     = "pbs-backup"
    ntfy_password = local.op.ntfy_pbs_backup_password
  }

  # Container monitoring agents
  pulse_agent = {
    enabled     = true
    pulse_token = local.agent_tokens["monitoring"].pulse_token
  }

  arcane_agent = {
    enabled         = true
    bootstrap_token = local.agent_tokens["monitoring"].arcane_bootstrap_token
  }

  depends_on = [module.monitoring]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Outputs
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

output "container_id" {
  value = module.monitoring.container_id
}

output "ip_address" {
  value = module.monitoring.ip_address
}

output "ssh_command" {
  value = module.monitoring.ssh_command
}

output "alloy_endpoints" {
  value = {
    grpc = "http://${module.monitoring.ip_address}:4317"
    http = "http://${module.monitoring.ip_address}:4318"
  }
}

output "loki_url" {
  value = "http://${module.monitoring.ip_address}:3100"
}

output "urls" {
  value = {
    grafana      = module.grafana_route.internal_url
    prometheus   = module.prometheus_route.internal_url
    alertmanager = module.alertmanager_route.internal_url
    uptime_kuma  = module.uptime_kuma_route.internal_url
    ntfy         = module.ntfy_route.internal_url
  }
}

output "traefik_config_paths" {
  description = "Paths to Traefik configs on Traefik LXC"
  value = {
    grafana      = module.grafana_route.remote_config_path
    prometheus   = module.prometheus_route.remote_config_path
    alertmanager = module.alertmanager_route.remote_config_path
    uptime_kuma  = module.uptime_kuma_route.remote_config_path
    ntfy         = module.ntfy_route.remote_config_path
  }
}

## 2. LXC Sidecars Module (Core Backup Framework)

3. **Arcane Agent** - Remote container management
4. **Alloy Agent** - Grafana telemetry (Loki/Prometheus)

```
OpenTofu lxc-sidecars module
  ↓
ansible_navigator_run resource (Ansible execution on container)
  ↓
Configure backup via Ansible playbook
  ├─ Install proxmox-backup-client binary

  ├─ Parse backup output for size

  ├─ Clean up temporary dump files
```

**Variables:** `/tofu/modules/lxc-sidecars/variables.tf`
- `backup` object with enabled flag, schedule, retention, namespace
- Pre-backup commands (database dumps)
- Include/exclude paths
- PBS server settings (IP, datastore, user, password command)
- ntfy alert configuration

**Main Module:** `/tofu/modules/lxc-sidecars/main.tf`

```bash
ssh root@10.100.5.102 "systemctl start pbs-backup-502.service"

```


**Manual restore test:**
```bash

ssh root@10.100.5.102 "proxmox-backup-client restore --repository backup@pbs@10.100.1.102:homelab --ns lxc-502 lxc-502/<snapshot> /tmp/restore-test"
```

---

## 9. Backup Timeline (Daily)

```
05:00 AM - PBS S3 sync (homelab → backblaze-s3 on PBS)
07:00 AM - Immich daily backup (PostgreSQL dump + backup)
07:01 AM - OpenWebUI daily backup
Daily    - n8n daily backup
Daily    - Obsidian Sync daily backup
Daily    - Documents daily backup (PostgreSQL dump + backup)
08:00 AM - Weekly backups (Sundays only) for all other apps
03:00 AM - Photos cloud sync to B2 (Wed/Sun via rclone)
03:30 AM - Documents cloud sync to B2 (Wed/Sun via rclone)
```

---

## 10. Storage & Retention Overview

### PBS Datastores:

| Datastore | Type | Location | Purpose | Retention |
|-----------|------|----------|---------|-----------|
| `homelab` | Local | `/mnt/datastore/homelab` | Primary backups | Daily (7), Weekly (4 weeks) |
| `backblaze-s3` | S3 | rambtech-homelab bucket | Off-site cloud copy | Unlimited (S3 versioning) |

### Bucket Structure (Backblaze B2):

```
rambtech-homelab/
├── ct/                    # PBS S3 sync (container backups)
│   ├── 101/               # Network Services snapshots
│   ├── 200/               # Traefik snapshots
│   ├── 201/               # Dashboards snapshots
│   ├── 203/               # Authentik snapshots
│   ├── 304/               # Immich snapshots
│   ├── 401/               # Jellyfin snapshots
│   ├── 402/               # Media Management snapshots
│   ├── 500/               # Monitoring snapshots
│   ├── 501/               # OpenWebUI snapshots
│   ├── 502/               # n8n snapshots
│   ├── 503/               # Obsidian Sync snapshots
│   ├── 504/               # Documents snapshots
│   └── 104/               # Container Mgmt snapshots
├── photos-encrypted/      # Immich photos (rclone crypt)
└── documents/             # Paperless documents (rclone crypt)
```

---

## 11. Database-Specific Handling

### Immich (PostgreSQL with pgvector extension):
- **Container:** `immich_postgres`
- **Pre-backup dump:** `docker exec immich_postgres pg_dump -U postgres -d immich --clean --if-exists | gzip > /config/immich-db-backup.sql.gz`
- **Timeout:** 600 seconds
- **Included in backup:** Both dump and volume data

### Paperless-ngx (PostgreSQL 16):
- **Container:** `paperless-db`
- **Dump:** Generated and stored in `/config/paperless-db-backup.sql.gz`
- **Backup:** Includes both dump and docker volumes

### Obsidian Sync (CouchDB 3.5):
- **Data volume:** `couchdb-data`
- **No pre-backup dump:** CouchDB handles consistency natively
- **Backup:** Direct volume backup via PBS

### OpenWebUI (SQLite):
- **Database file:** `/config/openwebui/webui.db`
- **No dump needed:** File-level backup is sufficient
- **Contains:** Chat history, users, settings

### n8n (SQLite):
- **Database file:** `/config/n8n/database.sqlite`
- **Pre-backup copy:** `cp database.sqlite database.sqlite.backup`
- **Timeout:** 60 seconds
- **Contains:** Workflows, credentials, execution history

---

## Key Design Patterns

1. **Zero-Downtime Backups:** PBS client runs without stopping containers
2. **Deduplication:** PBS efficiently handles daily/weekly overlapping backups
3. **Incremental Transfers:** Only changes synced to S3
4. **Namespace Isolation:** Each container gets separate PBS namespace (lxc-{id})
5. **Flexible Scheduling:** Per-app schedules optimized for criticality
6. **Integrated Notifications:** All failures alerting via ntfy + structured templates
7. **Retention Policies:** Daily (7 days) vs Weekly (4 weeks) based on importance
8. **Cloud Fallback:** All critical data replicated to Backblaze B2

---

This architecture provides a robust, automated, and observable backup system with multiple redundancy layers for the homelab infrastructure.

```
Daily    - Obsidian Sync daily backup
Daily    - Documents daily backup (PostgreSQL dump + backup)
08:00 AM - Weekly backups (Sundays only) for all other apps
03:00 AM - Photos cloud sync to B2 (Wed/Sun via rclone)
03:30 AM - Documents cloud sync to B2 (Wed/Sun via rclone)
```

## 10. Storage & Retention Overview

### PBS Datastores:

| Datastore | Type | Location | Purpose | Retention |
|-----------|------|----------|---------|-----------|
| `homelab` | Local | `/mnt/datastore/homelab` | Primary backups | Daily (7), Weekly (4 weeks) |
| `backblaze-s3` | S3 | rambtech-homelab bucket | Off-site cloud copy | Unlimited (S3 versioning) |

### Bucket Structure (Backblaze B2):

```
rambtech-homelab/
├── ct/                    # PBS S3 sync (container backups)
│   ├── 101/               # Network Services snapshots
│   ├── 200/               # Traefik snapshots
│   ├── 201/               # Dashboards snapshots
│   ├── 203/               # Authentik snapshots
│   ├── 304/               # Immich snapshots
│   ├── 401/               # Jellyfin snapshots
│   ├── 402/               # Media Management snapshots
│   ├── 500/               # Monitoring snapshots
│   ├── 501/               # OpenWebUI snapshots
│   ├── 502/               # n8n snapshots
│   ├── 503/               # Obsidian Sync snapshots
│   ├── 504/               # Documents snapshots
│   └── 104/               # Container Mgmt snapshots
├── photos-encrypted/      # Immich photos (rclone crypt)
└── documents/             # Paperless documents (rclone crypt)
```

---

## 11. Database-Specific Handling

### Immich (PostgreSQL with pgvector extension):
- **Container:** `immich_postgres`
- **Pre-backup dump:** `docker exec immich_postgres pg_dump -U postgres -d immich --clean --if-exists | gzip > /config/immich-db-backup.sql.gz`
- **Timeout:** 600 seconds
- **Included in backup:** Both dump and volume data

### Paperless-ngx (PostgreSQL 16):
- **Container:** `paperless-db`
- **Dump:** Generated and stored in `/config/paperless-db-backup.sql.gz`
- **Backup:** Includes both dump and docker volumes

### Obsidian Sync (CouchDB 3.5):
- **Data volume:** `couchdb-data`
- **No pre-backup dump:** CouchDB handles consistency natively
- **Backup:** Direct volume backup via PBS

### OpenWebUI (SQLite):
- **Database file:** `/config/openwebui/webui.db`
- **No dump needed:** File-level backup is sufficient
- **Contains:** Chat history, users, settings

### n8n (SQLite):
- **Database file:** `/config/n8n/database.sqlite`
- **Pre-backup copy:** `cp database.sqlite database.sqlite.backup`
- **Timeout:** 60 seconds
- **Contains:** Workflows, credentials, execution history

---

## Key Design Patterns

1. **Zero-Downtime Backups:** PBS client runs without stopping containers
2. **Deduplication:** PBS efficiently handles daily/weekly overlapping backups
3. **Incremental Transfers:** Only changes synced to S3
4. **Namespace Isolation:** Each container gets separate PBS namespace (lxc-{id})
5. **Flexible Scheduling:** Per-app schedules optimized for criticality
6. **Integrated Notifications:** All failures alerting via ntfy + structured templates
7. **Retention Policies:** Daily (7 days) vs Weekly (4 weeks) based on importance
8. **Cloud Fallback:** All critical data replicated to Backblaze B2

---

This architecture provides a robust, automated, and observable backup system with multiple redundancy layers for the homelab infrastructure.

---
# =============================================================================
# Configure PBS Backup Client in LXC Container
# =============================================================================
# This playbook is generated by the lxc-sidecars OpenTofu module.
# It configures proxmox-backup-client for zero-downtime incremental backups.
# =============================================================================

- name: Configure PBS backup for ${container_name}
  hosts: ${container_name}
  gather_facts: true

  vars:
    container_id: ${container_id}
    namespace: ${namespace}
    schedule: ${schedule}
    retention: ${retention}
    pbs_server: ${pbs_server}
    pbs_datastore: ${pbs_datastore}
    pbs_user: ${pbs_user}
    pbs_password_cmd: ${pbs_password_cmd}
    pbs_repository: ${pbs_user}@${pbs_server}:${pbs_datastore}

    backup_script_dir: /usr/local/bin/pbs-backup
    backup_script_path: /usr/local/bin/pbs-backup/backup-${container_id}.sh
    log_dir: /var/log/pbs-backups
    log_file: /var/log/pbs-backups/${namespace}.log

    systemd_service_name: pbs-backup-${container_id}.service
    systemd_timer_name: pbs-backup-${container_id}.timer

    ntfy_url: ${ntfy_url}
    ntfy_priority: ${ntfy_priority}
    ntfy_tags: ${ntfy_tags}

  tasks:
    # =========================================================================
    # Install proxmox-backup-client
    # =========================================================================
    - name: Check if proxmox-backup-client is already installed
      ansible.builtin.command:
        cmd: which proxmox-backup-client
      register: pbs_client_check
      changed_when: false
      failed_when: false

    - name: Install proxmox-backup-client dependencies
      ansible.builtin.apt:
        name:
          - curl
          - ca-certificates
        state: present
        update_cache: true
      when: pbs_client_check.rc != 0

    - name: Download proxmox-backup-client binary
      ansible.builtin.get_url:
        url: https://cloud-pbs.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/proxmox-backup-client
        dest: /usr/local/bin/proxmox-backup-client
        mode: '0755'
        checksum: sha256:85b477e2f17b86947f332cfe71ccfc365e1c9821a7a748899b13fcffbcd0c8f9
      when: pbs_client_check.rc != 0

    - name: Verify proxmox-backup-client installation
      ansible.builtin.command:
        cmd: proxmox-backup-client version
      register: pbs_version_check
      changed_when: false

    - name: Display proxmox-backup-client version
      ansible.builtin.debug:
        msg: "{{ pbs_version_check.stdout }}"

    # =========================================================================
    # Configure PBS Password
    # =========================================================================
    - name: Create PBS encryption key directory
      ansible.builtin.file:
        path: /root/.config/proxmox-backup
        state: directory
        mode: '0700'

    - name: Get PBS certificate fingerprint
      ansible.builtin.shell:
        cmd: |
          ssh root@{{ pbs_server }} "proxmox-backup-manager cert info" | \
          grep "Fingerprint (sha256):" | \
          awk '{print $NF}'
      register: pbs_fingerprint
      changed_when: false
      delegate_to: localhost

    - name: Get PBS password from 1Password
      ansible.builtin.shell:
        cmd: ${pbs_password_cmd}
      register: pbs_password
      changed_when: false
      delegate_to: localhost
      no_log: true

    - name: Store PBS password and fingerprint in environment file
      ansible.builtin.copy:
        content: |
          PBS_REPOSITORY={{ pbs_repository }}
          PBS_NAMESPACE={{ namespace }}
          PBS_PASSWORD={{ pbs_password.stdout }}
          PBS_FINGERPRINT={{ pbs_fingerprint.stdout }}
        dest: /root/.pbs-backup-env
        mode: '0600'
      no_log: true

    # =========================================================================
    # Create PBS Namespace (if specified and doesn't exist)
    # =========================================================================
    - name: Create PBS namespace
      ansible.builtin.shell:
        cmd: |
          set -a
          source /root/.pbs-backup-env
          set +a
          proxmox-backup-client namespace create {{ namespace }} --repository {{ pbs_repository }}
        executable: /bin/bash
      register: namespace_create
      changed_when: "'created namespace' in namespace_create.stdout or namespace_create.rc == 0"
      failed_when: false
      no_log: true
      when: namespace != ""

    # =========================================================================
    # Create Backup Script
    # =========================================================================
    - name: Create backup script directory
      ansible.builtin.file:
        path: "{{ backup_script_dir }}"
        state: directory
        mode: '0755'

    - name: Create log directory
      ansible.builtin.file:
        path: "{{ log_dir }}"
        state: directory
        mode: '0755'

    - name: Deploy backup script
      ansible.builtin.copy:
        content: |
          ${indent(10, backup_script)}
        dest: "{{ backup_script_path }}"
        mode: '0755'

    # =========================================================================
    # Create Systemd Service & Timer
    # =========================================================================
    - name: Create systemd service
      ansible.builtin.copy:
        content: |
          [Unit]
          Description=PBS Backup for ${container_name} (${namespace})
          After=network-online.target
          Wants=network-online.target

          [Service]
          Type=oneshot
          EnvironmentFile=/root/.pbs-backup-env
          ExecStart={{ backup_script_path }}
          StandardOutput=append:{{ log_file }}
          StandardError=append:{{ log_file }}

          # Resource limits
          CPUQuota=50%
          MemoryMax=1G

          [Install]
          WantedBy=multi-user.target
        dest: /etc/systemd/system/{{ systemd_service_name }}
        mode: '0644'
      register: service_file

    - name: Determine systemd timer schedule
      ansible.builtin.set_fact:
        timer_oncalendar: |-
          {%- if schedule == "daily" -%}
          daily
          {%- elif schedule | regex_search('^[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}$') -%}
          *-*-* {{ schedule }}
          {%- else -%}
          {{ schedule }}
          {%- endif -%}

    - name: Create systemd timer
      ansible.builtin.copy:
        content: |
          [Unit]
          Description=Timer for PBS Backup of ${container_name}

          [Timer]
          OnCalendar={{ timer_oncalendar }}
          Persistent=true
          RandomizedDelaySec=5min

          [Install]
          WantedBy=timers.target
        dest: /etc/systemd/system/{{ systemd_timer_name }}
        mode: '0644'
      register: timer_file

    - name: Reload systemd daemon
      ansible.builtin.systemd:
        daemon_reload: true
      when: service_file is changed or timer_file is changed

    - name: Enable and start timer
      ansible.builtin.systemd:
        name: "{{ systemd_timer_name }}"
        enabled: true
        state: started

    # =========================================================================
    # Verify Configuration
    # =========================================================================
    - name: Check timer status
      ansible.builtin.command:
        cmd: systemctl status {{ systemd_timer_name }}
      register: timer_status
      changed_when: false
      failed_when: false

    - name: Display configuration summary
      ansible.builtin.debug:
        msg:
          - "=== PBS Backup Configured for ${container_name} ==="
          - ""
          - "Container ID: ${container_id}"
          - "Namespace: ${namespace}"
          - "Schedule: {{ timer_oncalendar }}"
          - "Repository: {{ pbs_repository }}"
          - "Log file: {{ log_file }}"
          - ""
          - "Manual trigger:"
          - "  systemctl start {{ systemd_service_name }}"
          - ""
          - "Check timer:"
          - "  systemctl list-timers {{ systemd_timer_name }}"
          - ""
          - "View logs:"
          - "  tail -f {{ log_file }}"

content.text:
Looking at the current configuration, **per-LXC namespaces have been the design from the beginning**. Each container gets its own PBS namespace like `lxc-502`, `lxc-304`, etc.

## Why Per-LXC Namespaces?

This design was chosen for several reasons:

1. **Isolation** - Each container's backups are completely isolated. If you need to restore immich, you only see immich snapshots, not a mixed list of all containers.

2. **Retention management** - The prune command only affects that container's namespace:
   ```bash
   proxmox-backup-client prune "host/lxc-304" --ns lxc-304 --keep-last 7
   ```
   No risk of accidentally pruning another container's backups.

3. **Permission granularity** - PBS supports per-namespace ACLs if you ever need different backup users or access controls.

4. **Cleaner PBS UI** - In the PBS web interface, each namespace shows as a separate "folder," making it easy to browse and manage.

5. **Independent restore** - You can restore a specific container without knowing anything about the others.

The alternative (single shared namespace) would put all backups in one bucket, making it harder to:
- See which snapshots belong to which container
- Manage retention independently
- Grant selective access to specific container backups

Was there a specific concern about the per-namespace approach, or were you just trying to understand the rationale?
i think I am missing something - how is prune "host/lxc-304" different from prune "host/lxc-304" --ns lxc-304

Good question. Let me clarify the PBS backup structure.

In PBS, the backup path has this format:
```
<datastore>/<namespace>/<backup-type>/<backup-id>/<timestamp>
```

Looking at the backup script in [pbs-backup.sh.tftpl](tofu/modules/lxc-sidecars/templates/pbs-backup.sh.tftpl):

```bash
# Line 181-209
local backup_id="lxc-${CONTAINER_ID}"
...
backup_cmd="${backup_cmd} --backup-id '${backup_id}'"
%{ if namespace != "" ~}
backup_cmd="${backup_cmd} --ns $PBS_NAMESPACE"
%{ endif ~}
```

So for immich (container 304), with `namespace = "lxc-304"`:
- **backup-id**: `lxc-304` (identifies this container's backup set)
- **namespace**: `lxc-304` (PBS namespace for isolation)

The prune command at line 250-255:
```bash
proxmox-backup-client prune "host/${backup_id}" \
    --repository "$PBS_REPOSITORY" \
    --ns "$PBS_NAMESPACE" \
    --keep-last "${RETENTION}"
```

**The difference:**
- `prune "host/lxc-304"` without `--ns` would look in the **root namespace**
- `prune "host/lxc-304" --ns lxc-304` looks in the **lxc-304 namespace**

Since all backups are created with `--ns lxc-304`, they exist *inside* that namespace. Without `--ns`, the prune command would find nothing (or error) because there's no `host/lxc-304` backup in the root namespace.

**In short:** The namespace is like a folder. The backup-id (`lxc-304`) happens to match the namespace name, but they serve different purposes:
- **namespace**: Where in PBS the backup is stored (like a directory)
- **backup-id**: Which backup group within that namespace

You could theoretically have `namespace = "media"` with `backup-id = "lxc-304"`, but using matching names keeps it simple.
right, but what i meant was how is that providing any additional protection? why would prune "host/lxc-304"be inferior prune "host/lxc-304" --ns lxc-304

You're right to question this. **There's no additional protection** from having matching names.

The namespace doesn't add protection in this case - it's just organizational. Here's what actually matters:

**Without namespaces (root namespace):**
```
datastore/host/lxc-304/2024-12-26T02:00:00Z
datastore/host/lxc-401/2024-12-26T02:00:00Z
datastore/host/lxc-502/2024-12-26T02:00:00Z
```
- `prune "host/lxc-304"` only prunes lxc-304's backups
- The backup-id (`lxc-304`) already isolates it from `lxc-401` and `lxc-502`

**With per-container namespaces:**
```
datastore/lxc-304/host/lxc-304/2024-12-26T02:00:00Z
datastore/lxc-401/host/lxc-401/2024-12-26T02:00:00Z
datastore/lxc-502/host/lxc-502/2024-12-26T02:00:00Z
```
- Same isolation, just nested one level deeper

**The only real benefit of namespaces** is if you wanted to:
1. **Group related containers** - e.g., `namespace = "media"` containing both `lxc-304` (immich) and `lxc-401` (jellyfin)
2. **Apply PBS ACLs** - give someone access to all backups in a namespace without listing each backup-id
3. **Visual organization** in PBS UI

With the current 1:1 mapping (`namespace = lxc-304`, `backup-id = lxc-304`), it's redundant. The backup-id alone would provide the same isolation.

It could be simplified to use no namespace (root) or a single shared namespace like `homelab`, and the backup-id would still keep everything separate.
yea i asked coz due to our current organization strategy, apps like pulse cant really track which lxcs have backups and which dont

Exactly. The current structure makes it hard for Pulse (or any central tool) to discover what's being backed up because:

1. **Namespaces are per-container** - Pulse would need to know all possible namespace names (`lxc-304`, `lxc-401`, etc.) to query them
2. **No central registry** - There's no single place listing "these containers have backups enabled"

**Better approach: Single shared namespace**

If all backups were in one namespace (e.g., `homelab` or even root):
```
datastore/homelab/host/lxc-304/...
datastore/homelab/host/lxc-401/...
datastore/homelab/host/lxc-502/...
```

Then Pulse could simply:
```bash
proxmox-backup-client list --ns homelab --repository ...
```

And get all backup-ids in one query.

**Want me to refactor to use a single namespace?**

The changes would be:
1. Update `lxc-sidecars` module to use a fixed namespace (e.g., `homelab`) instead of per-container
2. Remove the `namespace` variable requirement from app configs (or make it optional with a default)
3. Migrate existing backups (or let them age out under retention)

This would simplify the config from:
```hcl
backup = {
  namespace = "lxc-304"  # redundant
  ...
}
```

To just relying on the backup-id for isolation, which already works.
can we also migrate the current backups to move to the root namespace?
Yes, we can migrate the existing backups. Let me first check what's currently in PBS to understand the scope.

---
# =============================================================================
# Configure PBS Backup Client in LXC Container
# =============================================================================
# This playbook is generated by the lxc-sidecars OpenTofu module.
# It configures proxmox-backup-client for zero-downtime incremental backups.
# =============================================================================

- name: Configure PBS backup for ${container_name}
  hosts: ${container_name}
  gather_facts: true

  vars:
    container_id: ${container_id}
    namespace: ${namespace}
    schedule: ${schedule}
    retention: ${retention}
    pbs_server: ${pbs_server}
    pbs_datastore: ${pbs_datastore}
    pbs_user: ${pbs_user}
    pbs_password_cmd: ${pbs_password_cmd}
    pbs_repository: ${pbs_user}@${pbs_server}:${pbs_datastore}

    backup_script_dir: /usr/local/bin/pbs-backup
    backup_script_path: /usr/local/bin/pbs-backup/backup-${container_id}.sh
    log_dir: /var/log/pbs-backups
    log_file: /var/log/pbs-backups/${namespace}.log

    systemd_service_name: pbs-backup-${container_id}.service
    systemd_timer_name: pbs-backup-${container_id}.timer

    ntfy_url: ${ntfy_url}
    ntfy_priority: ${ntfy_priority}
    ntfy_tags: ${ntfy_tags}

  tasks:
    # =========================================================================
    # Install proxmox-backup-client
    # =========================================================================
    - name: Check if proxmox-backup-client is already installed
      ansible.builtin.command:
        cmd: which proxmox-backup-client
      register: pbs_client_check
      changed_when: false
      failed_when: false

    - name: Install proxmox-backup-client dependencies
      ansible.builtin.apt:
        name:
          - curl
          - ca-certificates
        state: present
        update_cache: true
      when: pbs_client_check.rc != 0

    - name: Download proxmox-backup-client binary
      ansible.builtin.get_url:
        url: https://cloud-pbs.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/proxmox-backup-client
        dest: /usr/local/bin/proxmox-backup-client
        mode: '0755'
        checksum: sha256:85b477e2f17b86947f332cfe71ccfc365e1c9821a7a748899b13fcffbcd0c8f9
      when: pbs_client_check.rc != 0

    - name: Verify proxmox-backup-client installation
      ansible.builtin.command:
        cmd: proxmox-backup-client version
      register: pbs_version_check
      changed_when: false

    - name: Display proxmox-backup-client version
      ansible.builtin.debug:
        msg: "{{ pbs_version_check.stdout }}"

    # =========================================================================
    # Configure PBS Password
    # =========================================================================
    - name: Create PBS encryption key directory
      ansible.builtin.file:
        path: /root/.config/proxmox-backup
        state: directory
        mode: '0700'

    - name: Get PBS certificate fingerprint
      ansible.builtin.shell:
        cmd: |
          ssh root@{{ pbs_server }} "proxmox-backup-manager cert info" | \
          grep "Fingerprint (sha256):" | \
          awk '{print $NF}'
      register: pbs_fingerprint
      changed_when: false
      delegate_to: localhost

    - name: Get PBS password from 1Password
      ansible.builtin.shell:
        cmd: ${pbs_password_cmd}
      register: pbs_password
      changed_when: false
      delegate_to: localhost
      no_log: true

    - name: Store PBS password and fingerprint in environment file
      ansible.builtin.copy:
        content: |
          PBS_REPOSITORY={{ pbs_repository }}
          PBS_NAMESPACE={{ namespace }}
          PBS_PASSWORD={{ pbs_password.stdout }}
          PBS_FINGERPRINT={{ pbs_fingerprint.stdout }}
        dest: /root/.pbs-backup-env
        mode: '0600'
      no_log: true

    # =========================================================================
    # Create PBS Namespace (if specified and doesn't exist)
    # =========================================================================
    - name: Create PBS namespace
      ansible.builtin.shell:
        cmd: |
          set -a
          source /root/.pbs-backup-env
          set +a
          proxmox-backup-client namespace create {{ namespace }} --repository {{ pbs_repository }}
        executable: /bin/bash
      register: namespace_create
      changed_when: "'created namespace' in namespace_create.stdout or namespace_create.rc == 0"
      failed_when: false
      no_log: true
      when: namespace != ""

    # =========================================================================
    # Create Backup Script
    # =========================================================================
    - name: Create backup script directory
      ansible.builtin.file:
        path: "{{ backup_script_dir }}"
        state: directory
        mode: '0755'

    - name: Create log directory
      ansible.builtin.file:
        path: "{{ log_dir }}"
        state: directory
        mode: '0755'

    - name: Deploy backup script
      ansible.builtin.copy:
        content: |
          ${indent(10, backup_script)}
        dest: "{{ backup_script_path }}"
        mode: '0755'

    # =========================================================================
    # Create Systemd Service & Timer
    # =========================================================================
    - name: Create systemd service
      ansible.builtin.copy:
        content: |
          [Unit]
          Description=PBS Backup for ${container_name} (${namespace})
          After=network-online.target
          Wants=network-online.target

          [Service]
          Type=oneshot
          EnvironmentFile=/root/.pbs-backup-env
          ExecStart={{ backup_script_path }}
          StandardOutput=append:{{ log_file }}
          StandardError=append:{{ log_file }}

          # Resource limits
          CPUQuota=50%
          MemoryMax=1G

          [Install]
          WantedBy=multi-user.target
        dest: /etc/systemd/system/{{ systemd_service_name }}
        mode: '0644'
      register: service_file

    - name: Determine systemd timer schedule
      ansible.builtin.set_fact:
        timer_oncalendar: |-
          {%- if schedule == "daily" -%}
          daily
          {%- elif schedule | regex_search('^[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}$') -%}
          *-*-* {{ schedule }}
          {%- else -%}
          {{ schedule }}
          {%- endif -%}

    - name: Create systemd timer
      ansible.builtin.copy:
        content: |
          [Unit]
          Description=Timer for PBS Backup of ${container_name}

          [Timer]
          OnCalendar={{ timer_oncalendar }}
          Persistent=true
          RandomizedDelaySec=5min

          [Install]
          WantedBy=timers.target
        dest: /etc/systemd/system/{{ systemd_timer_name }}
        mode: '0644'
      register: timer_file

    - name: Reload systemd daemon
      ansible.builtin.systemd:
        daemon_reload: true
      when: service_file is changed or timer_file is changed

    - name: Enable and start timer
      ansible.builtin.systemd:
        name: "{{ systemd_timer_name }}"
        enabled: true
        state: started

    # =========================================================================
    # Verify Configuration
    # =========================================================================
    - name: Check timer status
      ansible.builtin.command:
        cmd: systemctl status {{ systemd_timer_name }}
      register: timer_status
      changed_when: false
      failed_when: false

    - name: Display configuration summary
      ansible.builtin.debug:
        msg:
          - "=== PBS Backup Configured for ${container_name} ==="
          - ""
          - "Container ID: ${container_id}"
          - "Namespace: ${namespace}"
          - "Schedule: {{ timer_oncalendar }}"
          - "Repository: {{ pbs_repository }}"
          - "Log file: {{ log_file }}"
          - ""
          - "Manual trigger:"
          - "  systemctl start {{ systemd_service_name }}"
          - ""
          - "Check timer:"
          - "  systemctl list-timers {{ systemd_timer_name }}"
          - ""
          - "View logs:"
          - "  tail -f {{ log_file }}"

---
# =============================================================================
# Configure PBS Backup Client in LXC Container
# =============================================================================
# This playbook is generated by the lxc-sidecars OpenTofu module.
# It configures proxmox-backup-client for zero-downtime incremental backups.
# =============================================================================

- name: Configure PBS backup for ${container_name}
  hosts: ${container_name}
  gather_facts: true

  vars:
    container_id: ${container_id}
    backup_id: lxc-${container_id}
    schedule: ${schedule}
    retention: ${retention}
    pbs_server: ${pbs_server}
    pbs_datastore: ${pbs_datastore}
    pbs_user: ${pbs_user}
    pbs_password_cmd: ${pbs_password_cmd}
    pbs_repository: ${pbs_user}@${pbs_server}:${pbs_datastore}

    backup_script_dir: /usr/local/bin/pbs-backup
    backup_script_path: /usr/local/bin/pbs-backup/backup-${container_id}.sh
    log_dir: /var/log/pbs-backups
    log_file: /var/log/pbs-backups/lxc-${container_id}.log

    systemd_service_name: pbs-backup-${container_id}.service
    systemd_timer_name: pbs-backup-${container_id}.timer

    ntfy_url: ${ntfy_url}
    ntfy_priority: ${ntfy_priority}
    ntfy_tags: ${ntfy_tags}

  tasks:
    # =========================================================================
    # Install proxmox-backup-client
    # =========================================================================
    - name: Check if proxmox-backup-client is already installed
      ansible.builtin.command:
        cmd: which proxmox-backup-client
      register: pbs_client_check
      changed_when: false
      failed_when: false

    - name: Install proxmox-backup-client dependencies
      ansible.builtin.apt:
        name:
          - curl
          - ca-certificates
        state: present
        update_cache: true
      when: pbs_client_check.rc != 0

    - name: Download proxmox-backup-client binary
      ansible.builtin.get_url:
        url: https://cloud-pbs.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/proxmox-backup-client
        dest: /usr/local/bin/proxmox-backup-client
        mode: '0755'
        checksum: sha256:85b477e2f17b86947f332cfe71ccfc365e1c9821a7a748899b13fcffbcd0c8f9
      when: pbs_client_check.rc != 0

    - name: Verify proxmox-backup-client installation
      ansible.builtin.command:
        cmd: proxmox-backup-client version
      register: pbs_version_check
      changed_when: false

    - name: Display proxmox-backup-client version
      ansible.builtin.debug:
        msg: "{{ pbs_version_check.stdout }}"

    # =========================================================================
    # Configure PBS Password
    # =========================================================================
    - name: Create PBS encryption key directory
      ansible.builtin.file:
        path: /root/.config/proxmox-backup
        state: directory
        mode: '0700'

    - name: Get PBS certificate fingerprint
      ansible.builtin.shell:
        cmd: |
          ssh root@{{ pbs_server }} "proxmox-backup-manager cert info" | \
          grep "Fingerprint (sha256):" | \
          awk '{print $NF}'
      register: pbs_fingerprint
      changed_when: false
      delegate_to: localhost

    - name: Get PBS password from 1Password
      ansible.builtin.shell:
        cmd: ${pbs_password_cmd}
      register: pbs_password
      changed_when: false
      delegate_to: localhost
      no_log: true

    - name: Store PBS password and fingerprint in environment file
      ansible.builtin.copy:
        content: |
          PBS_REPOSITORY={{ pbs_repository }}
          PBS_PASSWORD={{ pbs_password.stdout }}
          PBS_FINGERPRINT={{ pbs_fingerprint.stdout }}
        dest: /root/.pbs-backup-env
        mode: '0600'
      no_log: true

    # =========================================================================
    # Create Backup Script
    # =========================================================================
    - name: Create backup script directory
      ansible.builtin.file:
        path: "{{ backup_script_dir }}"
        state: directory
        mode: '0755'

    - name: Create log directory
      ansible.builtin.file:
        path: "{{ log_dir }}"
        state: directory
        mode: '0755'

    - name: Deploy backup script
      ansible.builtin.copy:
        content: |
          ${indent(10, backup_script)}
        dest: "{{ backup_script_path }}"
        mode: '0755'

    # =========================================================================
    # Create Systemd Service & Timer
    # =========================================================================
    - name: Create systemd service
      ansible.builtin.copy:
        content: |
          [Unit]
          Description=PBS Backup for ${container_name} (lxc-${container_id})
          After=network-online.target
          Wants=network-online.target

          [Service]
          Type=oneshot
          EnvironmentFile=/root/.pbs-backup-env
          ExecStart={{ backup_script_path }}
          StandardOutput=append:{{ log_file }}
          StandardError=append:{{ log_file }}

          # Resource limits
          CPUQuota=50%
          MemoryMax=1G

          [Install]
          WantedBy=multi-user.target
        dest: /etc/systemd/system/{{ systemd_service_name }}
        mode: '0644'
      register: service_file

    - name: Determine systemd timer schedule
      ansible.builtin.set_fact:
        timer_oncalendar: |-
          {%- if schedule == "daily" -%}
          daily
          {%- elif schedule | regex_search('^[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}$') -%}
          *-*-* {{ schedule }}
          {%- else -%}
          {{ schedule }}
          {%- endif -%}

    - name: Create systemd timer
      ansible.builtin.copy:
        content: |
          [Unit]
          Description=Timer for PBS Backup of ${container_name}

          [Timer]
          OnCalendar={{ timer_oncalendar }}
          Persistent=true
          RandomizedDelaySec=5min

          [Install]
          WantedBy=timers.target
        dest: /etc/systemd/system/{{ systemd_timer_name }}
        mode: '0644'
      register: timer_file

    - name: Reload systemd daemon
      ansible.builtin.systemd:
        daemon_reload: true
      when: service_file is changed or timer_file is changed

    - name: Enable and start timer
      ansible.builtin.systemd:
        name: "{{ systemd_timer_name }}"
        enabled: true
        state: started

    # =========================================================================
    # Verify Configuration
    # =========================================================================
    - name: Check timer status
      ansible.builtin.command:
        cmd: systemctl status {{ systemd_timer_name }}
      register: timer_status
      changed_when: false
      failed_when: false

    - name: Display configuration summary
      ansible.builtin.debug:
        msg:
          - "=== PBS Backup Configured for ${container_name} ==="
          - ""
          - "Container ID: ${container_id}"
          - "Namespace: ${namespace}"
          - "Schedule: {{ timer_oncalendar }}"
          - "Repository: {{ pbs_repository }}"
          - "Log file: {{ log_file }}"
          - ""
          - "Manual trigger:"
          - "  systemctl start {{ systemd_service_name }}"
          - ""
          - "Check timer:"
          - "  systemctl list-timers {{ systemd_timer_name }}"
          - ""
          - "View logs:"
          - "  tail -f {{ log_file }}"

     5→# Generated by lxc-sidecars OpenTofu module

    14→# Configuration
    15→# =============================================================================

    18→NAMESPACE="${namespace}"
    19→RETENTION="${retention}"
    20→LOG_FILE="/var/log/pbs-backups/$${NAMESPACE}.log"
    21→
    22→# PBS repository from environment (set by systemd service)
    23→# PBS_REPOSITORY, PBS_NAMESPACE, PBS_PASSWORD, PBS_FINGERPRINT
    24→
    25→# Backup paths
    26→INCLUDE_PATHS=(
    27→%{ for path in include_paths ~}
    28→  "${path}"

    31→
    32→EXCLUDE_PATTERNS=(

    34→  "${pattern}"
    35→%{ endfor ~}
    36→)

    38→# Alert configuration
    39→NTFY_URL="${ntfy_url}"
    40→NTFY_PRIORITY="${ntfy_priority}"
    41→NTFY_TAGS="${ntfy_tags}"
    42→NTFY_USER="${ntfy_user}"
    43→NTFY_PASSWORD="${ntfy_password}"
    44→NOTIFY_ON_SUCCESS="${notify_on_success}"
    45→NOTIFY_ON_FAILURE="${notify_on_failure}"
    46→
    47→# =============================================================================
    48→# Helper Functions
    49→# =============================================================================
    50→
    51→log() {
    52→    echo "[$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')] $*"
    53→}
    54→
    55→# Legacy alert function (simple text) - kept for pre-backup hook failures
    56→send_alert() {
    57→    local title="$1"
    58→    local message="$2"
    59→    local priority="$${3:-$${NTFY_PRIORITY}}"
    60→
    61→    local auth_args=()
    62→    if [ -n "$${NTFY_USER}" ] && [ -n "$${NTFY_PASSWORD}" ]; then
    63→        auth_args=(-u "$${NTFY_USER}:$${NTFY_PASSWORD}")
    64→    fi
    65→
    66→    curl -sf "$${auth_args[@]}" \
    67→        -H "Title: $${title}" \
    68→        -H "Priority: $${priority}" \
    69→        -H "Tags: $${NTFY_TAGS}" \
    70→        -d "$${message}" \
    71→        "$${NTFY_URL}" 2>/dev/null || true
    72→}
    73→
    74→# Send structured JSON notification using ntfy pbs-backup template
    75→send_backup_notification() {
    76→    local status="$1"
    77→    local duration="$${2:-0}"
    78→    local backup_size="$${3:-unknown}"
    79→    local error_msg="$${4:-}"
    80→
    81→    # Check if notification should be sent based on status
    82→    if [ "$${status}" = "success" ] && [ "$${NOTIFY_ON_SUCCESS}" != "true" ]; then
    83→        log "Success notification disabled, skipping"
    84→        return 0
    85→    fi
    86→    if [ "$${status}" = "failure" ] && [ "$${NOTIFY_ON_FAILURE}" != "true" ]; then
    87→        log "Failure notification disabled, skipping"
    88→        return 0
    89→    fi
    90→
    91→    # Escape error message for JSON (replace quotes and newlines)
    92→    if [ -n "$${error_msg}" ]; then
    93→        error_msg=$(echo "$${error_msg}" | sed 's/"/\\"/g' | tr '\n' ' ')
    94→    fi
    95→
    96→    # Build JSON payload
    97→    local error_field=""
    98→    if [ -n "$${error_msg}" ]; then
    99→        error_field=",
   100→  \"error_message\": \"$${error_msg}\""
   101→    fi
   102→
   103→    local json_payload="{
   104→  \"status\": \"$${status}\",
   105→  \"container_name\": \"${container_name}\",
   106→  \"container_id\": \"${container_id}\",
   107→  \"namespace\": \"$${NAMESPACE}\",
   108→  \"duration\": $${duration},
   109→  \"backup_size\": \"$${backup_size}\",
   110→  \"retention\": $${RETENTION},
   111→  \"timestamp\": \"$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')\"$${error_field}
   112→}"
   113→
   114→    # Set priority based on status
   115→    local priority="$${NTFY_PRIORITY}"
   116→    if [ "$${status}" = "failure" ]; then
   117→        priority="high"
   118→    fi
   119→
   120→    log "Sending notification: status=$${status}, size=$${backup_size}, duration=$${duration}s"
   121→
   122→    local auth_args=()
   123→    if [ -n "$${NTFY_USER}" ] && [ -n "$${NTFY_PASSWORD}" ]; then
   124→        auth_args=(-u "$${NTFY_USER}:$${NTFY_PASSWORD}")
   125→    fi
   126→
   127→    curl -sf "$${auth_args[@]}" \
   128→        -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
   129→        -H "Priority: $${priority}" \
   130→        -H "Tags: $${NTFY_TAGS}" \
   131→        -d "$${json_payload}" \
   132→        "$${NTFY_URL}?template=pbs-backup" 2>/dev/null || true
   133→}
   134→
   135→# =============================================================================
   136→# Pre-Backup Commands (Database Dumps, etc.)
   137→# =============================================================================
   138→
   139→run_pre_backup_hooks() {
   140→    log "Running pre-backup hooks..."
   141→
   142→%{ if length(pre_backup_commands) > 0 ~}
   143→%{ for cmd in pre_backup_commands ~}
   144→    # ${cmd.name}
   145→    log "  - ${cmd.name}"
   146→    if timeout ${cmd.timeout} bash -c '${cmd.command}'; then
   147→        log "    ✓ Success"
   148→    else
   149→        local hook_exit_code=$?
   150→        log "    ✗ Failed (exit code: $${hook_exit_code})"
   151→        send_alert "Backup Hook Failed: ${container_name}" \
   152→            "Pre-backup hook failed: ${cmd.name} (exit code: $${hook_exit_code})" \
   153→            "high"
   154→        return 1
   155→    fi
   156→
   157→%{ endfor ~}
   158→%{ else ~}
   159→    log "  (No pre-backup hooks configured)"
   160→%{ endif ~}
   161→}
   162→
   163→# =============================================================================
   164→# Cleanup Functions
   165→# =============================================================================
   166→
   167→cleanup_temp_files() {
   168→    log "Cleaning up temporary dump files..."
   169→
   170→%{ if length(pre_backup_commands) > 0 ~}
   171→    # Remove database dumps after successful backup
   172→    find /config -type f \( -name "*.sql.gz" -o -name "*.db.backup" \) -mmin +60 -delete 2>/dev/null || true

   176→# =============================================================================
   177→# Main Backup Function
   178→# =============================================================================
   179→
   180→run_backup() {
   181→    local backup_id="lxc-$${CONTAINER_ID}"
   182→    local backup_time=$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S)
   183→    local start_time=$(date +%s)
   184→
   185→    log "=== Starting PBS Backup for ${container_name} ==="
   186→    log "Repository: $${PBS_REPOSITORY}"
   187→    log "Namespace: $${PBS_NAMESPACE}"
   188→    log "Backup ID: $${backup_id}"
   189→    log "Backup time: $${backup_time}"
   190→
   191→    # Build exclude arguments
   192→    local exclude_args=""
   193→    for pattern in "$${EXCLUDE_PATTERNS[@]}"; do
   194→        exclude_args="$${exclude_args} --exclude '$${pattern}'"
   195→    done
   196→
   197→    # Build backup command
   198→    local backup_cmd="proxmox-backup-client backup"
   199→
   200→    for path in "$${INCLUDE_PATHS[@]}"; do
   201→        local archive_name=$(basename "$${path}")
   202→        backup_cmd="$${backup_cmd} '$${archive_name}.pxar:$${path}'"
   203→    done
   204→
   205→    backup_cmd="$${backup_cmd} --repository \$PBS_REPOSITORY"
   206→%{ if namespace != "" ~}
   207→    backup_cmd="$${backup_cmd} --ns \$PBS_NAMESPACE"
   208→%{ endif ~}
   209→    backup_cmd="$${backup_cmd} --backup-id '$${backup_id}'"
   210→    backup_cmd="$${backup_cmd} --backup-time $(date +%s)"
   211→
   212→    if [ -n "$${exclude_args}" ]; then
   213→        backup_cmd="$${backup_cmd} $${exclude_args}"
   214→    fi
   215→
   216→    # Set PBS fingerprint environment variable for certificate verification
   217→    export PBS_FINGERPRINT
   218→
   219→    log "Command: $${backup_cmd}"
   220→
   221→    # Run backup and capture output for size parsing
   222→    local backup_exit_code=0
   223→    local backup_output=""
   224→    backup_output=$(eval "$${backup_cmd}" 2>&1) || backup_exit_code=$?
   225→
   226→    local end_time=$(date +%s)
   227→    local duration=$((end_time - start_time))
   228→
   229→    # Parse backup size from output (looks for "Uploaded: X.XX MiB" or "GiB")
   230→    local backup_size="unknown"
   231→    if [ -n "$${backup_output}" ]; then
   232→        # Try to extract uploaded size from PBS output
   233→        backup_size=$(echo "$${backup_output}" | grep -oP 'Uploaded:\s*\K[0-9.]+\s*[GMK]iB' | tail -1 || echo "unknown")
   234→        if [ -z "$${backup_size}" ] || [ "$${backup_size}" = "unknown" ]; then
   235→            # Fallback: try to get total size
   236→            backup_size=$(echo "$${backup_output}" | grep -oP 'total\s+\K[0-9.]+\s*[GMK]iB' | tail -1 || echo "unknown")
   237→        fi
   238→    fi
   239→
   240→    # Log the backup output

   243→    done
   244→
   245→    if [ "$${backup_exit_code}" -eq 0 ]; then
   246→        log "✓ Backup completed successfully in $${duration}s (size: $${backup_size})"
   247→
   248→        # Prune old backups
   249→        log "Pruning old backups (keep $${RETENTION})..."
   250→        proxmox-backup-client prune "host/$${backup_id}" \
   251→            --repository "$PBS_REPOSITORY" \
   252→%{ if namespace != "" ~}
   253→            --ns "$PBS_NAMESPACE" \
   254→%{ endif ~}
   255→            --keep-last "$${RETENTION}"
   256→
   257→        log "✓ Prune completed"
   258→
   259→        # Cleanup temporary files
   260→        cleanup_temp_files
   261→
   262→        # Send success notification
   263→        send_backup_notification "success" "$${duration}" "$${backup_size}"
   264→
   265→        log "=== Backup Completed Successfully ==="
   266→        return 0
   267→    else
   268→        log "✗ Backup failed with exit code: $${backup_exit_code}"
   269→
   270→        # Capture error message (last few lines of output)
   271→        local error_msg=""
   272→        if [ -n "$${backup_output}" ]; then
   273→            error_msg=$(echo "$${backup_output}" | tail -5)
   274→        fi
   275→
   276→        # Send failure notification
   277→        send_backup_notification "failure" "$${duration}" "$${backup_size}" "Exit code: $${backup_exit_code}. $${error_msg}"
   278→
   279→        return 1
   280→    fi
   281→}
   282→
   283→# =============================================================================
   284→# Main Execution
   285→# =============================================================================
   286→
   287→main() {
   288→    log "========================================"
   289→    log "PBS Backup: ${container_name}"
   290→    log "Container ID: ${container_id}"
   291→    log "Namespace: ${namespace}"
   292→    log "========================================"
   293→
   294→    # Run pre-backup hooks
   295→    if ! run_pre_backup_hooks; then
   296→        log "Pre-backup hooks failed, aborting backup"
   297→        exit 1
   298→    fi
   299→
   300→    # Run backup
   301→    if ! run_backup; then
   302→        log "Backup failed"
   303→        exit 1

#!/bin/bash
# =============================================================================
# PBS Backup Script for ${container_name} (Container ${container_id})
# =============================================================================
# Generated by lxc-sidecars OpenTofu module
# Namespace: ${namespace}
# Schedule: ${schedule}
# Retention: ${retention} backups
# =============================================================================

set -euo pipefail

# =============================================================================
# Configuration
# =============================================================================

CONTAINER_ID="${container_id}"
NAMESPACE="${namespace}"
RETENTION="${retention}"
LOG_FILE="/var/log/pbs-backups/$${NAMESPACE}.log"

# PBS repository from environment (set by systemd service)
# PBS_REPOSITORY, PBS_NAMESPACE, PBS_PASSWORD, PBS_FINGERPRINT

# Backup paths
INCLUDE_PATHS=(
%{ for path in include_paths ~}
  "${path}"
%{ endfor ~}
)

EXCLUDE_PATTERNS=(
%{ for pattern in exclude_paths ~}
  "${pattern}"
%{ endfor ~}
)

# Alert configuration
NTFY_URL="${ntfy_url}"
NTFY_PRIORITY="${ntfy_priority}"
NTFY_TAGS="${ntfy_tags}"
NTFY_USER="${ntfy_user}"
NTFY_PASSWORD="${ntfy_password}"
NOTIFY_ON_SUCCESS="${notify_on_success}"
NOTIFY_ON_FAILURE="${notify_on_failure}"

# =============================================================================
# Helper Functions
# =============================================================================

log() {
    echo "[$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')] $*"
}

# Legacy alert function (simple text) - kept for pre-backup hook failures
send_alert() {
    local title="$1"
    local message="$2"
    local priority="$${3:-$${NTFY_PRIORITY}}"

    local auth_args=()
    if [ -n "$${NTFY_USER}" ] && [ -n "$${NTFY_PASSWORD}" ]; then
        auth_args=(-u "$${NTFY_USER}:$${NTFY_PASSWORD}")
    fi

    curl -sf "$${auth_args[@]}" \
        -H "Title: $${title}" \
        -H "Priority: $${priority}" \
        -H "Tags: $${NTFY_TAGS}" \
        -d "$${message}" \
        "$${NTFY_URL}" 2>/dev/null || true
}

# Send structured JSON notification using ntfy pbs-backup template
send_backup_notification() {
    local status="$1"
    local duration="$${2:-0}"
    local backup_size="$${3:-unknown}"
    local error_msg="$${4:-}"

    # Check if notification should be sent based on status
    if [ "$${status}" = "success" ] && [ "$${NOTIFY_ON_SUCCESS}" != "true" ]; then
        log "Success notification disabled, skipping"
        return 0
    fi
    if [ "$${status}" = "failure" ] && [ "$${NOTIFY_ON_FAILURE}" != "true" ]; then
        log "Failure notification disabled, skipping"
        return 0
    fi

    # Escape error message for JSON (replace quotes and newlines)
    if [ -n "$${error_msg}" ]; then
        error_msg=$(echo "$${error_msg}" | sed 's/"/\\"/g' | tr '\n' ' ')
    fi

    # Build JSON payload
    local error_field=""
    if [ -n "$${error_msg}" ]; then
        error_field=",
  \"error_message\": \"$${error_msg}\""
    fi

    local json_payload="{
  \"status\": \"$${status}\",
  \"container_name\": \"${container_name}\",
  \"container_id\": \"${container_id}\",
  \"namespace\": \"$${NAMESPACE}\",
  \"duration\": $${duration},
  \"backup_size\": \"$${backup_size}\",
  \"retention\": $${RETENTION},
  \"timestamp\": \"$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')\"$${error_field}
}"

    # Set priority based on status
    local priority="$${NTFY_PRIORITY}"
    if [ "$${status}" = "failure" ]; then
        priority="high"
    fi

    log "Sending notification: status=$${status}, size=$${backup_size}, duration=$${duration}s"

    local auth_args=()
    if [ -n "$${NTFY_USER}" ] && [ -n "$${NTFY_PASSWORD}" ]; then
        auth_args=(-u "$${NTFY_USER}:$${NTFY_PASSWORD}")
    fi

    curl -sf "$${auth_args[@]}" \
        -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
        -H "Priority: $${priority}" \
        -H "Tags: $${NTFY_TAGS}" \
        -d "$${json_payload}" \
        "$${NTFY_URL}?template=pbs-backup" 2>/dev/null || true
}

# =============================================================================
# Pre-Backup Commands (Database Dumps, etc.)
# =============================================================================

run_pre_backup_hooks() {
    log "Running pre-backup hooks..."

%{ if length(pre_backup_commands) > 0 ~}
%{ for cmd in pre_backup_commands ~}
    # ${cmd.name}
    log "  - ${cmd.name}"
    if timeout ${cmd.timeout} bash -c '${cmd.command}'; then
        log "    ✓ Success"
    else
        local hook_exit_code=$?
        log "    ✗ Failed (exit code: $${hook_exit_code})"
        send_alert "Backup Hook Failed: ${container_name}" \
            "Pre-backup hook failed: ${cmd.name} (exit code: $${hook_exit_code})" \
            "high"
        return 1
    fi

%{ endfor ~}
%{ else ~}
    log "  (No pre-backup hooks configured)"
%{ endif ~}
}

# =============================================================================
# Cleanup Functions
# =============================================================================

cleanup_temp_files() {
    log "Cleaning up temporary dump files..."

%{ if length(pre_backup_commands) > 0 ~}
    # Remove database dumps after successful backup
    find /config -type f \( -name "*.sql.gz" -o -name "*.db.backup" \) -mmin +60 -delete 2>/dev/null || true
%{ endif ~}
}

# =============================================================================
# Main Backup Function
# =============================================================================

run_backup() {
    local backup_id="lxc-$${CONTAINER_ID}"
    local backup_time=$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S)
    local start_time=$(date +%s)

    log "=== Starting PBS Backup for ${container_name} ==="
    log "Repository: $${PBS_REPOSITORY}"
    log "Namespace: $${PBS_NAMESPACE}"
    log "Backup ID: $${backup_id}"
    log "Backup time: $${backup_time}"

    # Build exclude arguments
    local exclude_args=""
    for pattern in "$${EXCLUDE_PATTERNS[@]}"; do
        exclude_args="$${exclude_args} --exclude '$${pattern}'"
    done

    # Build backup command
    local backup_cmd="proxmox-backup-client backup"

    for path in "$${INCLUDE_PATHS[@]}"; do
        local archive_name=$(basename "$${path}")
        backup_cmd="$${backup_cmd} '$${archive_name}.pxar:$${path}'"
    done

    backup_cmd="$${backup_cmd} --repository \$PBS_REPOSITORY"
%{ if namespace != "" ~}
    backup_cmd="$${backup_cmd} --ns \$PBS_NAMESPACE"
%{ endif ~}
    backup_cmd="$${backup_cmd} --backup-id '$${backup_id}'"
    backup_cmd="$${backup_cmd} --backup-time $(date +%s)"

    if [ -n "$${exclude_args}" ]; then
        backup_cmd="$${backup_cmd} $${exclude_args}"
    fi

    # Set PBS fingerprint environment variable for certificate verification
    export PBS_FINGERPRINT

    log "Command: $${backup_cmd}"

    # Run backup and capture output for size parsing
    local backup_exit_code=0
    local backup_output=""
    backup_output=$(eval "$${backup_cmd}" 2>&1) || backup_exit_code=$?

    local end_time=$(date +%s)
    local duration=$((end_time - start_time))

    # Parse backup size from output (looks for "Uploaded: X.XX MiB" or "GiB")
    local backup_size="unknown"
    if [ -n "$${backup_output}" ]; then
        # Try to extract uploaded size from PBS output
        backup_size=$(echo "$${backup_output}" | grep -oP 'Uploaded:\s*\K[0-9.]+\s*[GMK]iB' | tail -1 || echo "unknown")
        if [ -z "$${backup_size}" ] || [ "$${backup_size}" = "unknown" ]; then
            # Fallback: try to get total size
            backup_size=$(echo "$${backup_output}" | grep -oP 'total\s+\K[0-9.]+\s*[GMK]iB' | tail -1 || echo "unknown")
        fi
    fi

    # Log the backup output
    echo "$${backup_output}" | while IFS= read -r line; do
        log "  $${line}"
    done

    if [ "$${backup_exit_code}" -eq 0 ]; then
        log "✓ Backup completed successfully in $${duration}s (size: $${backup_size})"

        # Prune old backups
        log "Pruning old backups (keep $${RETENTION})..."
        proxmox-backup-client prune "host/$${backup_id}" \
            --repository "$PBS_REPOSITORY" \
%{ if namespace != "" ~}
            --ns "$PBS_NAMESPACE" \
%{ endif ~}
            --keep-last "$${RETENTION}"

        log "✓ Prune completed"

        # Cleanup temporary files
        cleanup_temp_files

        # Send success notification
        send_backup_notification "success" "$${duration}" "$${backup_size}"

        log "=== Backup Completed Successfully ==="
        return 0
    else
        log "✗ Backup failed with exit code: $${backup_exit_code}"

        # Capture error message (last few lines of output)
        local error_msg=""
        if [ -n "$${backup_output}" ]; then
            error_msg=$(echo "$${backup_output}" | tail -5)
        fi

        # Send failure notification
        send_backup_notification "failure" "$${duration}" "$${backup_size}" "Exit code: $${backup_exit_code}. $${error_msg}"

        return 1
    fi
}

# =============================================================================
# Main Execution
# =============================================================================

main() {
    log "========================================"
    log "PBS Backup: ${container_name}"
    log "Container ID: ${container_id}"
    log "Namespace: ${namespace}"
    log "========================================"

    # Run pre-backup hooks
    if ! run_pre_backup_hooks; then
        log "Pre-backup hooks failed, aborting backup"
        exit 1
    fi

    # Run backup
    if ! run_backup; then
        log "Backup failed"
        exit 1
    fi

    log "All tasks completed successfully"
    exit 0
}

# Run main function
main
