# Retention: ${retention} backups
# =============================================================================

set -euo pipefail

# =============================================================================
# Configuration
# =============================================================================

CONTAINER_ID="${container_id}"
BACKUP_ID="lxc-${container_id}"
RETENTION="${retention}"
LOG_FILE="/var/log/pbs-backups/lxc-${container_id}.log"

# PBS repository from environment (set by systemd service)
# PBS_REPOSITORY, PBS_PASSWORD, PBS_FINGERPRINT

# Backup paths
INCLUDE_PATHS=(
%{ for path in include_paths ~}
  "${path}"
%{ endfor ~}
)

EXCLUDE_PATTERNS=(
%{ for pattern in exclude_paths ~}
  "${pattern}"
%{ endfor ~}
)

# Alert configuration
NTFY_URL="${ntfy_url}"
NTFY_PRIORITY="${ntfy_priority}"
NTFY_TAGS="${ntfy_tags}"
NTFY_USER="${ntfy_user}"
NTFY_PASSWORD="${ntfy_password}"
NOTIFY_ON_SUCCESS="${notify_on_success}"
NOTIFY_ON_FAILURE="${notify_on_failure}"

# =============================================================================
# Helper Functions
# =============================================================================

log() {
    echo "[$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')] $*"
}

# Legacy alert function (simple text) - kept for pre-backup hook failures
send_alert() {
    local title="$1"
    local message="$2"
    local priority="$${3:-$${NTFY_PRIORITY}}"

    local auth_args=()
    if [ -n "$${NTFY_USER}" ] && [ -n "$${NTFY_PASSWORD}" ]; then
        auth_args=(-u "$${NTFY_USER}:$${NTFY_PASSWORD}")
    fi

    curl -sf "$${auth_args[@]}" \
        -H "Title: $${title}" \
        -H "Priority: $${priority}" \
        -H "Tags: $${NTFY_TAGS}" \
        -d "$${message}" \
        "$${NTFY_URL}" 2>/dev/null || true
}

# Send structured JSON notification using ntfy pbs-backup template
send_backup_notification() {
    local status="$1"
    local duration="$${2:-0}"
    local backup_size="$${3:-unknown}"
    local error_msg="$${4:-}"

    # Check if notification should be sent based on status
    if [ "$${status}" = "success" ] && [ "$${NOTIFY_ON_SUCCESS}" != "true" ]; then
        log "Success notification disabled, skipping"
        return 0
    fi
    if [ "$${status}" = "failure" ] && [ "$${NOTIFY_ON_FAILURE}" != "true" ]; then
        log "Failure notification disabled, skipping"
        return 0
    fi

    # Escape error message for JSON (replace quotes and newlines)
    if [ -n "$${error_msg}" ]; then
        error_msg=$(echo "$${error_msg}" | sed 's/"/\\"/g' | tr '\n' ' ')
    fi

    # Build JSON payload
    local error_field=""
    if [ -n "$${error_msg}" ]; then
        error_field=",
  \"error_message\": \"$${error_msg}\""
    fi

    local json_payload="{
  \"status\": \"$${status}\",
  \"container_name\": \"${container_name}\",
  \"container_id\": \"${container_id}\",
  \"namespace\": \"$${NAMESPACE}\",
  \"duration\": $${duration},
  \"backup_size\": \"$${backup_size}\",
  \"retention\": $${RETENTION},
  \"timestamp\": \"$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')\"$${error_field}
}"

    # Set priority based on status
    local priority="$${NTFY_PRIORITY}"
    if [ "$${status}" = "failure" ]; then
        priority="high"
    fi

    log "Sending notification: status=$${status}, size=$${backup_size}, duration=$${duration}s"

    local auth_args=()
    if [ -n "$${NTFY_USER}" ] && [ -n "$${NTFY_PASSWORD}" ]; then
        auth_args=(-u "$${NTFY_USER}:$${NTFY_PASSWORD}")
    fi

    curl -sf "$${auth_args[@]}" \
        -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
        -H "Priority: $${priority}" \
        -H "Tags: $${NTFY_TAGS}" \
        -d "$${json_payload}" \
        "$${NTFY_URL}?template=pbs-backup" 2>/dev/null || true
}

# =============================================================================

%{ if length(pre_backup_commands) > 0 ~}
%{ for cmd in pre_backup_commands ~}
    # ${cmd.name}
    log "  - ${cmd.name}"
    if timeout ${cmd.timeout} bash -c '${cmd.command}'; then
        log "    ✓ Success"
    else
        local hook_exit_code=$?
        log "    ✗ Failed (exit code: $${hook_exit_code})"
        send_alert "Backup Hook Failed: ${container_name}" \
            "Pre-backup hook failed: ${cmd.name} (exit code: $${hook_exit_code})" \
            "high"
        return 1
    fi

%{ endfor ~}
%{ else ~}
    log "  (No pre-backup hooks configured)"
%{ endif ~}
}

# =============================================================================
# Cleanup Functions
# =============================================================================

cleanup_temp_files() {
    log "Cleaning up temporary dump files..."

%{ if length(pre_backup_commands) > 0 ~}
    # Remove database dumps after successful backup
    find /config -type f \( -name "*.sql.gz" -o -name "*.db.backup" \) -mmin +60 -delete 2>/dev/null || true
%{ endif ~}
}

# =============================================================================
# Main Backup Function
# =============================================================================

run_backup() {
    local backup_id="lxc-$${CONTAINER_ID}"
    local backup_time=$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S)
    local start_time=$(date +%s)

    log "=== Starting PBS Backup for ${container_name} ==="
    log "Repository: $${PBS_REPOSITORY}"
    log "Namespace: $${PBS_NAMESPACE}"
    log "Backup ID: $${backup_id}"
    log "Backup time: $${backup_time}"

    # Build exclude arguments
    local exclude_args=""
    for pattern in "$${EXCLUDE_PATTERNS[@]}"; do
        exclude_args="$${exclude_args} --exclude '$${pattern}'"
    done

    # Build backup command
    local backup_cmd="proxmox-backup-client backup"

    for path in "$${INCLUDE_PATHS[@]}"; do
        local archive_name=$(basename "$${path}")
        backup_cmd="$${backup_cmd} '$${archive_name}.pxar:$${path}'"
    done

    backup_cmd="$${backup_cmd} --repository \$PBS_REPOSITORY"
%{ if namespace != "" ~}
    backup_cmd="$${backup_cmd} --ns \$PBS_NAMESPACE"
%{ endif ~}
    backup_cmd="$${backup_cmd} --backup-id '$${backup_id}'"
    backup_cmd="$${backup_cmd} --backup-time $(date +%s)"

    if [ -n "$${exclude_args}" ]; then
        backup_cmd="$${backup_cmd} $${exclude_args}"
    fi

    # Set PBS fingerprint environment variable for certificate verification
    export PBS_FINGERPRINT

    log "Command: $${backup_cmd}"

    # Run backup and capture output for size parsing
    local backup_exit_code=0
    local backup_output=""
    backup_output=$(eval "$${backup_cmd}" 2>&1) || backup_exit_code=$?

    local end_time=$(date +%s)
    local duration=$((end_time - start_time))

    # Parse backup size from output (looks for "Uploaded: X.XX MiB" or "GiB")
    local backup_size="unknown"
    if [ -n "$${backup_output}" ]; then
        # Try to extract uploaded size from PBS output
        backup_size=$(echo "$${backup_output}" | grep -oP 'Uploaded:\s*\K[0-9.]+\s*[GMK]iB' | tail -1 || echo "unknown")
        if [ -z "$${backup_size}" ] || [ "$${backup_size}" = "unknown" ]; then
            # Fallback: try to get total size
            backup_size=$(echo "$${backup_output}" | grep -oP 'total\s+\K[0-9.]+\s*[GMK]iB' | tail -1 || echo "unknown")
        fi
    fi

    # Log the backup output
    echo "$${backup_output}" | while IFS= read -r line; do
        log "  $${line}"
    done

    if [ "$${backup_exit_code}" -eq 0 ]; then
        log "✓ Backup completed successfully in $${duration}s (size: $${backup_size})"

        # Prune old backups
        log "Pruning old backups (keep $${RETENTION})..."
        proxmox-backup-client prune "host/$${backup_id}" \
            --repository "$PBS_REPOSITORY" \
%{ if namespace != "" ~}
            --ns "$PBS_NAMESPACE" \
%{ endif ~}
            --keep-last "$${RETENTION}"

        log "✓ Prune completed"

        # Cleanup temporary files
        cleanup_temp_files

        # Send success notification
        send_backup_notification "success" "$${duration}" "$${backup_size}"

        log "=== Backup Completed Successfully ==="
        return 0
    else
        log "✗ Backup failed with exit code: $${backup_exit_code}"

        # Capture error message (last few lines of output)
        local error_msg=""
        if [ -n "$${backup_output}" ]; then
            error_msg=$(echo "$${backup_output}" | tail -5)
        fi

        # Send failure notification
        send_backup_notification "failure" "$${duration}" "$${backup_size}" "Exit code: $${backup_exit_code}. $${error_msg}"

        return 1
    fi
}

# =============================================================================
# Main Execution
# =============================================================================

main() {
    log "========================================"
    log "PBS Backup: ${container_name}"
    log "Container ID: ${container_id}"
    log "Namespace: ${namespace}"
    log "========================================"

    # Run pre-backup hooks
    if ! run_pre_backup_hooks; then
        log "Pre-backup hooks failed, aborting backup"
        exit 1
    fi

    # Run backup
    if ! run_backup; then
        log "Backup failed"
        exit 1
    fi

    log "All tasks completed successfully"
    exit 0
}

# Run main function
main

# PBS Backup Script for ${container_name} (Container ${container_id})
# =============================================================================
# Generated by lxc-sidecars OpenTofu module

# Schedule: ${schedule}
# Retention: ${retention} backups
# =============================================================================

set -euo pipefail

# Configuration
# =============================================================================

CONTAINER_ID="${container_id}"
BACKUP_ID="lxc-${container_id}"
RETENTION="${retention}"
LOG_FILE="/var/log/pbs-backups/lxc-${container_id}.log"

# PBS repository from environment (set by systemd service)
# PBS_REPOSITORY, PBS_PASSWORD, PBS_FINGERPRINT

# Backup paths
INCLUDE_PATHS=(
%{ for path in include_paths ~}
  "${path}"
%{ endfor ~}
)

EXCLUDE_PATTERNS=(
%{ for pattern in exclude_paths ~}
  "${pattern}"
%{ endfor ~}
)

# Alert configuration
NTFY_URL="${ntfy_url}"
NTFY_PRIORITY="${ntfy_priority}"
NTFY_TAGS="${ntfy_tags}"
NTFY_USER="${ntfy_user}"
NTFY_PASSWORD="${ntfy_password}"
NOTIFY_ON_SUCCESS="${notify_on_success}"
NOTIFY_ON_FAILURE="${notify_on_failure}"

# =============================================================================
# Helper Functions
# =============================================================================

log() {
    echo "[$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')] $*"
}

# Legacy alert function (simple text) - kept for pre-backup hook failures
send_alert() {
    local title="$1"
    local message="$2"
    local priority="$${3:-$${NTFY_PRIORITY}}"

    local auth_args=()
    if [ -n "$${NTFY_USER}" ] && [ -n "$${NTFY_PASSWORD}" ]; then
        auth_args=(-u "$${NTFY_USER}:$${NTFY_PASSWORD}")
    fi

    curl -sf "$${auth_args[@]}" \
        -H "Title: $${title}" \
        -H "Priority: $${priority}" \
        -H "Tags: $${NTFY_TAGS}" \
        -d "$${message}" \
        "$${NTFY_URL}" 2>/dev/null || true
}

# Send structured JSON notification using ntfy pbs-backup template
send_backup_notification() {
    local status="$1"
    local duration="$${2:-0}"
    local backup_size="$${3:-unknown}"
    local error_msg="$${4:-}"

    # Check if notification should be sent based on status
    if [ "$${status}" = "success" ] && [ "$${NOTIFY_ON_SUCCESS}" != "true" ]; then
        log "Success notification disabled, skipping"
        return 0
    fi
    if [ "$${status}" = "failure" ] && [ "$${NOTIFY_ON_FAILURE}" != "true" ]; then
        log "Failure notification disabled, skipping"
        return 0
    fi

    # Escape error message for JSON (replace quotes and newlines)
    if [ -n "$${error_msg}" ]; then
        error_msg=$(echo "$${error_msg}" | sed 's/"/\\"/g' | tr '\n' ' ')
    fi

    # Build JSON payload
    local error_field=""
    if [ -n "$${error_msg}" ]; then
        error_field=",
  \"error_message\": \"$${error_msg}\""
    fi

    local json_payload="{
  \"status\": \"$${status}\",
  \"container_name\": \"${container_name}\",
  \"container_id\": \"${container_id}\",
  \"backup_id\": \"$${BACKUP_ID}\",
  \"duration\": $${duration},
  \"backup_size\": \"$${backup_size}\",
  \"retention\": $${RETENTION},
  \"timestamp\": \"$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')\"$${error_field}
}"

    local priority="$${NTFY_PRIORITY}"
    if [ "$${status}" = "failure" ]; then
        priority="high"
    fi

    log "Sending notification: status=$${status}, size=$${backup_size}, duration=$${duration}s"

    local auth_args=()
    if [ -n "$${NTFY_USER}" ] && [ -n "$${NTFY_PASSWORD}" ]; then
        auth_args=(-u "$${NTFY_USER}:$${NTFY_PASSWORD}")
    fi

        -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
        -H "Priority: $${priority}" \
        -H "Tags: $${NTFY_TAGS}" \
        -d "$${json_payload}" \
        "$${NTFY_URL}?template=pbs-backup" 2>/dev/null || true
}

# Pre-Backup Commands (Database Dumps, etc.)
# =============================================================================

run_pre_backup_hooks() {
    log "Running pre-backup hooks..."

%{ if length(pre_backup_commands) > 0 ~}
%{ for cmd in pre_backup_commands ~}
    # ${cmd.name}
    log "  - ${cmd.name}"
    if timeout ${cmd.timeout} bash -c '${cmd.command}'; then
        log "    ✓ Success"

        log "    ✗ Failed (exit code: $${hook_exit_code})"

            "Pre-backup hook failed: ${cmd.name} (exit code: $${hook_exit_code})" \

    fi

%{ endfor ~}
%{ else ~}

%{ endif ~}

# =============================================================================

cleanup_temp_files() {

%{ if length(pre_backup_commands) > 0 ~}

%{ endif ~}
}

# Main Backup Function
# =============================================================================

run_backup() {
    local backup_time=$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S)
    local start_time=$(date +%s)

    log "=== Starting PBS Backup for ${container_name} ==="
    log "Repository: $${PBS_REPOSITORY}"
    log "Backup ID: $${BACKUP_ID}"
    log "Backup time: $${backup_time}"

    # Build exclude arguments
    local exclude_args=""
    for pattern in "$${EXCLUDE_PATTERNS[@]}"; do
        exclude_args="$${exclude_args} --exclude '$${pattern}'"
    done

    # Build backup command
    local backup_cmd="proxmox-backup-client backup"

    for path in "$${INCLUDE_PATHS[@]}"; do
        local archive_name=$(basename "$${path}")
        backup_cmd="$${backup_cmd} '$${archive_name}.pxar:$${path}'"
    done

    backup_cmd="$${backup_cmd} --repository \$PBS_REPOSITORY"
    backup_cmd="$${backup_cmd} --backup-id '$${BACKUP_ID}'"
    backup_cmd="$${backup_cmd} --backup-time $(date +%s)"

    if [ -n "$${exclude_args}" ]; then
        backup_cmd="$${backup_cmd} $${exclude_args}"
    fi

    # Set PBS fingerprint environment variable for certificate verification
    export PBS_FINGERPRINT

    log "Command: $${backup_cmd}"

    # Run backup and capture output for size parsing
    local backup_exit_code=0
    local backup_output=""
    backup_output=$(eval "$${backup_cmd}" 2>&1) || backup_exit_code=$?

    local end_time=$(date +%s)
    local duration=$((end_time - start_time))

    # Parse backup size from output (looks for "Uploaded: X.XX MiB" or "GiB")
    local backup_size="unknown"
    if [ -n "$${backup_output}" ]; then
        # Try to extract uploaded size from PBS output
        backup_size=$(echo "$${backup_output}" | grep -oP 'Uploaded:\s*\K[0-9.]+\s*[GMK]iB' | tail -1 || echo "unknown")
        if [ -z "$${backup_size}" ] || [ "$${backup_size}" = "unknown" ]; then
            # Fallback: try to get total size
            backup_size=$(echo "$${backup_output}" | grep -oP 'total\s+\K[0-9.]+\s*[GMK]iB' | tail -1 || echo "unknown")
        fi
    fi

    # Log the backup output
    echo "$${backup_output}" | while IFS= read -r line; do
        log "  $${line}"
    done

    if [ "$${backup_exit_code}" -eq 0 ]; then
        log "✓ Backup completed successfully in $${duration}s (size: $${backup_size})"

        # Prune old backups
        log "Pruning old backups (keep $${RETENTION})..."
        proxmox-backup-client prune "host/$${backup_id}" \
            --repository "$PBS_REPOSITORY" \
%{ if namespace != "" ~}
            --ns "$PBS_NAMESPACE" \
%{ endif ~}
            --keep-last "$${RETENTION}"

        log "✓ Prune completed"

        # Cleanup temporary files
        cleanup_temp_files

        # Send success notification
        send_backup_notification "success" "$${duration}" "$${backup_size}"

        log "=== Backup Completed Successfully ==="
        return 0
    else
        log "✗ Backup failed with exit code: $${backup_exit_code}"

        # Capture error message (last few lines of output)
        local error_msg=""
        if [ -n "$${backup_output}" ]; then
            error_msg=$(echo "$${backup_output}" | tail -5)
        fi

        # Send failure notification
        send_backup_notification "failure" "$${duration}" "$${backup_size}" "Exit code: $${backup_exit_code}. $${error_msg}"

        return 1
    fi
}

# =============================================================================
# Main Execution
# =============================================================================

main() {
    log "========================================"
    log "PBS Backup: ${container_name}"
    log "Container ID: ${container_id}"
    log "Namespace: ${namespace}"
    log "========================================"

    # Run pre-backup hooks
    if ! run_pre_backup_hooks; then
        log "Pre-backup hooks failed, aborting backup"
        exit 1
    fi

    # Run backup
    if ! run_backup; then
        log "Backup failed"
        exit 1
    fi

    log "All tasks completed successfully"
    exit 0
}

# Run main function
main

# =============================================================================
# n8n LXC - Workflow Automation
# =============================================================================
# Container ID: 502
#
# Uses the docker-lxc module - the gold standard pattern for Docker apps.
# Plus traefik-route module for self-service routing.
# =============================================================================

module "n8n" {
  source = "../../modules/docker-lxc"

  # Identity
  name         = "n8n"
  container_id = 502

  # Network (container network only)
  container_ip = "${local.ip_registry.monitoring.n8n}${local.network.container_netmask}"

  # Resources
  cores          = 2
  memory         = 2048
  swap           = 1024
  rootfs_size    = 8
  rootfs_storage = "nvme-containers"

  # Deployment
  deploy_dir = "${path.module}/deploy"

  # SSH
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path
  ssh_public_key       = local.ssh_public_key
  proxmox_ssh_host     = local.proxmox_ssh_host

  # Container options - unprivileged for security
  unprivileged = true
  template     = var.lxc_template_docker

  # Proxmox notes
  service_description = "Workflow automation platform"
  service_urls = {
    internal = "https://n8n.${var.domain_internal}/"
    direct   = "http://${local.lan_ips.n8n}:5678/"
  }
  services = [
    { name = "n8n", port = 5678, info = "Web UI and API" }
  ]
  custom_notes = <<-EOT
## Docker Deployment

**Compose file:** `/config/docker-compose.yml`
**Data volume:** `n8n_data`

## Quick Commands

**View logs:**
```
cd /config && docker compose logs -f n8n
```

**Restart n8n:**
```
cd /config && docker compose restart n8n
```

## Managed by OpenTofu

Run `task tofu:apply APP=n8n` to update.
EOT

  tags = ["n8n", "automation"]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Backup Configuration - PBS Client
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "n8n_sidecars" {
  source = "../../modules/lxc-sidecars"

  container_id   = module.n8n.container_id
  container_ip   = module.n8n.ip_address
  container_name = "n8n"

  proxmox_ssh_host             = local.proxmox_ssh_host
  proxmox_ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  backup = {
    enabled   = true
    schedule  = "daily"
    retention = "7"
    namespace = "lxc-502"

    pre_backup_commands = [{
      name    = "SQLite backup"
      command = "cp /var/lib/docker/volumes/config_n8n_data/_data/database.sqlite /var/lib/docker/volumes/config_n8n_data/_data/database.sqlite.backup"
      timeout = 60
    }]

    include_paths = ["/config", "/var/lib/docker/volumes/config_n8n_data/_data"]
    exclude_paths = ["/var/lib/docker/overlay2"]

    ntfy_priority = "default"
    ntfy_tags     = "backup,n8n"
    ntfy_user     = "pbs-backup"
    ntfy_password = local.op.ntfy_pbs_backup_password
  }

  # Container monitoring agents
  pulse_agent = {
    enabled     = true
    pulse_token = local.agent_tokens["n8n"].pulse_token
  }

  arcane_agent = {
    enabled         = true
    bootstrap_token = local.agent_tokens["n8n"].arcane_bootstrap_token
  }

  alloy_agent = {
    enabled  = true
    username = local.op.alloy_telemetry_username
    password = local.op.alloy_telemetry_password
  }

  depends_on = [module.n8n]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Traefik Route - Self-Service Route Registration
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "n8n_route" {
  source = "../../modules/traefik-route"

  app_name    = "n8n"
  backend_url = "http://${module.n8n.ip_address}:5678"

  # Internal route (HTTPS via Let's Encrypt)
  internal_domain = "n8n.${var.domain_internal}"

  # Traefik config
  traefik_host         = local.traefik_ip
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  # Middlewares - authentik provides SSO authentication
  internal_middlewares = ["security-headers", "authentik"]

  depends_on = [module.n8n]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Outputs
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

output "container_id" {
  value = module.n8n.container_id
}

output "ip_address" {
  value = module.n8n.ip_address
}

output "ssh_command" {
  value = module.n8n.ssh_command
}

output "urls" {
  value = {
    internal = module.n8n_route.internal_url
    direct   = "http://${module.n8n.ip_address}:5678/"
  }
}

output "traefik_config_path" {
  description = "Path to Traefik config on Traefik LXC"
  value       = module.n8n_route.remote_config_path
}

# =============================================================================
# Authentik LXC - Identity Provider (SSO/OIDC)
# =============================================================================
# Container ID: 203
#
# Replaces Authelia with a more feature-rich identity provider:
#   - Native Google/GitHub OAuth federation
#   - OIDC provider for apps with native SSO support
#   - Forward auth for apps without native OAuth
#   - Centralized user/group management
#
# File Structure:
#   - main.tf:      Container, env, routes, sidecars
#   - providers.tf: OAuth sources, forward auth, OIDC providers
#   - users.tf:     User management (SOPS-encrypted)
#   - outputs.tf:   All outputs
# =============================================================================

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Variables
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

variable "container_id" {
  description = "Container ID for Authentik LXC"
  type        = number
  default     = 203
}

variable "cores" {
  description = "CPU cores"
  type        = number
  default     = 2
}

variable "memory" {
  description = "Memory in MB"
  type        = number
  default     = 4096  # Authentik recommended minimum
}

variable "swap" {
  description = "Swap in MB"
  type        = number
  default     = 1024
}

variable "rootfs_size" {
  description = "Root filesystem size in GB"
  type        = number
  default     = 16
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Authentik Container
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "authentik" {
  source = "../../modules/docker-lxc"

  name         = "authentik"
  container_id = var.container_id
  proxmox_node = var.proxmox_node

  # Network (container network only - Traefik handles external access)
  container_ip = "${local.ip_registry.dashboards.authentik}${local.network.container_netmask}"

  # Resources
  cores  = var.cores
  memory = var.memory
  swap   = var.swap

  rootfs_storage = "nvme-containers"
  rootfs_size    = var.rootfs_size

  # Unprivileged container (security hardened)
  unprivileged = true

  # Deployment
  deploy_dir  = "${path.module}/deploy"
  target_path = "/config"

  # Exclude .env template files (we generate .env from template)
  exclude_patterns = ["^\\.env"]

  # SSH
  ssh_public_key       = local.ssh_public_key
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path
  proxmox_ssh_host     = local.proxmox_ssh_host

  # Template with Docker pre-installed
  template = var.lxc_template_docker

  # Proxmox Notes
  service_name        = "Authentik"
  service_description = "Identity Provider - SSO, OIDC, and forward auth for all homelab services"

  service_urls = {
    admin    = "https://auth.${var.domain_internal}/if/admin/"
    user     = "https://auth.${var.domain_internal}/if/user/"
    direct   = "http://${local.ip_registry.dashboards.authentik}:9000"
  }

  services = [
    { name = "Authentik HTTP", port = 9000, info = "Web UI and API" },
    { name = "Authentik HTTPS", port = 9443, info = "HTTPS (self-signed)" },
    { name = "PostgreSQL", port = 5432, info = "Database (internal only)" }
  ]

  custom_notes = <<-EOT
## Initial Setup

1. Access the admin interface at https://auth.${var.domain_internal}/if/admin/
2. Login with credentials from 1Password (item: authentik)
3. Configure Google OAuth source for SSO

## Forward Auth Endpoint

Add this middleware to Traefik routes for protected services:
```yaml
middlewares:
  authentik:
    forwardAuth:
      address: https://auth.${var.domain_public}/outpost.goauthentik.io/auth/traefik
      trustForwardHeader: true
      authResponseHeaders:
        - X-authentik-username
        - X-authentik-groups
        - X-authentik-email
        - X-authentik-name
        - X-authentik-uid
        - X-authentik-jwt
        - X-authentik-meta-jwks
        - X-authentik-meta-outpost
        - X-authentik-meta-provider
        - X-authentik-meta-app
        - X-authentik-meta-version
```

## Quick Commands

```bash
# View server logs
docker logs -f authentik-server

# View worker logs
docker logs -f authentik-worker

# Database backup
docker exec authentik-postgres pg_dump -U authentik authentik > backup.sql

# Restart services
cd /config && docker compose restart
```

## OIDC Configuration

For apps with native OIDC support, create a Provider in Authentik:
1. Admin → Providers → Create OAuth2/OIDC Provider
2. Set redirect URI for the app
3. Create Application linking to the provider
4. Use client_id and client_secret in the app config

resource "local_sensitive_file" "authentik_env" {
  content = templatefile("${path.module}/deploy/.env.tpl", {
    postgres_password = local.op.authentik_postgres_password
    secret_key        = local.op.authentik_secret_key
    admin_email       = "admin@${var.domain_internal}"
    admin_password    = local.op.authentik_admin_password
  })
  filename        = "${path.module}/.terraform/authentik.env"
  file_permission = "0600"
}

resource "filesync_file" "authentik_env" {
  source      = local_sensitive_file.authentik_env.filename
  destination = "/config/.env"
  host        = module.authentik.ip_address

  mode = "0600"

  depends_on = [module.authentik]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Traefik Route - Self-Service Route Registration
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "authentik_route" {
  source = "../../modules/traefik-route"

  app_name    = "authentik"
  backend_url = "http://${module.authentik.ip_address}:9000"

  # Internal route (HTTPS via Let's Encrypt)
  # Using "auth" subdomain to match Authelia for easier migration
  internal_domain = "auth.${var.domain_internal}"

  # Public route for external access (Google OAuth redirect)
  public_domain = "auth.${var.domain_public}"

  # Traefik config
  traefik_host         = local.traefik_ip
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  # No auth middleware on the auth service itself!
  internal_middlewares = ["security-headers"]
  # cloudflare-https sets X-Forwarded-Proto: https to fix mixed content issues
  public_middlewares   = ["cloudflare-https", "security-headers"]
  # Use "web" entrypoint for public - Cloudflare handles TLS and forwards HTTP to origin
  public_entrypoint    = ["web"]

  depends_on = [module.authentik]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Traefik Forward Auth Middleware
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Generates the forwardAuth middleware config and syncs to Traefik

resource "local_file" "traefik_middleware" {
  content = templatefile("${path.module}/deploy/traefik-middleware.yml.tpl", {
    authentik_ip = module.authentik.ip_address
  })
  filename = "${path.module}/.terraform/authentik-middleware.yml"
}

resource "filesync_file" "traefik_middleware" {
  source      = local_file.traefik_middleware.filename
  destination = "/config/dynamic/authentik-middleware.yml"
  host        = local.traefik_ip

  mode = "0644"

  depends_on = [module.authentik, local_file.traefik_middleware]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Backup Configuration - PBS Client + Sidecars
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "authentik_sidecars" {
  source = "../../modules/lxc-sidecars"

  container_id   = module.authentik.container_id
  container_ip   = module.authentik.ip_address
  container_name = "authentik"

  proxmox_ssh_host             = local.proxmox_ssh_host
  proxmox_ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  backup = {
    enabled   = true
    schedule  = "Sun 03:00"  # Weekly backup
    retention = "4"          # Keep 4 weekly backups
    namespace = "lxc-203"

    # Dump PostgreSQL before backup
    pre_backup_commands = [
      {
        name    = "Backup PostgreSQL database"
        command = "docker exec authentik-postgres pg_dump -U authentik authentik > /config/authentik-db-backup.sql"
        timeout = 120
      }
    ]

    include_paths = ["/config"]
    exclude_paths = ["/var/lib/docker/overlay2"]

    ntfy_priority = "default"
    ntfy_tags     = "backup,authentik"
    ntfy_user     = "pbs-backup"
    ntfy_password = local.op.ntfy_pbs_backup_password
  }

  # Container monitoring agents
  pulse_agent = {
    enabled     = true
    pulse_token = local.agent_tokens["authentik"].pulse_token
  }

  arcane_agent = {
    enabled         = true
    bootstrap_token = local.agent_tokens["authentik"].arcane_bootstrap_token
  }

  alloy_agent = {
    enabled  = true
    username = local.op.alloy_telemetry_username
    password = local.op.alloy_telemetry_password
  }

  depends_on = [module.authentik]
}

  }

  services = [

    { name = "SABnzbd", port = 8085, info = "Usenet download client" },

**Data Directory:** `/data` (mounted from `/tank/data`)
- `/data/torrents/movies` - Movie downloads
- `/data/torrents/tv` - TV show downloads
- `/data/torrents/music` - Music downloads
- `/data/library/movies` - Movie library (hardlinks from downloads)
- `/data/library/tv` - TV show library (hardlinks from downloads)
- `/data/library/music` - Music library (hardlinks from downloads)

## VPN Protection

All torrent traffic routes through Gluetun (NordVPN WireGuard):
- qBittorrent, Prowlarr, FlareSolverr use VPN network
- Sonarr, Radarr, Lidarr, Bazarr use host network

**Check VPN status:**
```bash
docker exec gluetun wget -qO- ifconfig.me
```

**Restart VPN:**
```bash

```

**Check qBittorrent connectivity:**
```bash
docker exec qbittorrent curl -s ifconfig.me
```

## TRaSH Guides Sync

Recyclarr runs on schedule to sync quality profiles:
```bash
docker exec recyclarr recyclarr sync
```

# =============================================================================
# Container ID: 401

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Generate .env file with Jellystat credentials
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

resource "local_sensitive_file" "jellyfin_env" {
  filename = "${path.module}/deploy/.env"
  content  = <<-EOT
# Jellyfin Stack Environment Variables
# Auto-generated by OpenTofu from 1Password
# DO NOT EDIT - changes will be overwritten

# Jellystat PostgreSQL credentials
JELLYSTAT_DB_PASSWORD=st4dnS0X75gJTlATNXYBWQawJ4OzYQ
JELLYSTAT_JWT_SECRET=69z87jUXLPJxIkao3EGXW8QF51ZTM5uSSucwJaw6I
EOT

  file_permission = "0600"
}

module "jellyfin" {
  source = "../../modules/docker-lxc"

  name         = "jellyfin"
  container_id = 401
  proxmox_node = var.proxmox_node

  # Network (dual-NIC: container network + LAN for DLNA/casting)
  container_ip = "${local.ip_registry.media.jellyfin}${local.network.container_netmask}"
  lan_ip       = "${local.lan_ips.jellyfin}${local.network.lan_netmask}"

  cores  = 4
  memory = 8192
  swap   = 2048

  rootfs_storage = "nvme-containers"
  rootfs_size    = 32

  # Unprivileged container (security hardened)
  unprivileged = true

  # Enable AMD GPU passthrough for hardware transcoding
  enable_gpu = true

  # Mount point for media library
  # This is configured via SSH (null_resource.configure_mount_points) since
  # the API token doesn't have permission for bind mounts (requires root@pam)
  mount_points = [
    {
      slot   = 0
      path   = "/data/library"
      volume = "/tank/data/library"
    }
  ]

  deploy_dir  = "${path.module}/deploy"
  target_path = "/config"

  ssh_public_key       = local.ssh_public_key
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path
  proxmox_ssh_host     = local.proxmox_ssh_host

  template = var.lxc_template_docker

  service_name        = "Jellyfin"
  service_description = "Media server for movies, TV shows, and music"

  service_urls = {
    internal = "https://jellyfin.${var.domain_internal}"
    public   = "https://jellyfin.${var.domain_public}"
    direct   = "http://${local.lan_ips.jellyfin}:8096"
  }

  services = [
    { name = "Jellyfin", port = 8096, info = "Media server UI" },
    { name = "Jellyseerr", port = 5055, info = "Media request management" },
    { name = "Jellystat", port = 3000, info = "Statistics dashboard" }
  ]

  custom_notes = <<-EOT
## Quick Commands
**View logs:** cd /config && docker compose logs -f jellyfin
**Restart:** cd /config && docker compose restart jellyfin
EOT

  tags = ["jellyfin", "media"]
}

module "jellyfin_route" {
  source = "../../modules/traefik-route"

  app_name    = "jellyfin"
  backend_url = "http://${module.jellyfin.ip_address}:8096"

  internal_domain = "jellyfin.${var.domain_internal}"
  public_domain   = "jellyfin.${var.domain_public}"

  traefik_host         = local.traefik_ip
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  internal_middlewares = ["security-headers"]
  public_middlewares   = ["security-headers"]

  depends_on = [module.jellyfin]
}

# Jellystat - Jellyfin statistics dashboard

  source = "../../modules/traefik-route"

  app_name    = "jellystat"
  backend_url = "http://${module.jellyfin.ip_address}:3000"

  internal_domain = "jellystat.${var.domain_internal}"

  traefik_host         = local.traefik_ip
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  # Has built-in auth, only need security headers and internal access
  internal_middlewares = ["security-headers", "internal-only"]

  depends_on = [module.jellyfin]
}

  public_domain   = "requests.${var.domain_public}"

  public_middlewares   = ["public-security"]

  depends_on = [module.jellyfin]

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "jellyfin_sidecars" {
  source = "../../modules/lxc-sidecars"

  container_id   = module.jellyfin.container_id
  container_ip   = module.jellyfin.ip_address
  container_name = "jellyfin"

  proxmox_ssh_host             = local.proxmox_ssh_host
  proxmox_ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  backup = {
    enabled   = true
    schedule  = "Sun 03:00"  # Weekly backup
    retention = "4"          # Keep 4 weekly backups
    namespace = "lxc-401"

    pre_backup_commands = [{
      name    = "PostgreSQL dump (Jellystat)"
      command = "docker exec jellystat-db pg_dump -U jellystat -d jellystat --clean --if-exists | gzip > /config/jellystat-db-backup.sql.gz"
      timeout = 300
    }]

    include_paths = ["/config", "/var/lib/docker/volumes"]
    exclude_paths = ["/var/lib/docker/overlay2"]

    ntfy_priority = "default"
    ntfy_tags     = "backup,jellyfin,jellystat"
    ntfy_user     = "pbs-backup"
    ntfy_password = local.op.ntfy_pbs_backup_password
  }

  # Container monitoring agents
  pulse_agent = {
    enabled     = true
    pulse_token = local.agent_tokens["jellyfin"].pulse_token
  }

  arcane_agent = {
    enabled         = true
    bootstrap_token = local.agent_tokens["jellyfin"].arcane_bootstrap_token
  }

  alloy_agent = {
    enabled  = true
    username = local.op.alloy_telemetry_username
    password = local.op.alloy_telemetry_password
  }

  depends_on = [module.jellyfin]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Outputs
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

output "container_id" { value = module.jellyfin.container_id }
output "ip_address" { value = module.jellyfin.ip_address }
output "ssh_command" { value = module.jellyfin.ssh_command }
output "urls" {
  value = {
    jellyfin  = { internal = module.jellyfin_route.internal_url, public = module.jellyfin_route.public_url }
    jellystat = { internal = module.jellystat_route.internal_url }
    requests  = { internal = module.requests_route.internal_url, public = module.requests_route.public_url }
  }
}

# =============================================================================
# Traefik LXC - Reverse Proxy & Ingress Controller
# =============================================================================
# Container ID: 200
#
# This deployment uses the docker-lxc module which handles:
#   1. LXC container creation with Docker pre-installed
#   2. File sync via rsync (file-sync module)
#   3. Docker Compose deployment
#   4. Proxmox notes generation
# =============================================================================

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# App-specific Variables
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

variable "container_id" {
  description = "Container ID for Traefik LXC"
  type        = number
  default     = 200
}

variable "cores" {
  description = "CPU cores"
  type        = number
  default     = 2
}

variable "memory" {
  description = "Memory in MB"
  type        = number
  default     = 2048
}

variable "swap" {
  description = "Swap in MB"
  type        = number
  default     = 1024
}

variable "rootfs_size" {
  description = "Root filesystem size in GB"
  type        = number
  default     = 8
}

variable "rootfs_storage" {
  description = "Storage pool for root filesystem"
  type        = string
  default     = "nvme-containers"
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Traefik Container
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "traefik" {
  source = "../../modules/docker-lxc"

  name         = "traefik"
  container_id = var.container_id
  proxmox_node = var.proxmox_node

  # Network (dual-NIC: container network + LAN for external access)
  container_ip = "${local.ip_registry.dashboards.traefik}${local.network.container_netmask}"
  lan_ip       = "${local.lan_ips.traefik}${local.network.lan_netmask}"

  # Resources
  cores  = var.cores
  memory = var.memory
  swap   = var.swap

  rootfs_storage = var.rootfs_storage
  rootfs_size    = var.rootfs_size

  # MUST be privileged for binding to ports 80/443
  unprivileged = false

  # Deployment
  deploy_dir  = "${path.module}/deploy"
  target_path = "/config"

  # Exclude migrated routes (managed by traefik-route module), env templates, and .tpl files
  exclude_patterns = ["^migrated-dynamic/", "^\\.env", "\\.tpl$"]

  # SSH
  ssh_public_key       = local.ssh_public_key
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path
  proxmox_ssh_host     = local.proxmox_ssh_host

  # Template with Docker pre-installed
  template = var.lxc_template_docker

  # Proxmox Notes
  service_name        = "Traefik"
  service_description = "Reverse proxy and ingress controller for all homelab services"

  service_urls = {
    dashboard_internal = "https://traefik.${var.domain_internal}/dashboard/"
    direct             = "http://${local.traefik_ip}:8080/dashboard/"
  }

  services = [
    { name = "HTTP", port = 80, info = "HTTP entrypoint (redirects to HTTPS)" },
    { name = "HTTPS", port = 443, info = "HTTPS entrypoint with Let's Encrypt" },
    { name = "Metrics", port = 8082, info = "Prometheus metrics endpoint" }
  ]

  custom_notes = file("${path.module}/notes.md")

  tags = ["traefik", "ingress", "reverse-proxy"]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Create .env file with secrets
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Generate .env file locally with secrets from 1Password, then sync to container

resource "local_sensitive_file" "traefik_env" {
  content = templatefile("${path.module}/deploy/.env.tpl", {
    cf_api_token = local.op.cloudflare_api_token
    cf_api_email = local.op.cloudflare_email
  })
  filename        = "${path.module}/.terraform/traefik.env"
  file_permission = "0600"
}

resource "filesync_file" "traefik_env" {
  source      = local_sensitive_file.traefik_env.filename
  destination = "/config/.env"
  host        = local.traefik_ip

  mode = "0600"

  depends_on = [module.traefik]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Alloy Auth Middleware (for Loki/Prometheus push endpoints)
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Creates authenticated endpoints for Alloy agents to push logs and metrics

resource "local_sensitive_file" "alloy_auth_config" {
  content = templatefile("${path.module}/deploy/dynamic/alloy-auth.yml.tpl", {
    htpasswd      = local.op.alloy_telemetry_htpasswd
    domain        = var.domain_internal
    monitoring_ip = local.ip_registry.monitoring.monitoring
  })
  filename        = "${path.module}/.terraform/alloy-auth.yml"
  file_permission = "0600"
}

resource "filesync_file" "alloy_auth_config" {
  source      = local_sensitive_file.alloy_auth_config.filename
  destination = "/config/dynamic/alloy-auth.yml"
  host        = local.traefik_ip

  mode = "0644"

  depends_on = [module.traefik]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Backup Configuration - PBS Client
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "traefik_sidecars" {
  source = "../../modules/lxc-sidecars"

  container_id   = module.traefik.container_id
  container_ip   = module.traefik.ip_address
  container_name = "traefik"

  proxmox_ssh_host             = local.proxmox_ssh_host
  proxmox_ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  backup = {
    enabled   = true
    schedule  = "Sun 03:00"  # Weekly backup
    retention = "4"          # Keep 4 weekly backups
    namespace = "lxc-200"

    pre_backup_commands = []  # No database - config only

    include_paths = ["/config"]
    exclude_paths = ["/config/acme.json", "/config/logs/**"]

    ntfy_priority = "default"
    ntfy_tags     = "backup,traefik"
    ntfy_user     = "pbs-backup"
    ntfy_password = local.op.ntfy_pbs_backup_password
  }

  # Container monitoring agents
  pulse_agent = {
    enabled     = true
    pulse_token = local.agent_tokens["traefik"].pulse_token
  }

  arcane_agent = {
    enabled         = true
    bootstrap_token = local.agent_tokens["traefik"].arcane_bootstrap_token
  }

  alloy_agent = {
    enabled  = true
    username = local.op.alloy_telemetry_username
    password = local.op.alloy_telemetry_password
  }

  depends_on = [module.traefik]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Outputs
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

output "container_id" {
  value = module.traefik.container_id
}

output "ip_address" {
  value = module.traefik.ip_address
}

output "ssh_command" {
  value = module.traefik.ssh_command
}

output "urls" {
  value = {
    dashboard_internal = "https://traefik.${var.domain_internal}/dashboard/"
  }
}

# =============================================================================
# OpenWebUI LXC - AI Chat Interface with llama.cpp
# =============================================================================
# Container ID: 501
#
# Uses the docker-lxc module - the gold standard pattern for Docker apps.
# Features Vulkan GPU acceleration for llama.cpp (AMD Radeon 890M gfx1150).
#
# Benchmarked performance (Vulkan vs ROCm vs CPU):
#   - Vulkan: ~800 tok/s prompt, ~40 tok/s generation (WINNER)
#   - ROCm:   ~30 tok/s prompt,  ~29 tok/s generation
#   - CPU:    ~28 tok/s prompt,  ~28 tok/s generation
# =============================================================================

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Variables
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

variable "container_id" {
  type    = number
  default = 501
}

variable "cores" {
  type    = number
  default = 12
}

variable "memory" {
  type    = number
  default = 24576
}

variable "rootfs_size" {
  type    = number
  default = 64
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# OpenWebUI Container
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "openwebui" {
  source = "../../modules/docker-lxc"

  name         = "openwebui"
  container_id = var.container_id
  proxmox_node = var.proxmox_node

  # Network (container network only)
  container_ip = "${local.ip_registry.monitoring.openwebui}${local.network.container_netmask}"

  # Resources
  cores  = var.cores
  memory = var.memory
  swap   = 2048

  rootfs_storage = "nvme-containers"
  rootfs_size    = var.rootfs_size

  # Unprivileged for security (with GPU passthrough)
  unprivileged = true
  enable_gpu   = true

  # Mount points - LLM models on ZFS tank for unlimited storage
  mount_points = [
    {
      slot   = 0
      path   = "/llm-models"
      volume = "/tank/llm-models"
    }
  ]

  # Deployment
  deploy_dir  = "${path.module}/deploy"
  target_path = "/config"

  # Make download script executable
  file_permissions = {
    "/config/download-model.sh" = "0755"
  }

  # SSH
  ssh_public_key       = local.ssh_public_key
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path
  proxmox_ssh_host     = local.proxmox_ssh_host

  # Template with Docker pre-installed
  template = var.lxc_template_docker

  # Proxmox Notes
  service_name        = "OpenWebUI"
  service_description = "AI chat interface with llama.cpp backend (Vulkan GPU accelerated)"

  service_urls = {
    internal = "https://ai.${var.domain_internal}"
    direct   = "http://${local.lan_ips.openwebui}:3000"
  }

  services = [
    { name = "OpenWebUI", port = 3000, info = "AI chat interface" },
    { name = "llama-server", port = 8080, info = "LLM backend (Vulkan GPU)" }
  ]

  custom_notes = <<-EOT
## GPU Acceleration

AMD Radeon 890M (gfx1150) via Vulkan/RADV:
- `/dev/dri` device passthrough
- ~40 tok/s generation, ~800 tok/s prompt processing

**Check GPU detection:**
```
docker logs llama-server 2>&1 | grep -i vulkan
```

## Quick Commands

**View logs:**
```
cd /config && docker compose logs -f openwebui
cd /config && docker compose logs -f llama-server
```

**Test inference:**
```
curl -s http://localhost:8080/v1/chat/completions \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"llama-3.2-3b","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Hello"}]}'
```

**Download new model (GGUF format):**
```
cd /llm-models
curl -L -O "https://huggingface.co/bartowski/MODEL/resolve/main/MODEL.gguf"
```

Models are stored on ZFS tank (`/tank/llm-models` → `/llm-models`).

## Managed by OpenTofu

Run `task tofu:apply APP=openwebui` to update.
EOT

  tags = ["openwebui", "ai", "llama-cpp", "llm"]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Create .env file with secrets
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Generate .env file locally with secrets, then sync to container

resource "local_sensitive_file" "openwebui_env" {
  content = templatefile("${path.module}/deploy/.env.tpl", {
    webui_secret_key    = random_password.openwebui_secret_key.result
    oauth_client_id     = authentik_provider_oauth2.openwebui.client_id
    oauth_client_secret = random_password.openwebui_oidc_secret.result
    openid_provider_url = "https://auth.${var.domain_public}/application/o/openwebui/.well-known/openid-configuration"
  })
  filename        = "${path.module}/.terraform/openwebui.env"
  file_permission = "0600"
}

resource "filesync_file" "openwebui_env" {
  source      = local_sensitive_file.openwebui_env.filename
  destination = "/config/.env"
  host        = module.openwebui.ip_address

  mode = "0600"

  depends_on = [module.openwebui]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Backup Configuration - PBS Client
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "openwebui_sidecars" {
  source = "../../modules/lxc-sidecars"

  container_id   = module.openwebui.container_id
  container_ip   = module.openwebui.ip_address
  container_name = "openwebui"

  proxmox_ssh_host             = local.proxmox_ssh_host
  proxmox_ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  backup = {
    enabled   = true
    schedule  = "daily"
    retention = "7"
    namespace = "lxc-501"

    pre_backup_commands = []  # No database dump needed - SQLite file backup is sufficient

    include_paths = ["/config"]
    exclude_paths = ["/var/lib/docker/overlay2"]  # Models are on /tank, not backed up here

    ntfy_priority = "default"
    ntfy_tags     = "backup,openwebui"
    ntfy_user     = "pbs-backup"
    ntfy_password = local.op.ntfy_pbs_backup_password
  }

  # Container monitoring agents
  pulse_agent = {
    enabled     = true
    pulse_token = local.agent_tokens["openwebui"].pulse_token
  }

  arcane_agent = {
    enabled         = true
    bootstrap_token = local.agent_tokens["openwebui"].arcane_bootstrap_token
  }

  alloy_agent = {
    enabled  = true
    username = local.op.alloy_telemetry_username
    password = local.op.alloy_telemetry_password
  }

  depends_on = [module.openwebui]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Traefik Routes - Self-Service Route Registration
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

# OpenWebUI (AI Chat Interface)
module "openwebui_route" {
  source = "../../modules/traefik-route"

  app_name    = "openwebui"
  backend_url = "http://${module.openwebui.ip_address}:3000"

  # Internal and public routes (HTTPS via Let's Encrypt)
  internal_domain = "ai.${var.domain_internal}"
  public_domain   = "ai.${var.domain_public}"

  # Traefik config
  traefik_host         = local.traefik_ip
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  # Middlewares
  internal_middlewares = ["security-headers"]
  public_middlewares   = ["security-headers"]

  depends_on = [module.openwebui]
}

# llama.cpp API (LLM Backend - OpenAI compatible)
module "llama_route" {
  source = "../../modules/traefik-route"

  app_name    = "llama"
  backend_url = "http://${module.openwebui.ip_address}:8080"

  # Internal only (OpenAI-compatible API access)
  internal_domain = "llama.${var.domain_internal}"

  # Traefik config
  traefik_host         = local.traefik_ip
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  # Middlewares - Basic auth for API access
  internal_middlewares = ["security-headers", "llama-auth"]

  depends_on = [module.openwebui]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Outputs
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

output "container_id" {
  value = module.openwebui.container_id
}

output "ip_address" {
  value = module.openwebui.ip_address
}

output "ssh_command" {
  value = module.openwebui.ssh_command
}

output "urls" {
  value = {
    openwebui = {
      internal = module.openwebui_route.internal_url
      public   = module.openwebui_route.public_url
      direct   = "http://${module.openwebui.ip_address}:3000"
    }
    llama = {
      internal = module.llama_route.internal_url
      direct   = "http://${module.openwebui.ip_address}:8080"
    }
  }
}

output "traefik_config_paths" {
  description = "Paths to Traefik configs on Traefik LXC"
  value = {
    openwebui = module.openwebui_route.remote_config_path
    llama     = module.llama_route.remote_config_path
  }
}

# =============================================================================
# Network Services LXC - AdGuard + Cloudflared + DDNS
# =============================================================================
# Container ID: 101
#
# Core network infrastructure: DNS (AdGuard Home), Cloudflare tunnel, DDNS.
# Tailscale runs as systemd service (requires kernel access).
# =============================================================================

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Variables
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

variable "container_id" {
  type    = number
  default = 101
}

variable "cores" {
  type    = number
  default = 2
}

variable "memory" {
  type    = number
  default = 2048
}

variable "rootfs_size" {
  type    = number
  default = 4
}

variable "cloudflare_ddns_domains" {
  type    = string
  default = "homelab.rambtech.dev"
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Network Services Container
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "network_services" {
  source = "../../modules/docker-lxc"

  name         = "network-services"
  container_id = var.container_id
  proxmox_node = var.proxmox_node

  # Network (dual-NIC: container network + LAN for DNS service)
  container_ip = "${local.ip_registry.core.network_services}${local.network.container_netmask}"
  lan_ip       = "${local.lan_ips.network_services}${local.network.lan_netmask}"

  # Resources
  cores  = var.cores
  memory = var.memory
  swap   = 1024

  rootfs_storage = "nvme-containers"
  rootfs_size    = var.rootfs_size

  # Privileged for Tailscale kernel access
  unprivileged = false

  # Deployment
  deploy_dir  = "${path.module}/deploy"
  target_path = "/config"

  # Exclude AdGuard config - managed separately via templating for dns_mode toggle
  exclude_patterns = ["AdGuardHome\\.yaml$", "\\.tpl$"]

  # SSH
  ssh_public_key       = local.ssh_public_key
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path
  proxmox_ssh_host     = local.proxmox_ssh_host

  # Template
  template = var.lxc_template_docker

  # Proxmox Notes
  service_name        = "Network Services"
  service_description = "Core network infrastructure: DNS, tunnels, and VPN"

  service_urls = {
    adguard_internal = "https://dns.${var.domain_internal}"
    adguard_direct   = "http://${local.lan_ips.network_services}:3000"
  }

  services = [
    { name = "AdGuard Home", port = 53, info = "DNS server with ad blocking" },
    { name = "AdGuard UI", port = 3000, info = "Web management interface" },
    { name = "Cloudflared", port = 0, info = "Cloudflare tunnel (outbound only)" },
    { name = "Tailscale", port = 41641, info = "Mesh VPN (systemd service)" }
  ]

  custom_notes = <<-EOT
## Tailscale Management

Tailscale runs as a systemd service (not Docker) because it requires kernel-level network access.

**Check status:**
```bash
systemctl status tailscaled
tailscale status
```

**Restart if needed:**
```bash
systemctl restart tailscaled
```

## Docker Services

**View logs:**
```bash
cd /config && docker compose logs -f <service>
```

**Restart all services:**
```bash
cd /config && docker compose restart
```

## DNS Testing

**Test AdGuard (port 53):**
```bash
dig @${local.lan_ips.network_services} google.com
```

**Test internal DNS rewrites:**
```bash
dig @${local.lan_ips.network_services} traefik.homelab.rambtech.dev
```

## Managed by OpenTofu

Run `task tofu:apply APP=network-services` to update.
EOT

  tags = ["network-services", "dns", "adguard", "cloudflare"]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Create .env file with secrets
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Generate .env file locally with secrets from 1Password, then sync to container

resource "local_sensitive_file" "network_services_env" {
  content = <<-EOT
# Network Services Environment Variables
# Auto-generated by OpenTofu from 1Password
# DO NOT EDIT - changes will be overwritten

# Cloudflare Tunnel Token
CLOUDFLARE_TUNNEL_TOKEN=${local.op.cloudflare_tunnel_token}

# Cloudflare API Token for DDNS
CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN=${local.op.cloudflare_api_token}

# Domains to update with DDNS
CLOUDFLARE_DDNS_DOMAINS=${var.cloudflare_ddns_domains}
EOT

  filename        = "${path.module}/.terraform/network-services.env"
  file_permission = "0600"
}

resource "filesync_file" "network_services_env" {
  source      = local_sensitive_file.network_services_env.filename
  destination = "/config/.env"
  host        = module.network_services.ip_address

  mode = "0600"

  depends_on = [module.network_services]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# AdGuard Home Configuration (DNS Mode Toggle)
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Generates AdGuard config based on dns_mode variable:
# - home: Uses LAN IPs (192.168.1.x) - works on home network without Tailscale
# - travel: Uses container IPs (10.100.x.x) - routes through Tailscale, avoids subnet conflicts

locals {
  # Select IP based on dns_mode
  adguard_traefik_ip = var.dns_mode == "travel" ? local.ip_registry.dashboards.traefik : local.lan_ips.traefik
}

resource "local_file" "adguard_config" {
  content = templatefile("${path.module}/deploy/adguard/conf/AdGuardHome.yaml.tpl", {
    dns_mode   = var.dns_mode
    traefik_ip = local.adguard_traefik_ip
  })

  filename        = "${path.module}/.terraform/AdGuardHome.yaml"
  file_permission = "0644"
}

resource "filesync_file" "adguard_config" {
  source      = local_file.adguard_config.filename
  destination = "/config/adguard/conf/AdGuardHome.yaml"
  host        = module.network_services.ip_address

  mode = "0644"

  depends_on = [module.network_services]
}

# Restart AdGuard when config changes
resource "null_resource" "restart_adguard" {
  triggers = {
    config_hash = local_file.adguard_config.content_md5
  }

  provisioner "remote-exec" {
    inline = [
      "docker restart adguard || true"
    ]

    connection {
      type        = "ssh"
      user        = "root"
      host        = module.network_services.ip_address
      private_key = file(var.ssh_private_key_path)
    }
  }

  depends_on = [filesync_file.adguard_config]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Tailscale Service Management via Ansible
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Ensures Tailscale daemon is running and connected after deployment

resource "ansible_navigator_run" "manage_tailscale" {
  depends_on = [module.network_services]

  # Re-run when container is rebuilt or network config changes
  triggers = {
    container_id = var.container_id
    lan_ip       = local.lan_ips.network_services
  }

  execution_environment = {
    enabled = false  # Run ansible directly on host
  }

  ansible_options = {
    private_keys = [{
      name = "homelab"
      data = file(var.ssh_private_key_path)
    }]
  }

  playbook = <<-EOT
    - name: Manage Tailscale service on network-services
      hosts: lxc
      gather_facts: no
      vars:
        app_name: network-services

      tasks:
        # =====================================================================
        # Tailscale Service Management
        # =====================================================================
        - name: Ensure Tailscale daemon is running
          ansible.builtin.systemd:
            name: tailscaled
            state: started
            enabled: true
          register: tailscale_service

        - name: Wait for Tailscale to initialize
          ansible.builtin.pause:
            seconds: 3
          when: tailscale_service.changed

        # =====================================================================
        # Verify Tailscale Status
        # =====================================================================
        - name: Check Tailscale connection status
          ansible.builtin.command:
            cmd: tailscale status --json
          register: tailscale_status
          changed_when: false
          failed_when: false

        - name: Parse Tailscale status
          ansible.builtin.set_fact:
            tailscale_info: "{{ tailscale_status.stdout | from_json }}"
          when: tailscale_status.rc == 0

        - name: Display Tailscale connection info
          ansible.builtin.debug:
            msg: |
              Tailscale Status: {{ 'Connected' if (tailscale_info.BackendState | default('')) == 'Running' else 'Not Connected' }}
              Tailnet IP: {{ tailscale_info.Self.TailscaleIPs[0] | default('N/A') }}
              Hostname: {{ tailscale_info.Self.HostName | default('N/A') }}
          when: tailscale_status.rc == 0

        - name: Warn if Tailscale not connected
          ansible.builtin.debug:
            msg: "WARNING: Tailscale is not connected. Check authentication status with 'tailscale status'"
          when: tailscale_status.rc != 0 or (tailscale_info.BackendState | default('')) != 'Running'
  EOT

  inventory = yamlencode({
    lxc = {
      hosts = {
        "network-services" = {
          ansible_host = module.network_services.ip_address
          ansible_user = "root"
        }
      }
    }
  })
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Traefik Route for AdGuard Home UI
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "adguard_route" {
  source = "../../modules/traefik-route"

  app_name    = "dns"
  backend_url = "http://${module.network_services.ip_address}:3000"

  internal_domain = "dns.${var.domain_internal}"
  public_domain   = ""  # DNS admin UI should not be public

  traefik_host         = local.traefik_ip

}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "network_services_sidecars" {
  source = "../../modules/lxc-sidecars"

  container_id   = module.network_services.container_id
  container_ip   = module.network_services.ip_address
  container_name = "network-services"

  proxmox_ssh_host             = local.proxmox_ssh_host
  proxmox_ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

    schedule  = "Sun 03:00"  # Weekly backup
    retention = "4"          # Keep 4 weekly backups
    namespace = "lxc-101"

    pre_backup_commands = []  # No database - config only

    include_paths = ["/config"]
    exclude_paths = ["/var/lib/docker/overlay2"]

    ntfy_priority = "default"
    ntfy_tags     = "backup,network-services"
    ntfy_user     = "pbs-backup"
    ntfy_password = local.op.ntfy_pbs_backup_password
  }

  # Container monitoring agents
  pulse_agent = {
    enabled     = true
    pulse_token = local.agent_tokens["network-services"].pulse_token
  }

  arcane_agent = {
    enabled         = true
    bootstrap_token = local.agent_tokens["network-services"].arcane_bootstrap_token
  }

  alloy_agent = {
    enabled  = true
    username = local.op.alloy_telemetry_username
    password = local.op.alloy_telemetry_password
  }

  depends_on = [module.network_services]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Outputs
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

output "container_id" {
  value = module.network_services.container_id
}

output "ip_address" {
  value = module.network_services.ip_address
}

output "ssh_command" {
  value = module.network_services.ssh_command
}

output "urls" {
  value = {
    adguard_internal = module.adguard_route.internal_url
  }
}

output "traefik_config_path" {
  value = module.adguard_route.remote_config_path
}

output "dns_mode" {
  description = "Current DNS mode (home=LAN IPs, travel=container IPs for Tailscale)"
  value       = var.dns_mode
}

# Immich LXC - Photo & Video Management
# =============================================================================
# Container ID: 304
#
# Self-hosted photo and video management with ML features and GPU acceleration.
# =============================================================================

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Generate .env file with Immich credentials
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

resource "local_sensitive_file" "immich_env" {
  filename = "${path.module}/deploy/.env"
  content  = <<-EOT
# Immich Configuration
# Auto-generated by OpenTofu from 1Password
# DO NOT EDIT - changes will be overwritten
# https://immich.app/docs/install/environment-variables

# Paths - these match the LXC mount points from main.tf
UPLOAD_LOCATION=/photos
DB_DATA_LOCATION=/var/lib/postgresql/data

# Version - use 'release' for latest stable
IMMICH_VERSION=release

# Database credentials
DB_PASSWORD=qjIYvd2gOMh71CBpgA
DB_USERNAME=postgres
DB_DATABASE_NAME=immich

# Timezone
TZ=America/New_York

# OpenTelemetry - push metrics to monitoring stack
OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT=http://10.100.5.100:4318
OTEL_SERVICE_NAME=immich
IMMICH_TELEMETRY_INCLUDE=all
EOT

  file_permission = "0600"
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Variables
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

variable "container_id" {
  type    = number
  default = 304
}

variable "cores" {
  type    = number
  default = 6
}

variable "memory" {
  type    = number
  default = 6144
}

variable "rootfs_size" {
  type    = number
  default = 32
}

# Cloud backup schedule (default: Wed and Sun at 3:00 AM)
variable "cloud_backup_schedule" {
  type    = string
  default = "0 3 * * 0,3"
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Immich Container
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "immich" {
  source = "../../modules/docker-lxc"

  name         = "immich-docker"
  container_id = var.container_id
  proxmox_node = var.proxmox_node

  # Network (dual-NIC: container network + LAN for mobile app)
  container_ip = "${local.ip_registry.photos.immich}${local.network.container_netmask}"
  lan_ip       = "${local.lan_ips.immich}${local.network.lan_netmask}"

  # Resources
  cores  = var.cores
  memory = var.memory
  swap   = 2048

  rootfs_storage = "nvme-containers"
  rootfs_size    = var.rootfs_size

  # Unprivileged container (security hardened)
  unprivileged = true

  # Enable AMD GPU passthrough for ML acceleration and video transcoding
  enable_gpu = true

  # Mount points for photos and cache
  # These are configured via SSH (null_resource.configure_mount_points) since
  # the API token doesn't have permission for bind mounts (requires root@pam)
  mount_points = [
    {
      slot   = 0
      path   = "/photos"
      volume = "/tank/photos"
    },
    {
      slot   = 1
      path   = "/cache"
      volume = "/tank/cache/immich"
    }
  ]

  # Deployment
  deploy_dir  = "${path.module}/deploy"
  target_path = "/config"

  # SSH
  ssh_public_key       = local.ssh_public_key
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path
  proxmox_ssh_host     = local.proxmox_ssh_host

  # Template with Docker pre-installed
  template = var.lxc_template_docker

  # Proxmox Notes
  service_name        = "Immich"
  service_description = "Self-hosted photo and video management with ML features"

  service_urls = {
    internal = "https://photos.${var.domain_internal}"
    public   = "https://photos.${var.domain_public}"
    direct   = "http://${local.lan_ips.immich}:2283"
  }

  services = [
    { name = "Immich Web", port = 2283, info = "Photo management UI" },
    { name = "Immich Server", port = 2283, info = "API server" },
    { name = "Immich ML", port = 3003, info = "Machine learning service" },
    { name = "PostgreSQL", port = 5432, info = "Database" },
    { name = "Redis", port = 6379, info = "Cache" }
  ]

  custom_notes = <<-EOT
## Storage

**Photos:** `/photos` (mounted from `/tank/photos`)
**Cache:** `/cache` (mounted from `/tank/cache/immich`)
**Database:** Docker volumes (immich_pgdata)

## GPU Acceleration

AMD Radeon 890M passed through for ML acceleration:
- `/dev/dri/card0` - GPU device
- `/dev/dri/renderD128` - Render device

**Check GPU access:**
```bash
ls -la /dev/dri/
docker exec immich_machine_learning rocminfo
```

## Quick Commands

**View logs:**
```bash
cd /config && docker compose logs -f immich_server
```

**Restart all services:**
```bash
cd /config && docker compose restart
```

**Force reprocess ML jobs:**
```bash
docker exec -it immich_server npm run cli -- jobs run all
```

## Database Backup

PBS backup runs pre-backup hook to dump PostgreSQL.
Manual backup:
```bash
cd /config && docker compose exec -T postgres pg_dumpall -U postgres > backup.sql
```

## Managed by OpenTofu

Run `task tofu:apply APP=immich` to update.
EOT

  tags = ["photos", "immich", "media"]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Backup Configuration - PBS Client
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "immich_sidecars" {
  source = "../../modules/lxc-sidecars"

  container_id   = module.immich.container_id
  container_ip   = module.immich.ip_address
  container_name = "immich-docker"

  proxmox_ssh_host             = local.proxmox_ssh_host
  proxmox_ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  backup = {
    enabled   = true
    schedule  = "daily"
    retention = "7"
    namespace = "lxc-304"

    pre_backup_commands = [{
      name    = "PostgreSQL dump"
      command = "docker exec immich_postgres pg_dump -U postgres -d immich --clean --if-exists | gzip > /config/immich-db-backup.sql.gz"
      timeout = 600
    }]

    include_paths = ["/config", "/var/lib/docker/volumes"]
    exclude_paths = ["/var/lib/docker/overlay2", "/cache/**"]

    ntfy_priority = "high"
    ntfy_tags     = "backup,immich,rotating_light"
    ntfy_user     = "pbs-backup"
    ntfy_password = local.op.ntfy_pbs_backup_password
  }

  # Container monitoring agents
  pulse_agent = {
    enabled     = true
    pulse_token = local.agent_tokens["immich"].pulse_token
  }

  arcane_agent = {
    enabled         = true
    bootstrap_token = local.agent_tokens["immich"].arcane_bootstrap_token
  }

  alloy_agent = {
    enabled  = true
    username = local.op.alloy_telemetry_username
    password = local.op.alloy_telemetry_password
  }

  depends_on = [module.immich]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Cloud Backup - rclone to Backblaze B2
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Generate rclone config from 1Password secrets
resource "local_sensitive_file" "rclone_conf" {
  filename = "${path.module}/.tmp/rclone.conf"
  content  = <<-CONF
[b2]
type = b2
account = ${local.op.b2_account_id}
key = ${local.op.b2_application_key}
hard_delete = true

[b2-crypt]
type = crypt
remote = b2:rambtech-homelab/photos-encrypted
password = ${local.op.rclone_crypt_password}
password2 = ${local.op.rclone_crypt_password2}
CONF
}

# Install rclone via Ansible
resource "ansible_navigator_run" "install_rclone" {
  depends_on = [module.immich]

  triggers = {
    container_id = var.container_id
  }

  execution_environment = {
    enabled = false
  }

  ansible_options = {
    private_keys = [{
      name = "homelab"
      data = file(var.ssh_private_key_path)
    }]
  }

  playbook = <<-EOT
    - name: Install rclone for cloud backup
      hosts: lxc
      gather_facts: no

      tasks:
        - name: Install required packages
          ansible.builtin.apt:
            name:
              - unzip
              - curl
              - cron
            state: present
            update_cache: yes
            cache_valid_time: 3600

        - name: Check if rclone is installed
          ansible.builtin.command:
            cmd: which rclone
          register: rclone_check
          changed_when: false
          failed_when: false

        - name: Install rclone
          ansible.builtin.shell:
            cmd: curl -fsSL https://rclone.org/install.sh | bash
          when: rclone_check.rc != 0

        - name: Create rclone config directory
          ansible.builtin.file:
            path: /root/.config/rclone
            state: directory
            mode: '0700'
  EOT

  inventory = yamlencode({
    lxc = {
      hosts = {
        "immich" = {
          ansible_host = module.immich.ip_address
          ansible_user = "root"
        }
      }
    }
  })
}

# Deploy rclone config
resource "filesync_file" "rclone_conf" {
  source      = local_sensitive_file.rclone_conf.filename
  destination = "/root/.config/rclone/rclone.conf"
  host        = module.immich.ip_address

  mode         = "0600"
  ssh_user     = "root"
  ssh_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  depends_on = [ansible_navigator_run.install_rclone]
}

# Deploy cloud-sync script
resource "filesync_file" "cloud_sync_script" {
  source      = "${path.module}/deploy/cloud-sync.sh"
  destination = "/usr/local/bin/cloud-sync.sh"
  host        = module.immich.ip_address

  mode         = "0755"
  ssh_user     = "root"
  ssh_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  depends_on = [ansible_navigator_run.install_rclone]
}

# Configure cron job for cloud backup
resource "ansible_navigator_run" "configure_cloud_cron" {
  depends_on = [
    filesync_file.cloud_sync_script,
    filesync_file.rclone_conf
  ]

  triggers = {
    container_id   = var.container_id
    cloud_schedule = var.cloud_backup_schedule
  }

  execution_environment = {
    enabled = false
  }

  ansible_options = {
    private_keys = [{
      name = "homelab"
      data = file(var.ssh_private_key_path)
    }]
  }

  playbook = <<-EOT
    - name: Configure cloud backup cron job
      hosts: lxc
      gather_facts: no
      vars:
        cloud_schedule: "${var.cloud_backup_schedule}"

      tasks:
        - name: Add cloud backup cron job (B2 sync)
          ansible.builtin.cron:
            name: "Cloud backup photos to B2"
            minute: "{{ cloud_schedule.split()[0] }}"
            hour: "{{ cloud_schedule.split()[1] }}"
            day: "{{ cloud_schedule.split()[2] }}"
            month: "{{ cloud_schedule.split()[3] }}"
            weekday: "{{ cloud_schedule.split()[4] }}"
            job: "/usr/local/bin/cloud-sync.sh photos >> /var/log/cloud-sync-photos.log 2>&1"
            user: root

        - name: Ensure cron service is enabled and running
          ansible.builtin.systemd:
            name: cron
            enabled: yes
            state: started

        - name: Display cron configuration
          ansible.builtin.debug:
            msg: "Cloud backup configured: {{ cloud_schedule }}"
  EOT

  inventory = yamlencode({
    lxc = {
      hosts = {
        "immich" = {
          ansible_host = module.immich.ip_address
          ansible_user = "root"
        }
      }
    }
  })
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Traefik Routes - Self-Service Route Registration
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "immich_route" {
  source = "../../modules/traefik-route"

  app_name    = "photos"
  backend_url = "http://${module.immich.ip_address}:2283"

  internal_domain = "photos.${var.domain_internal}"
  public_domain   = "photos.${var.domain_public}"

  traefik_host         = local.traefik_ip
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  depends_on = [module.immich]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Outputs
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

output "container_id" {
  value = module.immich.container_id
}

output "ip_address" {
  value = module.immich.ip_address
}

output "ssh_command" {
  value = module.immich.ssh_command
}

output "urls" {
  value = {
    internal = module.immich_route.internal_url
    public   = module.immich_route.public_url
  }
}

output "traefik_config_path" {
  value = module.immich_route.remote_config_path
}

output "cloud_backup_schedule" {
  description = "Cloud backup cron schedule (to Backblaze B2)"
  value       = var.cloud_backup_schedule
}
