# =============================================================================
# Documents LXC - Paperless-ngx + Stirling-PDF
# =============================================================================
# Container ID: 504
# IP: 10.100.5.104
#
# Document management stack:
# - Paperless-ngx: OCR, full-text search, auto-tagging, email consumption
# - Stirling-PDF: PDF manipulation (merge, split, compress, convert, etc.)
# =============================================================================

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1Password - Paperless Secrets
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

data "onepassword_item" "paperless" {
  vault = data.onepassword_vault.homelab.uuid
  title = "paperless"
}

locals {
  # Flatten paperless section fields into a map by label
  _paperless_section_fields = merge([
    for s in try(data.onepassword_item.paperless.section, []) : {
      for f in try(s.field, []) : f.label => f.value
    }
  ]...)

  paperless = {
    admin_user     = try(data.onepassword_item.paperless.username, "admin")
    admin_password = try(data.onepassword_item.paperless.password, "")
    db_password    = lookup(local._paperless_section_fields, "db_password", "")
    secret_key     = lookup(local._paperless_section_fields, "secret_key", "")
  }
}

# Generate the .env file from 1Password secrets + OIDC config
resource "local_sensitive_file" "documents_env" {
  filename = "${path.module}/deploy/.env"
  content  = <<-EOT
# Documents Stack Environment
# Auto-generated by OpenTofu from 1Password
# DO NOT EDIT - changes will be overwritten

# Paperless-ngx
PAPERLESS_ADMIN_USER=${local.paperless.admin_user}
PAPERLESS_ADMIN_PASSWORD=${local.paperless.admin_password}
PAPERLESS_DB_PASSWORD=${local.paperless.db_password}
PAPERLESS_SECRET_KEY=${local.paperless.secret_key}

# OAuth/OIDC via Authentik (django-allauth)
PAPERLESS_SOCIALACCOUNT_PROVIDERS=${jsonencode({
    openid_connect = {
      APPS = [{
        provider_id = "authentik"
        name        = "Authentik"
        client_id   = authentik_provider_oauth2.paperless.client_id
        secret      = random_password.paperless_oidc_secret.result
        settings = {
          server_url = "https://auth.${var.domain_public}/application/o/paperless/"
        }
      }]
      OAUTH_PKCE_ENABLED = "True"
    }
  })}
EOT

  file_permission = "0600"
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Variables
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

variable "container_id" {
  type    = number
  default = 504
}

variable "cores" {
  type    = number
  default = 4  # OCR is CPU intensive
}

variable "memory" {
  type    = number
  default = 8192  # OCR needs memory
}

variable "swap" {
  type    = number
  default = 2048
}

variable "rootfs_size" {
  type    = number
  default = 64  # Documents can grow large
}

# Cloud backup schedule (default: Wed and Sun at 3:30 AM, after photos backup)
variable "cloud_backup_schedule" {
  type    = string
  default = "30 3 * * 0,3"
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Documents Container
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "documents" {
  source = "../../modules/docker-lxc"

  name         = "documents"
  container_id = var.container_id
  proxmox_node = var.proxmox_node

  # Network (container network only)
  container_ip = "${local.ip_registry.monitoring.documents}${local.network.container_netmask}"

  # Resources
  cores  = var.cores
  memory = var.memory
  swap   = var.swap

  rootfs_storage = "nvme-containers"
  rootfs_size    = var.rootfs_size

  # Unprivileged container (security hardened)
  unprivileged = true

  # Deployment
  deploy_dir  = "${path.module}/deploy"
  target_path = "/config"

  # Ensure .env is generated before file sync
  depends_on = [local_sensitive_file.documents_env]

  # SSH
  ssh_public_key       = local.ssh_public_key
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path
  proxmox_ssh_host     = local.proxmox_ssh_host

  # Template with Docker pre-installed
  template = var.lxc_template_docker

  # Proxmox Notes
  service_name        = "Documents"
  service_description = "Document management with Paperless-ngx (OCR) and Stirling-PDF (utilities)"

  service_urls = {
    paperless_internal    = "https://docs.${var.domain_internal}"
    paperless_public      = "https://docs.${var.domain_public}"
    stirling_pdf_internal = "https://pdf.${var.domain_internal}"
    stirling_pdf_public   = "https://pdf.${var.domain_public}"
  }

  services = [
    { name = "Paperless-ngx", port = 8000, info = "Document management with OCR" },
    { name = "Stirling-PDF", port = 8080, info = "PDF manipulation tools" },
    { name = "PostgreSQL", port = 5432, info = "Paperless database (internal)" },
    { name = "Redis", port = 6379, info = "Paperless cache (internal)" }
  ]

  custom_notes = <<-EOT
## Quick Commands

**View logs:**
```
cd /config && docker compose logs -f paperless
cd /config && docker compose logs -f stirling-pdf
```

**Restart services:**
```
cd /config && docker compose restart paperless
cd /config && docker compose restart stirling-pdf
```

**Import documents:**
Place files in `/config/consume/` - they'll be automatically imported.

**Export all documents:**
```
cd /config && docker compose exec paperless document_exporter ../export/
```

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Backup Configuration - PBS Client
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "documents_sidecars" {
  source = "../../modules/lxc-sidecars"

  container_id   = module.documents.container_id
  container_ip   = module.documents.ip_address
  container_name = "documents"

  proxmox_ssh_host             = local.proxmox_ssh_host
  proxmox_ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  backup = {
    enabled   = true
    schedule  = "daily"
    retention = "7"
    namespace = "lxc-504"

    pre_backup_commands = [{
      name    = "PostgreSQL dump (Paperless)"
      command = "docker exec paperless-db pg_dump -U paperless -d paperless --clean --if-exists | gzip > /config/paperless-db-backup.sql.gz"
      timeout = 300
    }]

    include_paths = ["/config", "/var/lib/docker/volumes"]
    exclude_paths = ["/var/lib/docker/overlay2"]

    ntfy_priority = "default"
    ntfy_tags     = "backup,documents,paperless"
    ntfy_user     = "pbs-backup"
    ntfy_password = local.op.ntfy_pbs_backup_password
  }

  # Container monitoring agents
  pulse_agent = {
    enabled     = true
    pulse_token = local.agent_tokens["documents"].pulse_token
  }

  arcane_agent = {
    enabled         = true
    bootstrap_token = local.agent_tokens["documents"].arcane_bootstrap_token
  }

  alloy_agent = {
    enabled  = true
    username = local.op.alloy_telemetry_username
    password = local.op.alloy_telemetry_password
  }

  depends_on = [module.documents]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Cloud Backup - rclone to Backblaze B2
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Generate rclone config from 1Password secrets
resource "local_sensitive_file" "rclone_conf" {
  filename = "${path.module}/.tmp/rclone.conf"
  content  = <<-CONF
[b2]
type = b2
account = ${local.op.b2_account_id}
key = ${local.op.b2_application_key}
hard_delete = true

[b2-crypt]
type = crypt
remote = b2:rambtech-homelab/documents
password = ${local.op.rclone_crypt_password}
password2 = ${local.op.rclone_crypt_password2}
CONF
}

# Install rclone via Ansible
resource "ansible_navigator_run" "install_rclone" {
  depends_on = [module.documents]

  triggers = {
    container_id = var.container_id
  }

  execution_environment = {
    enabled = false
  }

  ansible_options = {
    private_keys = [{
      name = "homelab"
      data = file(var.ssh_private_key_path)
    }]
  }

  playbook = <<-EOT
    - name: Install rclone for cloud backup
      hosts: lxc
      gather_facts: no

      tasks:
        - name: Install required packages
          ansible.builtin.apt:
            name:
              - unzip
              - curl
              - cron
            state: present
            update_cache: yes
            cache_valid_time: 3600

        - name: Check if rclone is installed
          ansible.builtin.command:
            cmd: which rclone
          register: rclone_check
          changed_when: false
          failed_when: false

        - name: Install rclone
          ansible.builtin.shell:
            cmd: curl -fsSL https://rclone.org/install.sh | bash
          when: rclone_check.rc != 0

        - name: Create rclone config directory
          ansible.builtin.file:
            path: /root/.config/rclone
            state: directory
            mode: '0700'
  EOT

  inventory = yamlencode({
    lxc = {
      hosts = {
        "documents" = {
          ansible_host = module.documents.ip_address
          ansible_user = "root"
        }
      }
    }
  })
}

# Deploy rclone config
resource "filesync_file" "rclone_conf" {
  source      = local_sensitive_file.rclone_conf.filename
  destination = "/root/.config/rclone/rclone.conf"
  host        = module.documents.ip_address

  mode         = "0600"
  ssh_user     = "root"
  ssh_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  depends_on = [ansible_navigator_run.install_rclone]
}

# Deploy cloud-sync script
resource "filesync_file" "cloud_sync_script" {
  source      = "${path.module}/deploy/cloud-sync.sh"
  destination = "/usr/local/bin/cloud-sync.sh"
  host        = module.documents.ip_address

  mode         = "0755"
  ssh_user     = "root"
  ssh_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  depends_on = [ansible_navigator_run.install_rclone]
}

# Configure cron job for cloud backup
resource "ansible_navigator_run" "configure_cron" {
  depends_on = [
    filesync_file.cloud_sync_script,
    filesync_file.rclone_conf
  ]

  triggers = {
    container_id   = var.container_id
    cloud_schedule = var.cloud_backup_schedule
  }

  execution_environment = {
    enabled = false

    private_keys = [{
      name = "homelab"
      data = file(var.ssh_private_key_path)
    }]
  }

  playbook = <<-EOT
    - name: Configure cloud backup cron job
      hosts: lxc
      gather_facts: no
      vars:
        cloud_schedule: "${var.cloud_backup_schedule}"

      tasks:
        - name: Add cloud backup cron job (B2 sync)
          ansible.builtin.cron:
            name: "Cloud backup documents to B2"
            minute: "{{ cloud_schedule.split()[0] }}"
            hour: "{{ cloud_schedule.split()[1] }}"
            day: "{{ cloud_schedule.split()[2] }}"
            month: "{{ cloud_schedule.split()[3] }}"
            weekday: "{{ cloud_schedule.split()[4] }}"
            job: "/usr/local/bin/cloud-sync.sh documents >> /var/log/cloud-sync-documents.log 2>&1"
            user: root

        - name: Ensure cron service is enabled and running
          ansible.builtin.systemd:
            name: cron
            enabled: yes
            state: started

        - name: Display cron configuration
          ansible.builtin.debug:
            msg: "Cloud backup configured: {{ cloud_schedule }}"
  EOT

  inventory = yamlencode({
    lxc = {
      hosts = {
        "documents" = {
          ansible_host = module.documents.ip_address
          ansible_user = "root"
        }
      }
    }
  })
}

module "paperless_route" {
  source = "../../modules/traefik-route"

  app_name    = "docs"

# Stirling-PDF route (internal only)
module "stirling_pdf_route" {
  source = "../../modules/traefik-route"

  app_name    = "pdf"
  backend_url = "http://${module.documents.ip_address}:8080"

  public_middlewares   = ["cloudflare-https", "security-headers", "authentik"]

}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Outputs

output "container_id" {

}

output "ip_address" {
  value = module.documents.ip_address
}

output "ssh_command" {

    paperless_public      = module.paperless_route.public_url

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Variables

variable "container_id" {
  type    = number
  default = 104
}

variable "cores" {
  type    = number
  default = 2

variable "memory" {

module "container_mgmt" {
  source = "../../modules/docker-lxc"

  name         = "container-mgmt"
  container_id = var.container_id
  proxmox_node = var.proxmox_node

  # Network (container network only - no LAN access needed)
  container_ip = "${local.ip_registry.core.container_mgmt}${local.network.container_netmask}"

  # Resources
  cores  = var.cores
  memory = var.memory
  swap   = 512

  rootfs_storage = "nvme-containers"
  rootfs_size    = var.rootfs_size

  # Unprivileged container (security hardened)
  unprivileged = true

  # Deployment
  deploy_dir  = "${path.module}/deploy"
  target_path = "/config"

  # Exclude runtime data directories from sync (they're managed by the apps)
  exclude_patterns = ["pulse/**", "arcane_data/**"]

  # SSH
  ssh_public_key       = local.ssh_public_key
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path
  proxmox_ssh_host     = local.proxmox_ssh_host

  # Template with Docker pre-installed
  template = var.lxc_template_docker

    arcane = "https://arcane.${var.domain_internal}"
  }

  services = [

## Pulse - Container Monitoring

Real-time monitoring for Proxmox VE and Docker containers.
- Dashboard: https://pulse.${var.domain_internal}
- Proxmox metrics via PVE API
- Docker metrics via socket

  }

  depends_on = [module.container_mgmt]

  value = module.container_mgmt.container_id
}

output "ip_address" {
  value = module.container_mgmt.ip_address
}

output "ssh_command" {
  value = module.container_mgmt.ssh_command
}

  }
}

  value = {
    pulse  = module.pulse_route.remote_config_path
    arcane = module.arcane_route.remote_config_path
  }

    container_id = module.monitoring.container_id
    container_ip = module.monitoring.ip_address
    # Re-run if credentials change
    credentials_hash = sha256(join(",", [
      local.op.ntfy_admin_password,
      local.op.ntfy_darshan_password,
      local.op.ntfy_alertmanager_password,
      local.op.ntfy_pbs_backup_password,
      local.op.ntfy_n8n_password,
      local.op.ntfy_uptime_kuma_password,
    ]))
  }

  execution_environment = {
    enabled = false
  }

  ansible_options = {
    private_keys = [{
      name = "homelab"
      data = file(var.ssh_private_key_path)
    }]
  }

  playbook = templatefile("${path.module}/deploy/ntfy/provision-users.yml.tpl", {
    ntfy_admin_user            = local.op.ntfy_admin_user
    ntfy_admin_password        = local.op.ntfy_admin_password
    ntfy_darshan_password      = local.op.ntfy_darshan_password
    ntfy_alertmanager_password = local.op.ntfy_alertmanager_password
    ntfy_pbs_backup_password   = local.op.ntfy_pbs_backup_password
    ntfy_n8n_password          = local.op.ntfy_n8n_password
    ntfy_uptime_kuma_password  = local.op.ntfy_uptime_kuma_password
  })

  inventory = yamlencode({
    monitoring = {
      hosts = {
        "monitoring" = {
          ansible_host = module.monitoring.ip_address
          ansible_user = "root"
        }
      }
    }
  })

  depends_on = [module.monitoring]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Traefik Routes - Self-Service Route Registration
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "grafana_route" {
  source = "../../modules/traefik-route"

  app_name    = "grafana"
  backend_url = "http://${module.monitoring.ip_address}:3000"

  # Internal route (HTTPS via Let's Encrypt)
  internal_domain = "grafana.${var.domain_internal}"

  # Traefik config
  traefik_host         = local.traefik_ip
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  # Middlewares
  internal_middlewares = ["security-headers"]

  depends_on = [module.monitoring]
}

module "prometheus_route" {
  source = "../../modules/traefik-route"

  app_name    = "prometheus"
  backend_url = "http://${module.monitoring.ip_address}:9090"

  internal_domain = "prometheus.${var.domain_internal}"

  traefik_host         = local.traefik_ip
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  # Middlewares - authentik provides SSO authentication
  internal_middlewares = ["security-headers", "authentik"]

  depends_on = [module.monitoring]
}

module "alertmanager_route" {
  source = "../../modules/traefik-route"

  app_name    = "alertmanager"
  backend_url = "http://${module.monitoring.ip_address}:9093"

  internal_domain = "alertmanager.${var.domain_internal}"

  traefik_host         = local.traefik_ip
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  # Middlewares - authentik provides SSO authentication
  internal_middlewares = ["security-headers", "authentik"]

  depends_on = [module.monitoring]
}

module "uptime_kuma_route" {
  source = "../../modules/traefik-route"

  app_name    = "status"
  backend_url = "http://${module.monitoring.ip_address}:3001"

  internal_domain = "status.${var.domain_internal}"

  traefik_host         = local.traefik_ip
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  internal_middlewares = ["security-headers", "authentik"]

  depends_on = [module.monitoring]
}

module "ntfy_route" {
  source = "../../modules/traefik-route"

  app_name    = "ntfy"
  backend_url = "http://${module.monitoring.ip_address}:8080"

  internal_domain = "ntfy.${var.domain_internal}"

  traefik_host         = local.traefik_ip
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  # ntfy has its own ACL-based authentication - no Authentik middleware
  internal_middlewares = ["security-headers"]

  depends_on = [module.monitoring]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Backup Configuration - PBS Client
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "monitoring_sidecars" {
  source = "../../modules/lxc-sidecars"

  container_id   = module.monitoring.container_id
  container_ip   = module.monitoring.ip_address
  container_name = "monitoring"

  proxmox_ssh_host             = local.proxmox_ssh_host
  proxmox_ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  backup = {
    enabled   = true
    schedule  = "Sun 03:00"  # Weekly backup
    retention = "4"          # Keep 4 weekly backups
    namespace = "lxc-500"

    pre_backup_commands = []  # No database - config only

    include_paths = ["/config"]
    exclude_paths = ["/var/lib/docker/overlay2"]

    ntfy_priority = "default"
    ntfy_tags     = "backup,monitoring"
    ntfy_user     = "pbs-backup"
    ntfy_password = local.op.ntfy_pbs_backup_password
  }

  # Container monitoring agents
  pulse_agent = {
    enabled     = true
    pulse_token = local.agent_tokens["monitoring"].pulse_token
  }

  arcane_agent = {
    enabled         = true
    bootstrap_token = local.agent_tokens["monitoring"].arcane_bootstrap_token
  }

  depends_on = [module.monitoring]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Outputs
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

output "container_id" {
  value = module.monitoring.container_id
}

output "ip_address" {
  value = module.monitoring.ip_address
}

output "ssh_command" {
  value = module.monitoring.ssh_command
}

output "alloy_endpoints" {
  value = {
    grpc = "http://${module.monitoring.ip_address}:4317"
    http = "http://${module.monitoring.ip_address}:4318"
  }
}

output "loki_url" {
  value = "http://${module.monitoring.ip_address}:3100"
}

output "urls" {
  value = {
    grafana      = module.grafana_route.internal_url
    prometheus   = module.prometheus_route.internal_url
    alertmanager = module.alertmanager_route.internal_url
    uptime_kuma  = module.uptime_kuma_route.internal_url
    ntfy         = module.ntfy_route.internal_url
  }
}

output "traefik_config_paths" {
  description = "Paths to Traefik configs on Traefik LXC"
  value = {
    grafana      = module.grafana_route.remote_config_path
    prometheus   = module.prometheus_route.remote_config_path
    alertmanager = module.alertmanager_route.remote_config_path
    uptime_kuma  = module.uptime_kuma_route.remote_config_path
    ntfy         = module.ntfy_route.remote_config_path
  }
}

#!/bin/bash
# =============================================================================
# PBS Namespace Migration Script
# =============================================================================
# Migrates backups from per-container namespaces (ns/lxc-*) to root namespace.
#
# Current structure:
#   /mnt/datastore/ns/lxc-304/host/lxc-304/2024-12-26T02:00:00Z/
#
# Target structure:
#   /mnt/datastore/host/lxc-304/2024-12-26T02:00:00Z/
#
# This is a file-system level migration on the PBS server.
# =============================================================================

set -euo pipefail

DATASTORE_PATH="/mnt/datastore"
NS_DIR="${DATASTORE_PATH}/ns"
HOST_DIR="${DATASTORE_PATH}/host"
DRY_RUN="${DRY_RUN:-true}"

log() {
    echo "[$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')] $*"
}

# Check if running on PBS server
if [ ! -d "${DATASTORE_PATH}" ]; then
    echo "Error: This script must be run on the PBS server"
    echo "Datastore path ${DATASTORE_PATH} not found"
    exit 1
fi

# Check if there are namespaces to migrate
if [ ! -d "${NS_DIR}" ]; then
    log "No namespace directory found at ${NS_DIR}"
    log "Nothing to migrate"
    exit 0
fi

# List namespaces
log "=== PBS Namespace Migration ==="
log "Datastore: ${DATASTORE_PATH}"
log "Dry run: ${DRY_RUN}"
log ""
log "Namespaces found:"
ls -1 "${NS_DIR}" | while read ns; do
    snapshot_count=$(find "${NS_DIR}/${ns}/host" -mindepth 2 -maxdepth 2 -type d 2>/dev/null | wc -l || echo 0)
    log "  - ${ns}: ${snapshot_count} snapshots"
done

log ""

# Create root host directory if it doesn't exist
if [ ! -d "${HOST_DIR}" ]; then
    if [ "${DRY_RUN}" = "true" ]; then
        log "[DRY RUN] Would create: ${HOST_DIR}"
    else
        log "Creating root host directory: ${HOST_DIR}"
        mkdir -p "${HOST_DIR}"
        chown backup:backup "${HOST_DIR}"
    fi
fi

# Migrate each namespace
for ns_path in "${NS_DIR}"/lxc-*; do
    if [ ! -d "${ns_path}" ]; then
        continue
    fi

    ns_name=$(basename "${ns_path}")
    backup_id="${ns_name}"  # lxc-304, lxc-502, etc.

    log "=== Migrating namespace: ${ns_name} ==="

    # Source: ns/lxc-304/host/lxc-304/
    src_backup_dir="${ns_path}/host/${backup_id}"

    # Destination: host/lxc-304/
    dst_backup_dir="${HOST_DIR}/${backup_id}"

    if [ ! -d "${src_backup_dir}" ]; then
        log "  Warning: Source backup directory not found: ${src_backup_dir}"
        continue
    fi

    # Count snapshots
    snapshot_count=$(find "${src_backup_dir}" -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -type d | wc -l)
    log "  Snapshots to migrate: ${snapshot_count}"

    if [ "${DRY_RUN}" = "true" ]; then
        log "  [DRY RUN] Would move: ${src_backup_dir} -> ${dst_backup_dir}"
    else
        # Check if destination already exists
        if [ -d "${dst_backup_dir}" ]; then
            log "  Warning: Destination already exists, merging..."
            # Move individual snapshot directories
            for snapshot in "${src_backup_dir}"/*/; do
                snapshot_name=$(basename "${snapshot}")
                if [ -d "${dst_backup_dir}/${snapshot_name}" ]; then
                    log "    Skipping existing snapshot: ${snapshot_name}"
                else
                    log "    Moving snapshot: ${snapshot_name}"
                    mv "${snapshot}" "${dst_backup_dir}/"
                fi
            done
            # Copy owner file if exists
            if [ -f "${src_backup_dir}/owner" ] && [ ! -f "${dst_backup_dir}/owner" ]; then
                cp "${src_backup_dir}/owner" "${dst_backup_dir}/"
            fi
        else
            log "  Moving: ${src_backup_dir} -> ${dst_backup_dir}"
            mv "${src_backup_dir}" "${dst_backup_dir}"
        fi

        # Fix ownership
        chown -R backup:backup "${dst_backup_dir}"

        log "  ✓ Migration complete for ${ns_name}"
    fi
done

log ""
log "=== Migration Summary ==="

if [ "${DRY_RUN}" = "true" ]; then
    log "This was a dry run. No changes were made."
    log ""
    log "To perform the actual migration, run:"
    log "  DRY_RUN=false $0"
else
    log "Migration complete!"
    log ""
    log "Post-migration steps:"
    log "1. Verify backups in PBS UI or with: proxmox-backup-manager snapshots homelab"
    log "2. Run garbage collection: proxmox-backup-manager garbage-collection start homelab"
    log "3. Optionally remove empty namespace directories:"
    log "   rm -rf ${NS_DIR}/lxc-*"
    log ""
    log "New backup structure:"
    ls -la "${HOST_DIR}" 2>/dev/null || echo "  (no backups yet)"
fi

---
# =============================================================================
# ntfy User Provisioning Playbook
# =============================================================================
# This playbook sets up ntfy users and access control.
# Generated by OpenTofu - do not edit manually.
# =============================================================================

- name: Provision ntfy users and ACL
  hosts: monitoring
  gather_facts: false
  vars:
    ntfy_container: ntfy
    users:
      - name: "${ntfy_admin_user}"
        password: "${ntfy_admin_password}"
        role: admin
      - name: darshan
        password: "${ntfy_darshan_password}"
        role: user
      - name: alertmanager
        password: "${ntfy_alertmanager_password}"
        role: user
      - name: pbs-backup
        password: "${ntfy_pbs_backup_password}"
        role: user
      - name: n8n
        password: "${ntfy_n8n_password}"
        role: user
      - name: uptime-kuma
        password: "${ntfy_uptime_kuma_password}"
        role: user
    access_rules:
      - user: darshan
        topic: "*"
        permission: ro  # Subscribe only - no publishing needed
      - user: alertmanager
        topic: "homelab-alerts"
        permission: wo
      - user: pbs-backup
        topic: "backup-alerts"
        permission: wo
      - user: n8n
        topic: "docker-updates"
        permission: rw  # n8n workflows may need to publish to various topics
      - user: uptime-kuma
        topic: "homelab-alerts"
        permission: wo  # Uptime Kuma publishes status alerts
      - user: everyone
        topic: "*"
        permission: deny

  tasks:
    - name: Wait for ntfy container to be running
      ansible.builtin.command:

---
# =============================================================================
# ntfy User Provisioning Playbook
# =============================================================================
# This playbook sets up ntfy users and access control.
# Generated by OpenTofu - do not edit manually.
# =============================================================================

- name: Provision ntfy users and ACL
  hosts: monitoring
  gather_facts: false
  vars:
    ntfy_container: ntfy
    users:
      - name: "${ntfy_admin_user}"
        password: "${ntfy_admin_password}"
        role: admin
      - name: darshan
        password: "${ntfy_darshan_password}"
        role: user
      - name: alertmanager
        password: "${ntfy_alertmanager_password}"
        role: user
      - name: pbs-backup
        password: "${ntfy_pbs_backup_password}"
        role: user
      - name: n8n
        password: "${ntfy_n8n_password}"
        role: user
      - name: uptime-kuma
        password: "${ntfy_uptime_kuma_password}"
        role: user
    access_rules:
      - user: darshan
        topic: "*"
        permission: ro  # Subscribe only - no publishing needed
      - user: alertmanager
        topic: "homelab-alerts"
        permission: wo
      - user: pbs-backup
        topic: "backup-alerts"
        permission: wo
      - user: n8n
        topic: "docker-updates"
        permission: rw  # n8n workflows may need to publish to various topics
      - user: uptime-kuma
        topic: "homelab-alerts"
        permission: wo  # Uptime Kuma publishes status alerts
      - user: everyone
        topic: "*"
        permission: deny

  tasks:
    - name: Wait for ntfy container to be running
      ansible.builtin.command:
        cmd: docker inspect -f '{{ "{{" }}.State.Running{{ "}}" }}' {{ ntfy_container }}
      register: container_check
      until: container_check.stdout == "true"
      retries: 30
      delay: 2
      changed_when: false

    # Restart ntfy to ensure it picks up latest server.yml config (including auth settings)
    - name: Restart ntfy container to load latest config
      ansible.builtin.command:
        cmd: docker restart {{ ntfy_container }}
      changed_when: true

    - name: Wait for ntfy container to be healthy after restart
      ansible.builtin.command:
        cmd: docker inspect -f '{{ "{{" }}.State.Running{{ "}}" }}' {{ ntfy_container }}
      register: container_healthy
      until: container_healthy.stdout == "true"
      retries: 30
      delay: 2
      changed_when: false

    - name: Create ntfy users
      ansible.builtin.command:
        cmd: >
          docker exec -e NTFY_PASSWORD={{ item.password }} {{ ntfy_container }}
          ntfy user add --ignore-exists
          {% if item.role == 'admin' %}--role=admin{% endif %}
          {{ item.name }}
      loop: "{{ users }}"
      loop_control:
        label: "{{ item.name }}"
      register: user_result
      failed_when: false
      changed_when: user_result.rc == 0

    - name: Report user creation results
      ansible.builtin.debug:
        msg: "User '{{ item.item.name }}': {{ 'created' if item.rc == 0 else 'already exists or failed' }}"
      loop: "{{ user_result.results }}"
      loop_control:
        label: "{{ item.item.name }}"

    - name: Set access control rules
      ansible.builtin.command:
        cmd: >
          docker exec {{ ntfy_container }} ntfy access
          "{{ item.user }}" "{{ item.topic }}" "{{ item.permission }}"
      loop: "{{ access_rules }}"
      loop_control:
        label: "{{ item.user }} -> {{ item.topic }}: {{ item.permission }}"
      register: acl_result
      failed_when: false
      changed_when: acl_result.rc == 0

    - name: Display current users
      ansible.builtin.command:
        cmd: docker exec {{ ntfy_container }} ntfy user list
      register: users_list
      changed_when: false

    - name: Display current ACL
      ansible.builtin.command:
        cmd: docker exec {{ ntfy_container }} ntfy access
      register: acl_list
      changed_when: false

    - name: Show final configuration
      ansible.builtin.debug:
        msg:
          - "=== ntfy Users ==="
          - "{{ users_list.stdout_lines }}"
          - "=== ntfy ACL ==="
          - "{{ acl_list.stdout_lines }}"

# =============================================================================
# Monitoring LXC - Loki + Alloy + Prometheus + Grafana + Uptime Kuma + ntfy
# =============================================================================
# Container ID: 500
#
# Uses the docker-lxc module - the gold standard pattern for Docker apps.
# Observability stack for logs, metrics, dashboards, and alerting.
# =============================================================================

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Variables
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

variable "container_id" {
  type    = number
  default = 500
}

variable "cores" {
  type    = number
  default = 4
}

variable "memory" {
  type    = number
  default = 4096
}

variable "rootfs_size" {
  type    = number
  default = 32
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Monitoring Container
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "monitoring" {
  source = "../../modules/docker-lxc"

  name         = "monitoring"
  container_id = var.container_id
  proxmox_node = var.proxmox_node

  # Network (container network only)
  container_ip = "${local.ip_registry.monitoring.monitoring}${local.network.container_netmask}"

  # Resources
  cores  = var.cores
  memory = var.memory
  swap   = 1024

  rootfs_storage = "tank"
  rootfs_size    = var.rootfs_size

  # Unprivileged container (security hardened)
  unprivileged = true

  # Deployment
  deploy_dir  = "${path.module}/deploy"
  target_path = "/config"

  # SSH
  ssh_public_key       = local.ssh_public_key
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path
  proxmox_ssh_host     = local.proxmox_ssh_host

  # Template with Docker pre-installed
  template = var.lxc_template_docker

  # Proxmox Notes
  service_name        = "Monitoring"
  service_description = "Observability stack with Loki, Alloy, Prometheus, Grafana, and alerting"

  service_urls = {
    grafana           = "https://grafana.${var.domain_internal}"
    prometheus        = "https://prometheus.${var.domain_internal}"
    alertmanager      = "https://alertmanager.${var.domain_internal}"
    uptime_kuma       = "https://status.${var.domain_internal}"
    ntfy              = "https://ntfy.${var.domain_internal}"
    direct_loki       = "http://${local.lan_ips.monitoring}:3100"
    direct_alloy_grpc = "http://${local.lan_ips.monitoring}:4317"
    direct_alloy_http = "http://${local.lan_ips.monitoring}:4318"
  }

  services = [
    { name = "Loki", port = 3100, info = "Log aggregation" },
    { name = "Alloy (gRPC)", port = 4317, info = "OTLP gRPC receiver" },
    { name = "Alloy (HTTP)", port = 4318, info = "OTLP HTTP receiver" },
    { name = "Alloy UI", port = 12345, info = "Alloy debug UI" },
    { name = "Prometheus", port = 9090, info = "Metrics storage and alerting" },
    { name = "Grafana", port = 3000, info = "Dashboards and visualization" },
    { name = "Alertmanager", port = 9093, info = "Alert routing" },
    { name = "Uptime Kuma", port = 3001, info = "HTTP monitoring and status page" },
    { name = "ntfy", port = 8080, info = "Push notifications" }
  ]

  custom_notes = <<-EOT
## Alloy OTLP Endpoints (for Proxmox/Immich)

**OTLP gRPC:** ${local.lan_ips.monitoring}:4317
**OTLP HTTP:** ${local.lan_ips.monitoring}:4318

Configure Proxmox metrics server:
```bash
pvesh create /cluster/metrics/server \
  --id homelab-alloy \
  --type opentelemetry \
  --server ${local.lan_ips.monitoring} \
  --port 4317 \
  --proto grpc
```

## Loki Endpoint (for Alloy sidecars)

**Loki URL:** http://${local.lan_ips.monitoring}:3100

## Grafana

Default login: admin / (password in 1Password)

## ntfy Topics

- `homelab-alerts` - Prometheus alerts
- `homelab-status` - Uptime Kuma notifications

Subscribe via mobile app or web UI.

## Quick Commands

```bash
# View Alloy logs
docker logs -f alloy

# View Loki logs
docker logs -f loki

# Query logs via Loki API
curl -s "http://localhost:3100/loki/api/v1/labels" | jq

# Reload Prometheus config
curl -X POST http://localhost:9090/-/reload

# Test ntfy notification
curl -d "Test notification" http://localhost:8080/homelab-alerts
```

## Managed by OpenTofu

Run `task tofu:apply APP=monitoring` to update.
EOT

  tags = ["monitoring", "loki", "alloy", "prometheus", "grafana"]

  # Pass env content to module - synced BEFORE docker compose runs
  env_content = templatefile("${path.module}/deploy/.env.tpl", {
    grafana_admin_password = local.op.grafana_admin_password
    uptime_kuma_username   = local.op.uptime_kuma_username
    uptime_kuma_password   = local.op.uptime_kuma_password
    discord_webhook_url    = local.op.discord_webhook_url
    # Grafana OAuth/OIDC via Authentik
    grafana_oauth_client_id     = authentik_provider_oauth2.grafana.client_id
    grafana_oauth_client_secret = random_password.grafana_oidc_secret.result
    grafana_oauth_auth_url      = "https://auth.${var.domain_public}/application/o/authorize/"
    grafana_oauth_token_url     = "https://auth.${var.domain_public}/application/o/token/"
    grafana_oauth_api_url       = "https://auth.${var.domain_public}/application/o/userinfo/"
    grafana_oauth_signout_url   = "https://auth.${var.domain_public}/application/o/grafana/end-session/"
    # ntfy credentials for Alertmanager
    ntfy_alertmanager_password = local.op.ntfy_alertmanager_password
  })
}

# Note: .env file is now handled by the docker-lxc module via env_content
# This ensures the .env is synced BEFORE docker compose runs

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# ntfy User Provisioning (Ansible)
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Provisions ntfy users and ACL after container deployment

resource "ansible_navigator_run" "ntfy_provision" {
  triggers = {
    container_id = module.monitoring.container_id
    container_ip = module.monitoring.ip_address
    # Re-run if credentials change
    credentials_hash = sha256(join(",", [
      local.op.ntfy_admin_password,
      local.op.ntfy_darshan_password,
      local.op.ntfy_alertmanager_password,
      local.op.ntfy_pbs_backup_password,
      local.op.ntfy_n8n_password,
      local.op.ntfy_uptime_kuma_password,
    ]))
  }

  execution_environment = {
    enabled = false
  }

  ansible_options = {
    private_keys = [{
      name = "homelab"
      data = file(var.ssh_private_key_path)
    }]
  }

  playbook = templatefile("${path.module}/deploy/ntfy/provision-users.yml.tpl", {
    ntfy_admin_user            = local.op.ntfy_admin_user
    ntfy_admin_password        = local.op.ntfy_admin_password
    ntfy_darshan_password      = local.op.ntfy_darshan_password
    ntfy_alertmanager_password = local.op.ntfy_alertmanager_password
    ntfy_pbs_backup_password   = local.op.ntfy_pbs_backup_password
    ntfy_n8n_password          = local.op.ntfy_n8n_password
    ntfy_uptime_kuma_password  = local.op.ntfy_uptime_kuma_password
  })

  inventory = yamlencode({
    monitoring = {
      hosts = {
        "monitoring" = {
          ansible_host = module.monitoring.ip_address
          ansible_user = "root"
        }
      }
    }
  })

  depends_on = [module.monitoring]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Traefik Routes - Self-Service Route Registration
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "grafana_route" {
  source = "../../modules/traefik-route"

  app_name    = "grafana"
  backend_url = "http://${module.monitoring.ip_address}:3000"

  # Internal route (HTTPS via Let's Encrypt)
  internal_domain = "grafana.${var.domain_internal}"

  # Traefik config
  traefik_host         = local.traefik_ip
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  # Middlewares
  internal_middlewares = ["security-headers"]

  depends_on = [module.monitoring]
}

module "prometheus_route" {
  source = "../../modules/traefik-route"

  app_name    = "prometheus"
  backend_url = "http://${module.monitoring.ip_address}:9090"

  internal_domain = "prometheus.${var.domain_internal}"

  traefik_host         = local.traefik_ip
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  # Middlewares - authentik provides SSO authentication
  internal_middlewares = ["security-headers", "authentik"]

  depends_on = [module.monitoring]
}

module "alertmanager_route" {
  source = "../../modules/traefik-route"

  app_name    = "alertmanager"
  backend_url = "http://${module.monitoring.ip_address}:9093"

  internal_domain = "alertmanager.${var.domain_internal}"

  traefik_host         = local.traefik_ip
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  # Middlewares - authentik provides SSO authentication
  internal_middlewares = ["security-headers", "authentik"]

  depends_on = [module.monitoring]
}

module "uptime_kuma_route" {
  source = "../../modules/traefik-route"

  app_name    = "status"
  backend_url = "http://${module.monitoring.ip_address}:3001"

  internal_domain = "status.${var.domain_internal}"

  traefik_host         = local.traefik_ip
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  internal_middlewares = ["security-headers", "authentik"]

  depends_on = [module.monitoring]
}

module "ntfy_route" {
  source = "../../modules/traefik-route"

  app_name    = "ntfy"
  backend_url = "http://${module.monitoring.ip_address}:8080"

  internal_domain = "ntfy.${var.domain_internal}"

  traefik_host         = local.traefik_ip
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  # ntfy has its own ACL-based authentication - no Authentik middleware
  internal_middlewares = ["security-headers"]

  depends_on = [module.monitoring]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Backup Configuration - PBS Client
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "monitoring_sidecars" {
  source = "../../modules/lxc-sidecars"

  container_id   = module.monitoring.container_id
  container_ip   = module.monitoring.ip_address
  container_name = "monitoring"

  proxmox_ssh_host             = local.proxmox_ssh_host
  proxmox_ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  backup = {
    enabled   = true
    schedule  = "Sun 03:00"  # Weekly backup
    retention = "4"          # Keep 4 weekly backups

    pre_backup_commands = []  # No database - config only

    include_paths = ["/config"]
    exclude_paths = ["/var/lib/docker/overlay2"]

    ntfy_priority = "default"
    ntfy_tags     = "backup,monitoring"
    ntfy_user     = "pbs-backup"
    ntfy_password = local.op.ntfy_pbs_backup_password
  }

  # Container monitoring agents
  pulse_agent = {
    enabled     = true
    pulse_token = local.agent_tokens["monitoring"].pulse_token
  }

  arcane_agent = {
    enabled         = true
    bootstrap_token = local.agent_tokens["monitoring"].arcane_bootstrap_token
  }

  depends_on = [module.monitoring]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Outputs
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

output "container_id" {
  value = module.monitoring.container_id
}

output "ip_address" {
  value = module.monitoring.ip_address
}

output "ssh_command" {
  value = module.monitoring.ssh_command
}

output "alloy_endpoints" {
  value = {
    grpc = "http://${module.monitoring.ip_address}:4317"
    http = "http://${module.monitoring.ip_address}:4318"
  }
}

output "loki_url" {
  value = "http://${module.monitoring.ip_address}:3100"
}

output "urls" {
  value = {
    grafana      = module.grafana_route.internal_url
    prometheus   = module.prometheus_route.internal_url
    alertmanager = module.alertmanager_route.internal_url
    uptime_kuma  = module.uptime_kuma_route.internal_url
    ntfy         = module.ntfy_route.internal_url
  }
}

output "traefik_config_paths" {
  description = "Paths to Traefik configs on Traefik LXC"
  value = {
    grafana      = module.grafana_route.remote_config_path
    prometheus   = module.prometheus_route.remote_config_path
    alertmanager = module.alertmanager_route.remote_config_path
    uptime_kuma  = module.uptime_kuma_route.remote_config_path
    ntfy         = module.ntfy_route.remote_config_path
  }
}

services:
  # ==========================================================================
  # Loki - Log aggregation
  # ==========================================================================
  loki:
    image: grafana/loki:3.5.9
    container_name: loki
    command: -config.file=/etc/loki/local-config.yaml
    ports:
      - "3100:3100"
    volumes:
      - ./loki/config.yaml:/etc/loki/local-config.yaml:ro
      - loki_data:/loki
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 1024m
          cpus: '1.0'
        reservations:
          memory: 512m
          cpus: '0.5'
    restart: unless-stopped
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "wget -qO- http://localhost:3100/ready || exit 1"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 30s

  # ==========================================================================
  # Grafana Alloy - Unified telemetry collector (replaces OTEL Collector)
  # ==========================================================================
  alloy:
    image: grafana/alloy:v1.12.1
    container_name: alloy
    command:
      - run
      - --server.http.listen-addr=0.0.0.0:12345
      - --storage.path=/var/lib/alloy/data
      - --disable-reporting=true
      - /etc/alloy/config.alloy
    ports:
      - "4317:4317"   # OTLP gRPC receiver (backwards compat)
      - "4318:4318"   # OTLP HTTP receiver (backwards compat)
      - "12345:12345" # Alloy UI
    volumes:
      - ./alloy/config.alloy:/etc/alloy/config.alloy:ro
      - /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock:ro
      - /var/log:/var/log/host:ro
      - alloy_data:/var/lib/alloy/data
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 512m
          cpus: '0.5'
        reservations:
          memory: 256m
          cpus: '0.25'
    restart: unless-stopped
    depends_on:
      - prometheus
      - loki
    healthcheck:
      test:
        - CMD-SHELL
        - |
          bash -c '
          exec 42<>/dev/tcp/localhost/12345;
          echo -e "GET /-/healthy HTTP/1.1\nHost: localhost\nConnection: close\n\n" >&42;
          head -1 <&42 | cut -d" " -f2 | grep -q "^200$" || exit 1;
          exec 42<&-;
          exec 42>&-'
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 30s

  # ==========================================================================
  # Prometheus - Metrics storage and alerting
  # ==========================================================================
  prometheus:
    image: prom/prometheus:v3.8.1
    container_name: prometheus
    command:
      - '--config.file=/etc/prometheus/prometheus.yml'
      - '--storage.tsdb.path=/prometheus'
      - '--storage.tsdb.retention.time=30d'
      - '--web.enable-lifecycle'
      - '--web.enable-remote-write-receiver'
      - '--web.external-url=https://prometheus.homelab.rambtech.dev'
    ports:
      - "9090:9090"
    volumes:
      - ./prometheus/prometheus.yml:/etc/prometheus/prometheus.yml:ro
      - ./prometheus/alerts:/etc/prometheus/alerts:ro
      - prometheus_data:/prometheus
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 4096m
          cpus: '2.0'
        reservations:
          memory: 2048m
          cpus: '1.0'
    restart: unless-stopped
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "wget -qO- http://localhost:9090/-/healthy || exit 1"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 30s

  # ==========================================================================
  # Alertmanager - Alert routing and notifications
  # ==========================================================================
  alertmanager:
    image: prom/alertmanager:v0.30.0
    container_name: alertmanager
    command:
      - '--config.file=/etc/alertmanager/alertmanager.yml'
      - '--storage.path=/alertmanager'
      - '--web.external-url=https://alertmanager.homelab.rambtech.dev'
    ports:
      - "9093:9093"
    volumes:
      - ./alertmanager/alertmanager.yml:/etc/alertmanager/alertmanager.yml:ro
      - ./alertmanager/templates:/etc/alertmanager/templates:ro
      - alertmanager_data:/alertmanager
    secrets:
      - ntfy_password
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 512m
          cpus: '0.5'
        reservations:
          memory: 256m
          cpus: '0.25'
    restart: unless-stopped
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "wget -qO- http://localhost:9093/-/healthy || exit 1"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 10s

  # ==========================================================================
  # Grafana - Visualization and dashboards
  # ==========================================================================
  grafana:
    image: grafana/grafana:12.3.1
    container_name: grafana
    environment:
      - GF_SECURITY_ADMIN_USER=admin
      - GF_SECURITY_ADMIN_PASSWORD=${GRAFANA_ADMIN_PASSWORD:-admin}
      - GF_USERS_ALLOW_SIGN_UP=false
      - GF_SERVER_ROOT_URL=https://grafana.homelab.rambtech.dev
      - GF_AUTH_ANONYMOUS_ENABLED=false
      # OAuth/OIDC via Authentik
      - GF_AUTH_GENERIC_OAUTH_ENABLED=true
      - GF_AUTH_GENERIC_OAUTH_NAME=Authentik
      - GF_AUTH_GENERIC_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID=${GRAFANA_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID}
      - GF_AUTH_GENERIC_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET=${GRAFANA_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET}
      - GF_AUTH_GENERIC_OAUTH_SCOPES=openid email profile
      - GF_AUTH_GENERIC_OAUTH_AUTH_URL=${GRAFANA_OAUTH_AUTH_URL}
      - GF_AUTH_GENERIC_OAUTH_TOKEN_URL=${GRAFANA_OAUTH_TOKEN_URL}
      - GF_AUTH_GENERIC_OAUTH_API_URL=${GRAFANA_OAUTH_API_URL}
      - GF_AUTH_GENERIC_OAUTH_ALLOW_SIGN_UP=true
      - GF_AUTH_GENERIC_OAUTH_AUTO_LOGIN=false
      - GF_AUTH_GENERIC_OAUTH_USE_PKCE=true
      - GF_AUTH_SIGNOUT_REDIRECT_URL=${GRAFANA_OAUTH_SIGNOUT_URL}
      # Attribute mappings for user info from Authentik (using JMESPath)
      - GF_AUTH_GENERIC_OAUTH_EMAIL_ATTRIBUTE_PATH=email
      - GF_AUTH_GENERIC_OAUTH_LOGIN_ATTRIBUTE_PATH=preferred_username || email
      - GF_AUTH_GENERIC_OAUTH_NAME_ATTRIBUTE_PATH=name || preferred_username
    ports:
      - "3000:3000"
    volumes:
      - ./grafana/provisioning:/etc/grafana/provisioning:ro
      - ./grafana/dashboards:/var/lib/grafana/dashboards:ro
      - grafana_data:/var/lib/grafana
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 2048m
          cpus: '2.0'
        reservations:
          memory: 1024m
          cpus: '1.0'
    restart: unless-stopped
    depends_on:
      - prometheus
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "wget -qO- http://localhost:3000/api/health || exit 1"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 30s

  # ==========================================================================
  # Uptime Kuma - HTTP endpoint monitoring and status page
  # ==========================================================================
  uptime-kuma:
    image: louislam/uptime-kuma:2.0.2
    container_name: uptime-kuma
    ports:
      - "3001:3001"
    volumes:
      - uptime_kuma_data:/app/data
    dns:
      - 192.168.1.196  # AdGuard DNS for local domain resolution
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 1024m
          cpus: '1.0'
        reservations:
          memory: 512m
          cpus: '0.5'
    restart: unless-stopped
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "curl -sf http://localhost:3001/ > /dev/null || exit 1"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 60s

  # ==========================================================================
  # AutoKuma - Declarative monitor management for Uptime Kuma
  # Monitors defined in ./autokuma/monitors.json
  # ==========================================================================
  autokuma:
    image: ghcr.io/bigboot/autokuma:2.0.0
    container_name: autokuma
    environment:
      - AUTOKUMA__KUMA__URL=http://uptime-kuma:3001
      - AUTOKUMA__KUMA__USERNAME=${UPTIME_KUMA_USERNAME:-admin}
      - AUTOKUMA__KUMA__PASSWORD=${UPTIME_KUMA_PASSWORD}
      - AUTOKUMA__STATIC_MONITORS=/monitors/monitors.json
      - AUTOKUMA__DOCKER__ENABLED=false
    volumes:
      - ./autokuma/monitors.json:/monitors/monitors.json:ro
    depends_on:
      - uptime-kuma
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 512m
          cpus: '0.5'
        reservations:
          memory: 256m
          cpus: '0.25'
    # Healthcheck removed: AutoKuma is distroless Rust binary with no health endpoint
    # Container health monitored via Docker restart policy
    restart: unless-stopped

  # ==========================================================================
  # ntfy - Push notifications
  # ==========================================================================
  ntfy:
    image: binwiederhier/ntfy:v2.15.0
    container_name: ntfy
    command:
      - serve

services:
  # ==========================================================================
  # Loki - Log aggregation
  # ==========================================================================
  loki:
    image: grafana/loki:3.5.9
    container_name: loki
    command: -config.file=/etc/loki/local-config.yaml
    ports:
      - "3100:3100"
    volumes:
      - ./loki/config.yaml:/etc/loki/local-config.yaml:ro
      - loki_data:/loki
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:

          cpus: '1.0'

          cpus: '0.5'

    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "wget -qO- http://localhost:3100/ready || exit 1"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 30s

  # ==========================================================================
  # Grafana Alloy - Unified telemetry collector (replaces OTEL Collector)
  # ==========================================================================
  alloy:
    image: grafana/alloy:v1.12.1
    container_name: alloy
    command:
      - run
      - --server.http.listen-addr=0.0.0.0:12345
      - --storage.path=/var/lib/alloy/data
      - --disable-reporting=true
      - /etc/alloy/config.alloy
    ports:
      - "4317:4317"   # OTLP gRPC receiver (backwards compat)
      - "4318:4318"   # OTLP HTTP receiver (backwards compat)
      - "12345:12345" # Alloy UI
    volumes:
      - ./alloy/config.alloy:/etc/alloy/config.alloy:ro
      - /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock:ro
      - /var/log:/var/log/host:ro
      - alloy_data:/var/lib/alloy/data
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 512m
          cpus: '0.5'
        reservations:
          memory: 256m
          cpus: '0.25'

    depends_on:

    healthcheck:

# =============================================================================
# Monitoring LXC - Loki + Alloy + Prometheus + Grafana + Uptime Kuma + ntfy
# =============================================================================
# Container ID: 500
#
# Uses the docker-lxc module - the gold standard pattern for Docker apps.
# Observability stack for logs, metrics, dashboards, and alerting.
# =============================================================================

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Variables
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

variable "container_id" {
  type    = number
  default = 500
}

variable "cores" {
  type    = number
  default = 4
}

variable "memory" {
  type    = number
  default = 4096
}

variable "rootfs_size" {
  type    = number
  default = 32
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Monitoring Container
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "monitoring" {
  source = "../../modules/docker-lxc"

  name         = "monitoring"
  container_id = var.container_id
  proxmox_node = var.proxmox_node

  # Network (container network only)
  container_ip = "${local.ip_registry.monitoring.monitoring}${local.network.container_netmask}"

  # Resources
  cores  = var.cores
  memory = var.memory
  swap   = 1024

  rootfs_storage = "tank"
  rootfs_size    = var.rootfs_size

  # Unprivileged container (security hardened)
  unprivileged = true

  # Deployment
  deploy_dir  = "${path.module}/deploy"
  target_path = "/config"

  # SSH
  ssh_public_key       = local.ssh_public_key
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path
  proxmox_ssh_host     = local.proxmox_ssh_host

  # Template with Docker pre-installed
  template = var.lxc_template_docker

  # Proxmox Notes
  service_name        = "Monitoring"
  service_description = "Observability stack with Loki, Alloy, Prometheus, Grafana, and alerting"

  service_urls = {
    grafana           = "https://grafana.${var.domain_internal}"
    prometheus        = "https://prometheus.${var.domain_internal}"
    alertmanager      = "https://alertmanager.${var.domain_internal}"
    uptime_kuma       = "https://status.${var.domain_internal}"
    ntfy              = "https://ntfy.${var.domain_internal}"
    direct_loki       = "http://${local.lan_ips.monitoring}:3100"
    direct_alloy_grpc = "http://${local.lan_ips.monitoring}:4317"
    direct_alloy_http = "http://${local.lan_ips.monitoring}:4318"
  }

  services = [
    { name = "Loki", port = 3100, info = "Log aggregation" },
    { name = "Alloy (gRPC)", port = 4317, info = "OTLP gRPC receiver" },
    { name = "Alloy (HTTP)", port = 4318, info = "OTLP HTTP receiver" },
    { name = "Alloy UI", port = 12345, info = "Alloy debug UI" },
    { name = "Prometheus", port = 9090, info = "Metrics storage and alerting" },
    { name = "Grafana", port = 3000, info = "Dashboards and visualization" },
    { name = "Alertmanager", port = 9093, info = "Alert routing" },
    { name = "Uptime Kuma", port = 3001, info = "HTTP monitoring and status page" },
    { name = "ntfy", port = 8080, info = "Push notifications" }
  ]

  custom_notes = <<-EOT
## Alloy OTLP Endpoints (for Proxmox/Immich)

**OTLP gRPC:** ${local.lan_ips.monitoring}:4317
**OTLP HTTP:** ${local.lan_ips.monitoring}:4318

Configure Proxmox metrics server:
```bash
pvesh create /cluster/metrics/server \
  --id homelab-alloy \
  --type opentelemetry \
  --server ${local.lan_ips.monitoring} \
  --port 4317 \
  --proto grpc
```

## Loki Endpoint (for Alloy sidecars)

**Loki URL:** http://${local.lan_ips.monitoring}:3100

## Grafana

Default login: admin / (password in 1Password)

## ntfy Topics

- `homelab-alerts` - Prometheus alerts
- `homelab-status` - Uptime Kuma notifications

Subscribe via mobile app or web UI.

## Quick Commands

```bash
# View Alloy logs
docker logs -f alloy

# View Loki logs
docker logs -f loki

# Query logs via Loki API
curl -s "http://localhost:3100/loki/api/v1/labels" | jq

# Reload Prometheus config
curl -X POST http://localhost:9090/-/reload

# Test ntfy notification
curl -d "Test notification" http://localhost:8080/homelab-alerts
```

## Managed by OpenTofu

Run `task tofu:apply APP=monitoring` to update.
EOT

  tags = ["monitoring", "loki", "alloy", "prometheus", "grafana"]

  # Pass env content to module - synced BEFORE docker compose runs
  env_content = templatefile("${path.module}/deploy/.env.tpl", {
    grafana_admin_password = local.op.grafana_admin_password
    uptime_kuma_username   = local.op.uptime_kuma_username
    uptime_kuma_password   = local.op.uptime_kuma_password
    discord_webhook_url    = local.op.discord_webhook_url
    # Grafana OAuth/OIDC via Authentik
    grafana_oauth_client_id     = authentik_provider_oauth2.grafana.client_id
    grafana_oauth_client_secret = random_password.grafana_oidc_secret.result
    grafana_oauth_auth_url      = "https://auth.${var.domain_public}/application/o/authorize/"
    grafana_oauth_token_url     = "https://auth.${var.domain_public}/application/o/token/"
    grafana_oauth_api_url       = "https://auth.${var.domain_public}/application/o/userinfo/"
    grafana_oauth_signout_url   = "https://auth.${var.domain_public}/application/o/grafana/end-session/"
    # ntfy credentials for Alertmanager
    ntfy_alertmanager_password = local.op.ntfy_alertmanager_password
  })
}

# Note: .env file is now handled by the docker-lxc module via env_content
# This ensures the .env is synced BEFORE docker compose runs

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# ntfy User Provisioning (Ansible)
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Provisions ntfy users and ACL after container deployment

resource "ansible_navigator_run" "ntfy_provision" {
  triggers = {
    container_id = module.monitoring.container_id
    container_ip = module.monitoring.ip_address
    # Re-run if credentials change
    credentials_hash = sha256(join(",", [
      local.op.ntfy_admin_password,
      local.op.ntfy_darshan_password,
      local.op.ntfy_alertmanager_password,
      local.op.ntfy_pbs_backup_password,
      local.op.ntfy_n8n_password,
      local.op.ntfy_uptime_kuma_password,
      local.op.ntfy_discord_forwarder_password,
    ]))
  }

  execution_environment = {
    enabled = false
  }

  ansible_options = {
    private_keys = [{
      name = "homelab"
      data = file(var.ssh_private_key_path)
    }]
  }

  playbook = templatefile("${path.module}/deploy/ntfy/provision-users.yml.tpl", {
    ntfy_admin_user                 = local.op.ntfy_admin_user
    ntfy_admin_password             = local.op.ntfy_admin_password
    ntfy_darshan_password           = local.op.ntfy_darshan_password
    ntfy_alertmanager_password      = local.op.ntfy_alertmanager_password
    ntfy_pbs_backup_password        = local.op.ntfy_pbs_backup_password
    ntfy_n8n_password               = local.op.ntfy_n8n_password
    ntfy_uptime_kuma_password       = local.op.ntfy_uptime_kuma_password
    ntfy_discord_forwarder_password = local.op.ntfy_discord_forwarder_password
  })

  inventory = yamlencode({
    monitoring = {
      hosts = {
        "monitoring" = {
          ansible_host = module.monitoring.ip_address
          ansible_user = "root"
        }
      }
    }
  })

  depends_on = [module.monitoring]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Traefik Routes - Self-Service Route Registration
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "grafana_route" {
  source = "../../modules/traefik-route"

  app_name    = "grafana"
  backend_url = "http://${module.monitoring.ip_address}:3000"

  # Internal route (HTTPS via Let's Encrypt)
  internal_domain = "grafana.${var.domain_internal}"

  # Traefik config
  traefik_host         = local.traefik_ip
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  # Middlewares
  internal_middlewares = ["security-headers"]

  depends_on = [module.monitoring]
}

module "prometheus_route" {
  source = "../../modules/traefik-route"

  app_name    = "prometheus"
  backend_url = "http://${module.monitoring.ip_address}:9090"

  internal_domain = "prometheus.${var.domain_internal}"

  traefik_host         = local.traefik_ip
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  # Middlewares - authentik provides SSO authentication
  internal_middlewares = ["security-headers", "authentik"]

  depends_on = [module.monitoring]
}

module "alertmanager_route" {
  source = "../../modules/traefik-route"

  app_name    = "alertmanager"
  backend_url = "http://${module.monitoring.ip_address}:9093"

  internal_domain = "alertmanager.${var.domain_internal}"

  traefik_host         = local.traefik_ip
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  # Middlewares - authentik provides SSO authentication
  internal_middlewares = ["security-headers", "authentik"]

  depends_on = [module.monitoring]
}

module "uptime_kuma_route" {
  source = "../../modules/traefik-route"

  app_name    = "status"
  backend_url = "http://${module.monitoring.ip_address}:3001"

  internal_domain = "status.${var.domain_internal}"

  traefik_host         = local.traefik_ip
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  internal_middlewares = ["security-headers", "authentik"]

  depends_on = [module.monitoring]
}

module "ntfy_route" {
  source = "../../modules/traefik-route"

  app_name    = "ntfy"
  backend_url = "http://${module.monitoring.ip_address}:8080"

  internal_domain = "ntfy.${var.domain_internal}"

  traefik_host         = local.traefik_ip
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  # ntfy has its own ACL-based authentication - no Authentik middleware
  internal_middlewares = ["security-headers"]

  depends_on = [module.monitoring]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Backup Configuration - PBS Client
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "monitoring_sidecars" {
  source = "../../modules/lxc-sidecars"

  container_id   = module.monitoring.container_id
  container_ip   = module.monitoring.ip_address
  container_name = "monitoring"

  proxmox_ssh_host             = local.proxmox_ssh_host
  proxmox_ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  backup = {
    enabled   = true
    schedule  = "Sun 03:00"  # Weekly backup
    retention = "4"          # Keep 4 weekly backups

    pre_backup_commands = []  # No database - config only

    include_paths = ["/config"]
    exclude_paths = ["/var/lib/docker/overlay2"]

    ntfy_priority = "default"
    ntfy_tags     = "backup,monitoring"
    ntfy_user     = "pbs-backup"
    ntfy_password = local.op.ntfy_pbs_backup_password
  }

  # Container monitoring agents
  pulse_agent = {
    enabled     = true
    pulse_token = local.agent_tokens["monitoring"].pulse_token
  }

  arcane_agent = {
    enabled         = true
    bootstrap_token = local.agent_tokens["monitoring"].arcane_bootstrap_token
  }

  depends_on = [module.monitoring]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Outputs
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

output "container_id" {
  value = module.monitoring.container_id
}

output "ip_address" {
  value = module.monitoring.ip_address
}

output "ssh_command" {
  value = module.monitoring.ssh_command
}

output "alloy_endpoints" {
  value = {
    grpc = "http://${module.monitoring.ip_address}:4317"
    http = "http://${module.monitoring.ip_address}:4318"
  }
}

output "loki_url" {
  value = "http://${module.monitoring.ip_address}:3100"
}

output "urls" {
  value = {
    grafana      = module.grafana_route.internal_url
    prometheus   = module.prometheus_route.internal_url
    alertmanager = module.alertmanager_route.internal_url
    uptime_kuma  = module.uptime_kuma_route.internal_url
    ntfy         = module.ntfy_route.internal_url
  }
}

output "traefik_config_paths" {
  description = "Paths to Traefik configs on Traefik LXC"
  value = {
    grafana      = module.grafana_route.remote_config_path
    prometheus   = module.prometheus_route.remote_config_path
    alertmanager = module.alertmanager_route.remote_config_path
    uptime_kuma  = module.uptime_kuma_route.remote_config_path
    ntfy         = module.ntfy_route.remote_config_path
  }
}

# =============================================================================
# Documents LXC - Paperless-ngx + Stirling-PDF
# =============================================================================
# Container ID: 504
# IP: 10.100.5.104
#
# Document management stack:
# - Paperless-ngx: OCR, full-text search, auto-tagging, email consumption
# - Stirling-PDF: PDF manipulation (merge, split, compress, convert, etc.)
# =============================================================================

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1Password - Paperless Secrets
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

data "onepassword_item" "paperless" {
  vault = data.onepassword_vault.homelab.uuid
  title = "paperless"
}

locals {
  # Flatten paperless section fields into a map by label
  _paperless_section_fields = merge([
    for s in try(data.onepassword_item.paperless.section, []) : {
      for f in try(s.field, []) : f.label => f.value
    }
  ]...)

  paperless = {
    admin_user     = try(data.onepassword_item.paperless.username, "admin")
    admin_password = try(data.onepassword_item.paperless.password, "")
    db_password    = lookup(local._paperless_section_fields, "db_password", "")
    secret_key     = lookup(local._paperless_section_fields, "secret_key", "")
  }
}

# Generate the .env file from 1Password secrets + OIDC config
resource "local_sensitive_file" "documents_env" {
  filename = "${path.module}/deploy/.env"
  content  = <<-EOT
# Documents Stack Environment
# Auto-generated by OpenTofu from 1Password
# DO NOT EDIT - changes will be overwritten

# Paperless-ngx
PAPERLESS_ADMIN_USER=${local.paperless.admin_user}
PAPERLESS_ADMIN_PASSWORD=${local.paperless.admin_password}
PAPERLESS_DB_PASSWORD=${local.paperless.db_password}
PAPERLESS_SECRET_KEY=${local.paperless.secret_key}

# OAuth/OIDC via Authentik (django-allauth)
PAPERLESS_SOCIALACCOUNT_PROVIDERS=${jsonencode({
    openid_connect = {
      APPS = [{
        provider_id = "authentik"
        name        = "Authentik"
        client_id   = authentik_provider_oauth2.paperless.client_id
        secret      = random_password.paperless_oidc_secret.result
        settings = {
          server_url = "https://auth.${var.domain_public}/application/o/paperless/"
        }
      }]
      OAUTH_PKCE_ENABLED = "True"
    }
  })}
EOT

  file_permission = "0600"
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Variables
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

variable "container_id" {
  type    = number
  default = 504
}

variable "cores" {
  type    = number
  default = 4  # OCR is CPU intensive
}

variable "memory" {
  type    = number
  default = 8192  # OCR needs memory
}

variable "swap" {
  type    = number
  default = 2048
}

variable "rootfs_size" {
  type    = number
  default = 64  # Documents can grow large
}

# Cloud backup schedule (default: Wed and Sun at 3:30 AM, after photos backup)
variable "cloud_backup_schedule" {
  type    = string
  default = "30 3 * * 0,3"
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Documents Container
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "documents" {
  source = "../../modules/docker-lxc"

  name         = "documents"
  container_id = var.container_id
  proxmox_node = var.proxmox_node

  # Network (container network only)
  container_ip = "${local.ip_registry.monitoring.documents}${local.network.container_netmask}"

  # Resources
  cores  = var.cores
  memory = var.memory
  swap   = var.swap

  rootfs_storage = "nvme-containers"
  rootfs_size    = var.rootfs_size

  # Unprivileged container (security hardened)
  unprivileged = true

  # Deployment
  deploy_dir  = "${path.module}/deploy"
  target_path = "/config"

  # Ensure .env is generated before file sync
  depends_on = [local_sensitive_file.documents_env]

  # SSH
  ssh_public_key       = local.ssh_public_key
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path
  proxmox_ssh_host     = local.proxmox_ssh_host

  # Template with Docker pre-installed
  template = var.lxc_template_docker

  # Proxmox Notes
  service_name        = "Documents"
  service_description = "Document management with Paperless-ngx (OCR) and Stirling-PDF (utilities)"

  service_urls = {
    paperless_internal    = "https://docs.${var.domain_internal}"
    paperless_public      = "https://docs.${var.domain_public}"
    stirling_pdf_internal = "https://pdf.${var.domain_internal}"
    stirling_pdf_public   = "https://pdf.${var.domain_public}"
  }

  services = [
    { name = "Paperless-ngx", port = 8000, info = "Document management with OCR" },
    { name = "Stirling-PDF", port = 8080, info = "PDF manipulation tools" },
    { name = "PostgreSQL", port = 5432, info = "Paperless database (internal)" },
    { name = "Redis", port = 6379, info = "Paperless cache (internal)" }
  ]

  custom_notes = <<-EOT
## Quick Commands

**View logs:**
```
cd /config && docker compose logs -f paperless
cd /config && docker compose logs -f stirling-pdf
```

**Restart services:**
```
cd /config && docker compose restart paperless
cd /config && docker compose restart stirling-pdf
```

**Import documents:**
Place files in `/config/consume/` - they'll be automatically imported.

**Export all documents:**
```
cd /config && docker compose exec paperless document_exporter ../export/
```

## Managed by OpenTofu

Run `task tofu:apply APP=documents` to update.
EOT

  tags = ["documents", "paperless", "pdf", "ocr"]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Backup Configuration - PBS Client
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "documents_sidecars" {
  source = "../../modules/lxc-sidecars"

  container_id   = module.documents.container_id
  container_ip   = module.documents.ip_address
  container_name = "documents"

  proxmox_ssh_host             = local.proxmox_ssh_host
  proxmox_ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  backup = {
    enabled   = true
    schedule  = "daily"
    retention = "7"

    pre_backup_commands = [{
      name    = "PostgreSQL dump (Paperless)"
      command = "docker exec paperless-db pg_dump -U paperless -d paperless --clean --if-exists | gzip > /config/paperless-db-backup.sql.gz"
      timeout = 300
    }]

    include_paths = ["/config", "/var/lib/docker/volumes"]
    exclude_paths = ["/var/lib/docker/overlay2"]

    ntfy_priority = "default"
    ntfy_tags     = "backup,documents,paperless"
    ntfy_user     = "pbs-backup"
    ntfy_password = local.op.ntfy_pbs_backup_password
  }

  # Container monitoring agents
  pulse_agent = {
    enabled     = true
    pulse_token = local.agent_tokens["documents"].pulse_token
  }

  arcane_agent = {
    enabled         = true
    bootstrap_token = local.agent_tokens["documents"].arcane_bootstrap_token
  }

  alloy_agent = {
    enabled  = true
    username = local.op.alloy_telemetry_username
    password = local.op.alloy_telemetry_password
  }

  depends_on = [module.documents]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Cloud Backup - rclone to Backblaze B2
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Generate rclone config from 1Password secrets
resource "local_sensitive_file" "rclone_conf" {
  filename = "${path.module}/.tmp/rclone.conf"
  content  = <<-CONF
[b2]
type = b2
account = ${local.op.b2_account_id}
key = ${local.op.b2_application_key}
hard_delete = true

[b2-crypt]
type = crypt
remote = b2:rambtech-homelab/documents
password = ${local.op.rclone_crypt_password}
password2 = ${local.op.rclone_crypt_password2}
CONF
}

# Install rclone via Ansible
resource "ansible_navigator_run" "install_rclone" {
  depends_on = [module.documents]

  triggers = {
    container_id = var.container_id
  }

  execution_environment = {
    enabled = false
  }

  ansible_options = {
    private_keys = [{
      name = "homelab"
      data = file(var.ssh_private_key_path)
    }]
  }

  playbook = <<-EOT
    - name: Install rclone for cloud backup
      hosts: lxc
      gather_facts: no

      tasks:
        - name: Install required packages
          ansible.builtin.apt:
            name:
              - unzip
              - curl
              - cron
            state: present
            update_cache: yes
            cache_valid_time: 3600

        - name: Check if rclone is installed
          ansible.builtin.command:
            cmd: which rclone
          register: rclone_check
          changed_when: false
          failed_when: false

        - name: Install rclone
          ansible.builtin.shell:
            cmd: curl -fsSL https://rclone.org/install.sh | bash
          when: rclone_check.rc != 0

        - name: Create rclone config directory
          ansible.builtin.file:
            path: /root/.config/rclone
            state: directory
            mode: '0700'
  EOT

  inventory = yamlencode({
    lxc = {
      hosts = {
        "documents" = {
          ansible_host = module.documents.ip_address
          ansible_user = "root"
        }
      }
    }
  })
}

# Deploy rclone config
resource "filesync_file" "rclone_conf" {
  source      = local_sensitive_file.rclone_conf.filename
  destination = "/root/.config/rclone/rclone.conf"
  host        = module.documents.ip_address

  mode         = "0600"
  ssh_user     = "root"
  ssh_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  depends_on = [ansible_navigator_run.install_rclone]
}

# Deploy cloud-sync script
resource "filesync_file" "cloud_sync_script" {
  source      = "${path.module}/deploy/cloud-sync.sh"
  destination = "/usr/local/bin/cloud-sync.sh"
  host        = module.documents.ip_address

  mode         = "0755"
  ssh_user     = "root"
  ssh_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  depends_on = [ansible_navigator_run.install_rclone]
}

# Configure cron job for cloud backup
resource "ansible_navigator_run" "configure_cron" {
  depends_on = [
    filesync_file.cloud_sync_script,
    filesync_file.rclone_conf
  ]

  triggers = {
    container_id   = var.container_id
    cloud_schedule = var.cloud_backup_schedule
  }

  execution_environment = {
    enabled = false
  }

  ansible_options = {
    private_keys = [{
      name = "homelab"
      data = file(var.ssh_private_key_path)
    }]
  }

  playbook = <<-EOT
    - name: Configure cloud backup cron job
      hosts: lxc
      gather_facts: no
      vars:
        cloud_schedule: "${var.cloud_backup_schedule}"

      tasks:
        - name: Add cloud backup cron job (B2 sync)
          ansible.builtin.cron:
            name: "Cloud backup documents to B2"
            minute: "{{ cloud_schedule.split()[0] }}"
            hour: "{{ cloud_schedule.split()[1] }}"
            day: "{{ cloud_schedule.split()[2] }}"
            month: "{{ cloud_schedule.split()[3] }}"
            weekday: "{{ cloud_schedule.split()[4] }}"
            job: "/usr/local/bin/cloud-sync.sh documents >> /var/log/cloud-sync-documents.log 2>&1"
            user: root

        - name: Ensure cron service is enabled and running
          ansible.builtin.systemd:
            name: cron
            enabled: yes
            state: started

        - name: Display cron configuration
          ansible.builtin.debug:
            msg: "Cloud backup configured: {{ cloud_schedule }}"
  EOT

  inventory = yamlencode({
    lxc = {
      hosts = {
        "documents" = {
          ansible_host = module.documents.ip_address
          ansible_user = "root"
        }
      }
    }
  })
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Paperless-ngx route (internal only)
module "paperless_route" {
  source = "../../modules/traefik-route"
