# Document Management Stack
# Paperless-ngx (OCR document management) + Stirling-PDF (PDF utilities)

name: documents

services:
  # ==========================================================================
  # Paperless-ngx - Document Management with OCR
  # ==========================================================================
  # Self-hosted document management with full-text search, auto-tagging,
  # and email consumption. All documents are OCR'd for searchability.
  paperless:
    image: ghcr.io/paperless-ngx/paperless-ngx:2.20.3
    container_name: paperless
    environment:
      - PAPERLESS_REDIS=redis://paperless-redis:6379
      - PAPERLESS_DBHOST=paperless-db
      - PAPERLESS_DBNAME=paperless
      - PAPERLESS_DBUSER=paperless
      - PAPERLESS_DBPASS=${PAPERLESS_DB_PASSWORD}
      - PAPERLESS_SECRET_KEY=${PAPERLESS_SECRET_KEY}
      - PAPERLESS_URL=https://docs.homelab.rambtech.dev
      # Allow CSRF from both internal and public domains
      - PAPERLESS_CSRF_TRUSTED_ORIGINS=https://docs.homelab.rambtech.dev,https://docs.rambtech.dev
      - PAPERLESS_ALLOWED_HOSTS=docs.homelab.rambtech.dev,docs.rambtech.dev,localhost
      - PAPERLESS_CORS_ALLOWED_HOSTS=https://docs.homelab.rambtech.dev,https://docs.rambtech.dev
      - PAPERLESS_ADMIN_USER=${PAPERLESS_ADMIN_USER:-admin}
      - PAPERLESS_ADMIN_PASSWORD=${PAPERLESS_ADMIN_PASSWORD}
      - PAPERLESS_TIME_ZONE=America/New_York
      - PAPERLESS_OCR_LANGUAGE=eng
      - PAPERLESS_CONSUMER_POLLING=60
      - PAPERLESS_CONSUMER_RECURSIVE=true
      # Storage path: organize by year/title
      - PAPERLESS_FILENAME_FORMAT={created_year}/{title}
      - PAPERLESS_TASK_WORKERS=2
      - PAPERLESS_THREADS_PER_WORKER=2
      # OAuth/OIDC via Authentik (django-allauth)
      - PAPERLESS_APPS=allauth.socialaccount.providers.openid_connect
      - PAPERLESS_SOCIALACCOUNT_PROVIDERS=${PAPERLESS_SOCIALACCOUNT_PROVIDERS}
      - PAPERLESS_DISABLE_REGULAR_LOGIN=false
      - PAPERLESS_REDIRECT_LOGIN_TO_SSO=false
      - PAPERLESS_SOCIALACCOUNT_ALLOW_SIGNUPS=true
      # Auto-link accounts by email (skip email verification since Authentik already verified)
      - PAPERLESS_ACCOUNT_EMAIL_VERIFICATION=none
      - PAPERLESS_SOCIAL_AUTO_SIGNUP=true
    ports:
      - "8000:8000"
    volumes:
      - paperless-data:/usr/src/paperless/data
      - paperless-media:/usr/src/paperless/media
      - ./consume:/usr/src/paperless/consume
      - ./export:/usr/src/paperless/export
    depends_on:
      paperless-db:
        condition: service_healthy
      paperless-redis:
        condition: service_healthy
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 2048m
          cpus: '2.0'
        reservations:
          memory: 1024m
          cpus: '1.0'
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "curl -f http://localhost:8000/api/ || exit 1"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 60s
    restart: unless-stopped

  # ==========================================================================
  # PostgreSQL - Database for Paperless-ngx
  # ==========================================================================
  paperless-db:
    image: postgres:16-alpine
    container_name: paperless-db
    environment:
      - POSTGRES_USER=paperless
      - POSTGRES_PASSWORD=${PAPERLESS_DB_PASSWORD}
      - POSTGRES_DB=paperless
    volumes:
      - paperless-pgdata:/var/lib/postgresql/data
    shm_size: 128mb
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 1024m
          cpus: '1.0'
        reservations:
          memory: 512m
          cpus: '0.5'
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pg_isready -U paperless"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 5
      start_period: 30s
    restart: unless-stopped

  # ==========================================================================
  # Redis - Cache/Broker for Paperless-ngx
  # ==========================================================================
  paperless-redis:
    image: redis:8.4-alpine
    container_name: paperless-redis
    volumes:
      - paperless-redis-data:/data
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 512m
          cpus: '1.0'
        reservations:
          memory: 256m
          cpus: '0.5'
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "redis-cli", "ping"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 10s
    restart: unless-stopped

  # ==========================================================================
  # Stirling-PDF - PDF Manipulation Tools
  # ==========================================================================
  # Comprehensive PDF toolkit: merge, split, compress, OCR, convert, etc.
  # Stateless service - no persistent data needed.
  stirling-pdf:
    image: stirlingtools/stirling-pdf:2.1.5
    container_name: stirling-pdf
    environment:
      - DOCKER_ENABLE_SECURITY=false
      - SECURITY_ENABLELOGIN=false
      - SYSTEM_DEFAULTLOCALE=en_US
      - UI_APPNAME=Stirling PDF
      - UI_HOMEDESCRIPTION=PDF tools for the homelab
      - METRICS_ENABLED=false
    ports:
      - "8080:8080"
    volumes:
      # Training data for better OCR (optional)
      - stirling-tessdata:/usr/share/tessdata
      # Custom configurations
      - stirling-configs:/configs
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 2048m
          cpus: '2.0'
        reservations:
          memory: 1024m
          cpus: '1.0'
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "curl -sf http://localhost:8080/ | grep -q 'Stirling' || exit 1"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 30s
    restart: unless-stopped

volumes:
  paperless-data:
  paperless-media:
  paperless-pgdata:
  paperless-redis-data:
  stirling-tessdata:
  stirling-configs:

I don't see `PAPERLESS_CONSUMER_DELETE_DUPLICATES` or `PAPERLESS_CONSUMER_DELETE` set. By default, Paperless-ngx does **NOT** delete files from the consume folder after ingestion - this is by design so users can keep their original files.

Looking at the folder structure in consume, it seems like you're using it as a permanent organized input structure (Immigration, Tax, Work, etc.) rather than a temporary drop zone.

There are two options:

**Option 1: Exclude `/config/consume` from PBS backup**
- The consume folder appears to contain source documents you're organizing before/during ingestion
- Once ingested, they're in `paperless-media` (which IS backed up via volumes)
- Risk: If documents in consume haven't been ingested yet and the container is lost, you'd lose them

**Option 2: Keep it, but maybe it's also synced to cloud?**
- Check if consume is already backed up elsewhere (cloud sync, etc.)

Let me check if the cloud sync includes consume:

#!/bin/bash
# Cloud backup sync to Backblaze B2 (encrypted)
# Runs on LXC 504 (documents)
#
# Syncs Paperless-ngx media (documents) to B2
# The media folder contains the actual PDF/document files

set -eu

ACTION="${1:-documents}"
DRY_RUN=""
if [ "${2:-}" = "--dry-run" ]; then
    DRY_RUN="--dry-run"
    echo "=== DRY RUN MODE ==="
fi

# Use encrypted remote for documents
B2_CRYPT="b2-crypt:"

# Paperless media directory (actual document files)
# This is the docker volume mount point
DOCUMENTS_LOCAL="/var/lib/docker/volumes/documents_paperless-media/_data"

RCLONE_FLAGS="--progress --transfers 4 --checkers 8 --fast-list"

sync_documents() {
    echo "=== Syncing documents to B2 - ENCRYPTED ==="
    echo "Source: $DOCUMENTS_LOCAL"
    echo "Dest:   ${B2_CRYPT}documents"
    echo ""

    if [ ! -d "$DOCUMENTS_LOCAL" ]; then
        echo "ERROR: Source directory not found: $DOCUMENTS_LOCAL"
        echo "Make sure Paperless-ngx is running and has documents"
        exit 1
    fi

    rclone sync "$DOCUMENTS_LOCAL" "${B2_CRYPT}documents" \
        $RCLONE_FLAGS \
        --exclude "*.tmp" \
        --exclude "cache/**" \
        $DRY_RUN
}

show_status() {
    echo "=== B2 Documents Backup Status - Encrypted ==="
    echo ""
    echo "Remote contents:"
    rclone lsd ${B2_CRYPT}documents 2>/dev/null || echo "empty or not yet synced"
    echo ""
    echo "Remote size:"
    rclone size ${B2_CRYPT}documents 2>/dev/null || echo "not yet synced"
    echo ""
    echo "Local size:"
    du -sh "$DOCUMENTS_LOCAL" 2>/dev/null || echo "directory not found"
}

case "$ACTION" in
    documents|sync)
        sync_documents
        ;;
    status)
        show_status
        ;;
    *)
        echo "Usage: $0 [documents|status] [--dry-run]"
        exit 1
        ;;
esac

echo ""
echo "Done"

  ssh_user     = "root"
  ssh_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  depends_on = [ansible_navigator_run.install_rclone]
}

# Deploy cloud-sync script
resource "filesync_file" "cloud_sync_script" {
  source      = "${path.module}/deploy/cloud-sync.sh"
  destination = "/usr/local/bin/cloud-sync.sh"
  host        = module.documents.ip_address

  mode         = "0755"
  ssh_user     = "root"
  ssh_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  depends_on = [ansible_navigator_run.install_rclone]
}

# Configure cron job for cloud backup
resource "ansible_navigator_run" "configure_cron" {
  depends_on = [
    filesync_file.cloud_sync_script,
    filesync_file.rclone_conf
  ]

  triggers = {
    container_id   = var.container_id
    cloud_schedule = var.cloud_backup_schedule
  }

  execution_environment = {
    enabled = false
  }

  ansible_options = {
    private_keys = [{
      name = "homelab"
      data = file(var.ssh_private_key_path)
    }]
  }

  playbook = <<-EOT
    - name: Configure cloud backup cron job
      hosts: lxc
      gather_facts: no
      vars:
        cloud_schedule: "${var.cloud_backup_schedule}"

      tasks:
        - name: Add cloud backup cron job (B2 sync)
          ansible.builtin.cron:
            name: "Cloud backup documents to B2"
            minute: "{{ cloud_schedule.split()[0] }}"
            hour: "{{ cloud_schedule.split()[1] }}"
            day: "{{ cloud_schedule.split()[2] }}"
            month: "{{ cloud_schedule.split()[3] }}"
            weekday: "{{ cloud_schedule.split()[4] }}"
            job: "/usr/local/bin/cloud-sync.sh documents >> /var/log/cloud-sync-documents.log 2>&1"
            user: root

        - name: Ensure cron service is enabled and running
          ansible.builtin.systemd:
            name: cron
            enabled: yes
            state: started

        - name: Display cron configuration
          ansible.builtin.debug:
            msg: "Cloud backup configured: {{ cloud_schedule }}"
  EOT

  inventory = yamlencode({
    lxc = {
      hosts = {
        "documents" = {
          ansible_host = module.documents.ip_address
          ansible_user = "root"
        }
      }
    }
  })
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Traefik Routes - Self-Service Route Registration
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Paperless-ngx route (internal only)
module "paperless_route" {
  source = "../../modules/traefik-route"

  app_name    = "docs"
  backend_url = "http://${module.documents.ip_address}:8000"

  # Internal route (HTTPS via Let's Encrypt)
  internal_domain = "docs.${var.domain_internal}"
  public_domain   = "docs.${var.domain_public}"

  # Traefik config
  traefik_host         = local.traefik_ip
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  # Middlewares
  internal_middlewares = ["security-headers"]
  public_middlewares   = ["security-headers"]

  depends_on = [module.documents]
}

# Stirling-PDF route (internal only)
module "stirling_pdf_route" {
  source = "../../modules/traefik-route"

  app_name    = "pdf"
  backend_url = "http://${module.documents.ip_address}:8080"

  # Internal route (HTTPS via Let's Encrypt)
  internal_domain = "pdf.${var.domain_internal}"
  public_domain   = "pdf.${var.domain_public}"

  # Traefik config
  traefik_host         = local.traefik_ip
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  # Middlewares - authentik provides SSO authentication
  internal_middlewares = ["security-headers", "authentik"]
  public_middlewares   = ["cloudflare-https", "security-headers", "authentik"]
  public_entrypoint    = ["web"]

  depends_on = [module.documents]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Outputs
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

output "container_id" {
  value = module.documents.container_id
}

output "ip_address" {
  value = module.documents.ip_address
}

output "ssh_command" {
  value = module.documents.ssh_command
}

output "urls" {
  value = {
    direct_paperless      = "http://${module.documents.ip_address}:8000"
    paperless_internal    = module.paperless_route.internal_url
    paperless_public      = module.paperless_route.public_url

    direct_stirling_pdf   = "http://${module.documents.ip_address}:8080"
    stirling_pdf_internal = module.stirling_pdf_route.internal_url
    stirling_pdf_public   = module.stirling_pdf_route.public_url
  }
}

output "traefik_config_paths" {
  description = "Paths to Traefik configs on Traefik LXC"
  value = {
    paperless    = module.paperless_route.remote_config_path
    stirling_pdf = module.stirling_pdf_route.remote_config_path
  }
}

output "cloud_backup_schedule" {
  description = "Cloud backup cron schedule (to Backblaze B2)"
  value       = var.cloud_backup_schedule
}

# Document Management Stack
# Paperless-ngx (OCR document management) + Stirling-PDF (PDF utilities)

name: documents

services:
  # ==========================================================================
  # Paperless-ngx - Document Management with OCR
  # ==========================================================================
  # Self-hosted document management with full-text search, auto-tagging,
  # and email consumption. All documents are OCR'd for searchability.
  paperless:
    image: ghcr.io/paperless-ngx/paperless-ngx:2.20.3
    container_name: paperless
    environment:
      - PAPERLESS_REDIS=redis://paperless-redis:6379
      - PAPERLESS_DBHOST=paperless-db
      - PAPERLESS_DBNAME=paperless
      - PAPERLESS_DBUSER=paperless
      - PAPERLESS_DBPASS=${PAPERLESS_DB_PASSWORD}
      - PAPERLESS_SECRET_KEY=${PAPERLESS_SECRET_KEY}
      - PAPERLESS_URL=https://docs.homelab.rambtech.dev
      # Allow CSRF from both internal and public domains
      - PAPERLESS_CSRF_TRUSTED_ORIGINS=https://docs.homelab.rambtech.dev,https://docs.rambtech.dev
      - PAPERLESS_ALLOWED_HOSTS=docs.homelab.rambtech.dev,docs.rambtech.dev,localhost
      - PAPERLESS_CORS_ALLOWED_HOSTS=https://docs.homelab.rambtech.dev,https://docs.rambtech.dev
      - PAPERLESS_ADMIN_USER=${PAPERLESS_ADMIN_USER:-admin}
      - PAPERLESS_ADMIN_PASSWORD=${PAPERLESS_ADMIN_PASSWORD}
      - PAPERLESS_TIME_ZONE=America/New_York
      - PAPERLESS_OCR_LANGUAGE=eng
      - PAPERLESS_CONSUMER_POLLING=60
      - PAPERLESS_CONSUMER_RECURSIVE=true
      # Storage path: organize by year/title
      - PAPERLESS_FILENAME_FORMAT={created_year}/{title}
      - PAPERLESS_TASK_WORKERS=2
      - PAPERLESS_THREADS_PER_WORKER=2
      # OAuth/OIDC via Authentik (django-allauth)
      - PAPERLESS_APPS=allauth.socialaccount.providers.openid_connect
      - PAPERLESS_SOCIALACCOUNT_PROVIDERS=${PAPERLESS_SOCIALACCOUNT_PROVIDERS}
      - PAPERLESS_DISABLE_REGULAR_LOGIN=false
      - PAPERLESS_REDIRECT_LOGIN_TO_SSO=false
      - PAPERLESS_SOCIALACCOUNT_ALLOW_SIGNUPS=true
      # Auto-link accounts by email (skip email verification since Authentik already verified)
      - PAPERLESS_ACCOUNT_EMAIL_VERIFICATION=none
      - PAPERLESS_SOCIAL_AUTO_SIGNUP=true
    ports:
      - "8000:8000"
    volumes:
      - paperless-data:/usr/src/paperless/data
      - paperless-media:/usr/src/paperless/media

# Document Management Stack
# Paperless-ngx (OCR document management) + Stirling-PDF (PDF utilities)

name: documents

services:
  # ==========================================================================
  # Paperless-ngx - Document Management with OCR
  # ==========================================================================
  # Self-hosted document management with full-text search, auto-tagging,
  # and email consumption. All documents are OCR'd for searchability.
  paperless:
    image: ghcr.io/paperless-ngx/paperless-ngx:2.20.3
    container_name: paperless
    environment:
      - PAPERLESS_REDIS=redis://paperless-redis:6379
      - PAPERLESS_DBHOST=paperless-db
      - PAPERLESS_DBNAME=paperless
      - PAPERLESS_DBUSER=paperless
      - PAPERLESS_DBPASS=${PAPERLESS_DB_PASSWORD}
      - PAPERLESS_SECRET_KEY=${PAPERLESS_SECRET_KEY}
      - PAPERLESS_URL=https://docs.homelab.rambtech.dev
      # Allow CSRF from both internal and public domains
      - PAPERLESS_CSRF_TRUSTED_ORIGINS=https://docs.homelab.rambtech.dev,https://docs.rambtech.dev
      - PAPERLESS_ALLOWED_HOSTS=docs.homelab.rambtech.dev,docs.rambtech.dev,localhost
      - PAPERLESS_CORS_ALLOWED_HOSTS=https://docs.homelab.rambtech.dev,https://docs.rambtech.dev
      - PAPERLESS_ADMIN_USER=${PAPERLESS_ADMIN_USER:-admin}
      - PAPERLESS_ADMIN_PASSWORD=${PAPERLESS_ADMIN_PASSWORD}
      - PAPERLESS_TIME_ZONE=America/New_York
      - PAPERLESS_OCR_LANGUAGE=eng
      - PAPERLESS_CONSUMER_POLLING=60
      - PAPERLESS_CONSUMER_RECURSIVE=true
      # Storage path: organize by year/title
      - PAPERLESS_FILENAME_FORMAT={created_year}/{title}
      - PAPERLESS_TASK_WORKERS=2
      - PAPERLESS_THREADS_PER_WORKER=2
      # OAuth/OIDC via Authentik (django-allauth)
      - PAPERLESS_APPS=allauth.socialaccount.providers.openid_connect
      - PAPERLESS_SOCIALACCOUNT_PROVIDERS=${PAPERLESS_SOCIALACCOUNT_PROVIDERS}
      - PAPERLESS_DISABLE_REGULAR_LOGIN=false
      - PAPERLESS_REDIRECT_LOGIN_TO_SSO=false
      - PAPERLESS_SOCIALACCOUNT_ALLOW_SIGNUPS=true
      # Auto-link accounts by email (skip email verification since Authentik already verified)
      - PAPERLESS_ACCOUNT_EMAIL_VERIFICATION=none
      - PAPERLESS_SOCIAL_AUTO_SIGNUP=true
    ports:
      - "8000:8000"
    volumes:
      - paperless-data:/usr/src/paperless/data
      - paperless-media:/usr/src/paperless/media
      - ./consume:/usr/src/paperless/consume
      - ./export:/usr/src/paperless/export
    depends_on:
      paperless-db:
        condition: service_healthy
      paperless-redis:
        condition: service_healthy
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 2048m
          cpus: '2.0'
        reservations:
          memory: 1024m
          cpus: '1.0'
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "curl -f http://localhost:8000/api/ || exit 1"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 60s
    restart: unless-stopped

  # ==========================================================================
  # PostgreSQL - Database for Paperless-ngx
  # ==========================================================================
  paperless-db:
    image: postgres:16-alpine
    container_name: paperless-db
    environment:
      - POSTGRES_USER=paperless
      - POSTGRES_PASSWORD=${PAPERLESS_DB_PASSWORD}
      - POSTGRES_DB=paperless
    volumes:
      - paperless-pgdata:/var/lib/postgresql/data
    shm_size: 128mb
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 1024m
          cpus: '1.0'
        reservations:
          memory: 512m
          cpus: '0.5'
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pg_isready -U paperless"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 5
      start_period: 30s
    restart: unless-stopped

  # ==========================================================================
  # Redis - Cache/Broker for Paperless-ngx
  # ==========================================================================
  paperless-redis:
    image: redis:8.4-alpine
    container_name: paperless-redis
    volumes:
      - paperless-redis-data:/data
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 512m
          cpus: '1.0'
        reservations:
          memory: 256m
          cpus: '0.5'
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "redis-cli", "ping"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 10s
    restart: unless-stopped

  # ==========================================================================
  # Stirling-PDF - PDF Manipulation Tools
  # ==========================================================================
  # Comprehensive PDF toolkit: merge, split, compress, OCR, convert, etc.
  # Stateless service - no persistent data needed.
  stirling-pdf:
    image: stirlingtools/stirling-pdf:2.1.5
    container_name: stirling-pdf
    environment:
      - DOCKER_ENABLE_SECURITY=false
      - SECURITY_ENABLELOGIN=false
      - SYSTEM_DEFAULTLOCALE=en_US
      - UI_APPNAME=Stirling PDF
      - UI_HOMEDESCRIPTION=PDF tools for the homelab
      - METRICS_ENABLED=false
    ports:
      - "8080:8080"
    volumes:
      # Training data for better OCR (optional)
      - stirling-tessdata:/usr/share/tessdata
      # Custom configurations
      - stirling-configs:/configs
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 2048m
          cpus: '2.0'
        reservations:
          memory: 1024m
          cpus: '1.0'
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "curl -sf http://localhost:8080/ | grep -q 'Stirling' || exit 1"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 30s
    restart: unless-stopped

volumes:
  paperless-data:
  paperless-media:
  paperless-pgdata:
  paperless-redis-data:
  stirling-tessdata:
  stirling-configs:

# =============================================================================
# Dashboards LXC - Homepage + Dashy + Glances
# =============================================================================
# Container ID: 201
#
# Uses the docker-lxc module - the gold standard pattern for Docker apps.
# =============================================================================

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1Password - Homepage API Keys
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

data "onepassword_item" "homepage" {
  vault = data.onepassword_vault.homelab.uuid
  title = "homepage"
}

locals {
  # Flatten all section fields from homepage item
  _homepage_fields = merge([
    for s in data.onepassword_item.homepage.section : {
      for f in s.field : f.label => f.value
    }
  ]...)

  # Homepage widget API keys
  homepage_env = {
    adguard_user   = lookup(local._homepage_fields, "adguard_user", "admin")
    adguard_pass   = lookup(local._homepage_fields, "adguard_pass", "")
    immich_key     = lookup(local._homepage_fields, "immich_key", "")
    jellyfin_key   = lookup(local._homepage_fields, "jellyfin_key", "")
    jellyseerr_key = lookup(local._homepage_fields, "jellyseerr_key", "")
    sonarr_key     = lookup(local._homepage_fields, "sonarr_key", "")
    radarr_key     = lookup(local._homepage_fields, "radarr_key", "")
    sabnzbd_key    = lookup(local._homepage_fields, "sabnzbd_key", "")
    qbit_user      = lookup(local._homepage_fields, "qbit_user", "admin")
    qbit_pass      = lookup(local._homepage_fields, "qbit_pass", "")
  }
}

# Generate the homepage.env file from 1Password secrets
resource "local_sensitive_file" "homepage_env" {
  filename = "${path.module}/deploy/homepage.env"
  content  = <<-EOT
# Homepage Widget API Keys
# Auto-generated by OpenTofu from 1Password
# DO NOT EDIT - changes will be overwritten

# AdGuard Home: Web UI credentials
HOMEPAGE_VAR_ADGUARD_USER=${local.homepage_env.adguard_user}

# Authentik LXC - Identity Provider (SSO/OIDC)
# =============================================================================
# Container ID: 203
#
# Replaces Authelia with a more feature-rich identity provider:
#   - Native Google/GitHub OAuth federation
#   - OIDC provider for apps with native SSO support
#   - Forward auth for apps without native OAuth
#   - Centralized user/group management
#
# File Structure:
#   - main.tf:      Container, env, routes, sidecars
#   - providers.tf: OAuth sources, forward auth, OIDC providers
#   - users.tf:     User management (SOPS-encrypted)
#   - outputs.tf:   All outputs

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Variables
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

variable "container_id" {
  description = "Container ID for Authentik LXC"
  type        = number
  default     = 203
}

variable "cores" {
  description = "CPU cores"
  type        = number
  default     = 2
}

variable "memory" {
  description = "Memory in MB"
  type        = number
  default     = 4096  # Authentik recommended minimum
}

variable "swap" {
  description = "Swap in MB"

variable "rootfs_size" {

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Authentik Container
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "authentik" {
  source = "../../modules/docker-lxc"

  name         = "authentik"
  container_id = var.container_id
  proxmox_node = var.proxmox_node

  # Network (container network only - Traefik handles external access)
  container_ip = "${local.ip_registry.dashboards.authentik}${local.network.container_netmask}"

  # Resources
  cores  = var.cores
  memory = var.memory
  swap   = var.swap

  rootfs_storage = "nvme-containers"
  rootfs_size    = var.rootfs_size

  # Unprivileged container (security hardened)
  unprivileged = true

  # Deployment
  deploy_dir  = "${path.module}/deploy"
  target_path = "/config"

  # Exclude .env template files (we generate .env from template)
  exclude_patterns = ["^\\.env"]

  # SSH
  ssh_public_key       = local.ssh_public_key
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path
  proxmox_ssh_host     = local.proxmox_ssh_host

  # Template with Docker pre-installed
  template = var.lxc_template_docker

  # Proxmox Notes
  service_name        = "Authentik"
  service_description = "Identity Provider - SSO, OIDC, and forward auth for all homelab services"

  service_urls = {
    admin    = "https://auth.${var.domain_internal}/if/admin/"
    user     = "https://auth.${var.domain_internal}/if/user/"
    direct   = "http://${local.ip_registry.dashboards.authentik}:9000"
  }

  services = [
    { name = "Authentik HTTP", port = 9000, info = "Web UI and API" },
    { name = "Authentik HTTPS", port = 9443, info = "HTTPS (self-signed)" },

  custom_notes = <<-EOT
## Initial Setup

1. Access the admin interface at https://auth.${var.domain_internal}/if/admin/
2. Login with credentials from 1Password (item: authentik)
3. Configure Google OAuth source for SSO

## Forward Auth Endpoint

Add this middleware to Traefik routes for protected services:
```yaml
middlewares:
  authentik:
    forwardAuth:
      address: https://auth.${var.domain_public}/outpost.goauthentik.io/auth/traefik
      trustForwardHeader: true
      authResponseHeaders:
        - X-authentik-username
        - X-authentik-groups
        - X-authentik-email
        - X-authentik-name
        - X-authentik-uid
        - X-authentik-jwt

        - X-authentik-meta-outpost
        - X-authentik-meta-provider
        - X-authentik-meta-app
        - X-authentik-meta-version
```

```bash
# View server logs

# View worker logs

# Database backup

```

For apps with native OIDC support, create a Provider in Authentik:
1. Admin → Providers → Create OAuth2/OIDC Provider
2. Set redirect URI for the app
3. Create Application linking to the provider
4. Use client_id and client_secret in the app config

resource "local_sensitive_file" "authentik_env" {
  content = templatefile("${path.module}/deploy/.env.tpl", {

    secret_key        = local.op.authentik_secret_key
    admin_email       = "admin@${var.domain_internal}"
    admin_password    = local.op.authentik_admin_password

resource "filesync_file" "authentik_env" {

  destination = "/config/.env"
  host        = module.authentik.ip_address

  mode = "0600"

  depends_on = [module.authentik]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Traefik Route - Self-Service Route Registration
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "authentik_route" {
  source = "../../modules/traefik-route"

  app_name    = "authentik"
  backend_url = "http://${module.authentik.ip_address}:9000"

  # Internal route (HTTPS via Let's Encrypt)
  # Using "auth" subdomain to match Authelia for easier migration
  internal_domain = "auth.${var.domain_internal}"

  # Public route for external access (Google OAuth redirect)
  public_domain = "auth.${var.domain_public}"

  # Traefik config
  traefik_host         = local.traefik_ip
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  # No auth middleware on the auth service itself!
  internal_middlewares = ["security-headers"]
  # cloudflare-https sets X-Forwarded-Proto: https to fix mixed content issues
  public_middlewares   = ["cloudflare-https", "security-headers"]
  # Use "web" entrypoint for public - Cloudflare handles TLS and forwards HTTP to origin
  public_entrypoint    = ["web"]

  depends_on = [module.authentik]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Traefik Forward Auth Middleware
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Generates the forwardAuth middleware config and syncs to Traefik

resource "local_file" "traefik_middleware" {
  content = templatefile("${path.module}/deploy/traefik-middleware.yml.tpl", {
    authentik_ip = module.authentik.ip_address
  })
  filename = "${path.module}/.terraform/authentik-middleware.yml"
}

resource "filesync_file" "traefik_middleware" {
  source      = local_file.traefik_middleware.filename
  destination = "/config/dynamic/authentik-middleware.yml"
  host        = local.traefik_ip

  mode = "0644"

  depends_on = [module.authentik, local_file.traefik_middleware]
}

# Backup Configuration - PBS Client + Sidecars
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "authentik_sidecars" {
  source = "../../modules/lxc-sidecars"

  container_id   = module.authentik.container_id
  container_ip   = module.authentik.ip_address
  container_name = "authentik"

  proxmox_ssh_host             = local.proxmox_ssh_host
  proxmox_ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  backup = {
    enabled   = true
    schedule  = "Sun 03:00"  # Weekly backup
    retention = "4"          # Keep 4 weekly backups

    # Dump PostgreSQL before backup
    pre_backup_commands = [
      {
        name    = "Backup PostgreSQL database"
        command = "docker exec authentik-postgres pg_dump -U authentik authentik > /config/authentik-db-backup.sql"
        timeout = 120
      }
    ]

    include_paths = ["/config"]
    exclude_paths = ["/var/lib/docker/overlay2"]

    ntfy_priority = "default"
    ntfy_tags     = "backup,authentik"
    ntfy_user     = "pbs-backup"
    ntfy_password = local.op.ntfy_pbs_backup_password
  }

  # Container monitoring agents
  pulse_agent = {
    enabled     = true
    pulse_token = local.agent_tokens["authentik"].pulse_token
  }

  arcane_agent = {
    enabled         = true
    bootstrap_token = local.agent_tokens["authentik"].arcane_bootstrap_token
  }

  alloy_agent = {
    enabled  = true
    username = local.op.alloy_telemetry_username
    password = local.op.alloy_telemetry_password
  }

  depends_on = [module.authentik]
}

# =============================================================================
# Monitoring LXC - Loki + Alloy + Prometheus + Grafana + Uptime Kuma + ntfy
# =============================================================================
# Container ID: 500
#
# Uses the docker-lxc module - the gold standard pattern for Docker apps.
# Observability stack for logs, metrics, dashboards, and alerting.
# =============================================================================

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Variables
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

variable "container_id" {
  type    = number
  default = 500
}

variable "cores" {
  type    = number
  default = 4
}

variable "memory" {
  type    = number
  default = 4096
}

variable "rootfs_size" {
  type    = number
  default = 32
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Monitoring Container
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "monitoring" {
  source = "../../modules/docker-lxc"

  name         = "monitoring"
  container_id = var.container_id
  proxmox_node = var.proxmox_node

  # Network (container network only)
  container_ip = "${local.ip_registry.monitoring.monitoring}${local.network.container_netmask}"

  # Resources
  cores  = var.cores
  memory = var.memory
  swap   = 1024

  rootfs_storage = "tank"
  rootfs_size    = var.rootfs_size

  # Unprivileged container (security hardened)
  unprivileged = true

  # Deployment
  deploy_dir  = "${path.module}/deploy"
  target_path = "/config"

  # SSH
  ssh_public_key       = local.ssh_public_key
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path
  proxmox_ssh_host     = local.proxmox_ssh_host

  # Template with Docker pre-installed
  template = var.lxc_template_docker

  # Proxmox Notes
  service_name        = "Monitoring"
  service_description = "Observability stack with Loki, Alloy, Prometheus, Grafana, and alerting"

  service_urls = {
    grafana           = "https://grafana.${var.domain_internal}"
    prometheus        = "https://prometheus.${var.domain_internal}"
    alertmanager      = "https://alertmanager.${var.domain_internal}"
    uptime_kuma       = "https://status.${var.domain_internal}"
    ntfy              = "https://ntfy.${var.domain_internal}"
    direct_loki       = "http://${local.lan_ips.monitoring}:3100"
    direct_alloy_grpc = "http://${local.lan_ips.monitoring}:4317"
    direct_alloy_http = "http://${local.lan_ips.monitoring}:4318"
  }

  services = [
    { name = "Loki", port = 3100, info = "Log aggregation" },
    { name = "Alloy (gRPC)", port = 4317, info = "OTLP gRPC receiver" },
    { name = "Alloy (HTTP)", port = 4318, info = "OTLP HTTP receiver" },
    { name = "Alloy UI", port = 12345, info = "Alloy debug UI" },
    { name = "Prometheus", port = 9090, info = "Metrics storage and alerting" },
    { name = "Grafana", port = 3000, info = "Dashboards and visualization" },
    { name = "Alertmanager", port = 9093, info = "Alert routing" },
    { name = "Uptime Kuma", port = 3001, info = "HTTP monitoring and status page" },
    { name = "ntfy", port = 8080, info = "Push notifications" }
  ]

  custom_notes = <<-EOT
## Alloy OTLP Endpoints (for Proxmox/Immich)

**OTLP gRPC:** ${local.lan_ips.monitoring}:4317
**OTLP HTTP:** ${local.lan_ips.monitoring}:4318

Configure Proxmox metrics server:
```bash
pvesh create /cluster/metrics/server \
  --id homelab-alloy \
  --type opentelemetry \
  --server ${local.lan_ips.monitoring} \
  --port 4317 \
  --proto grpc
```

## Loki Endpoint (for Alloy sidecars)

**Loki URL:** http://${local.lan_ips.monitoring}:3100

## Grafana

Default login: admin / (password in 1Password)

## ntfy Topics

- `homelab-alerts` - Prometheus alerts
- `homelab-status` - Uptime Kuma notifications

Subscribe via mobile app or web UI.

## Quick Commands

```bash
# View Alloy logs
docker logs -f alloy

# View Loki logs
docker logs -f loki

# Query logs via Loki API
curl -s "http://localhost:3100/loki/api/v1/labels" | jq

# Reload Prometheus config
curl -X POST http://localhost:9090/-/reload

# Test ntfy notification
curl -d "Test notification" http://localhost:8080/homelab-alerts
```

## Managed by OpenTofu

Run `task tofu:apply APP=monitoring` to update.
EOT

  tags = ["monitoring", "loki", "alloy", "prometheus", "grafana"]

  # Pass env content to module - synced BEFORE docker compose runs
  env_content = templatefile("${path.module}/deploy/.env.tpl", {
    grafana_admin_password = local.op.grafana_admin_password
    uptime_kuma_username   = local.op.uptime_kuma_username
    uptime_kuma_password   = local.op.uptime_kuma_password
    discord_webhook_url    = local.op.discord_webhook_url
    # Grafana OAuth/OIDC via Authentik
    grafana_oauth_client_id     = authentik_provider_oauth2.grafana.client_id
    grafana_oauth_client_secret = random_password.grafana_oidc_secret.result
    grafana_oauth_auth_url      = "https://auth.${var.domain_public}/application/o/authorize/"
    grafana_oauth_token_url     = "https://auth.${var.domain_public}/application/o/token/"
    grafana_oauth_api_url       = "https://auth.${var.domain_public}/application/o/userinfo/"
    grafana_oauth_signout_url   = "https://auth.${var.domain_public}/application/o/grafana/end-session/"
    # ntfy credentials for Alertmanager
    ntfy_alertmanager_password = local.op.ntfy_alertmanager_password
    # ntfy credentials for Discord forwarder
    ntfy_discord_forwarder_password = local.op.ntfy_discord_forwarder_password
  })
}

# Note: .env file is now handled by the docker-lxc module via env_content
# This ensures the .env is synced BEFORE docker compose runs

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# ntfy User Provisioning (Ansible)
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Provisions ntfy users and ACL after container deployment

resource "ansible_navigator_run" "ntfy_provision" {
  triggers = {
    container_id = module.monitoring.container_id
    container_ip = module.monitoring.ip_address
    # Re-run if credentials change
    credentials_hash = sha256(join(",", [
      local.op.ntfy_admin_password,
      local.op.ntfy_darshan_password,
      local.op.ntfy_alertmanager_password,
      local.op.ntfy_pbs_backup_password,
      local.op.ntfy_n8n_password,
      local.op.ntfy_uptime_kuma_password,
      local.op.ntfy_discord_forwarder_password,
    ]))
  }

  execution_environment = {
    enabled = false
  }

  ansible_options = {
    private_keys = [{
      name = "homelab"
      data = file(var.ssh_private_key_path)
    }]
  }

  playbook = templatefile("${path.module}/deploy/ntfy/provision-users.yml.tpl", {
    ntfy_admin_user                 = local.op.ntfy_admin_user
    ntfy_admin_password             = local.op.ntfy_admin_password
    ntfy_darshan_password           = local.op.ntfy_darshan_password
    ntfy_alertmanager_password      = local.op.ntfy_alertmanager_password
    ntfy_pbs_backup_password        = local.op.ntfy_pbs_backup_password
    ntfy_n8n_password               = local.op.ntfy_n8n_password
    ntfy_uptime_kuma_password       = local.op.ntfy_uptime_kuma_password
    ntfy_discord_forwarder_password = local.op.ntfy_discord_forwarder_password
  })

  inventory = yamlencode({
    monitoring = {
      hosts = {
        "monitoring" = {
          ansible_host = module.monitoring.ip_address
          ansible_user = "root"
        }
      }
    }
  })

  depends_on = [module.monitoring]
}

  source = "../../modules/traefik-route"

  app_name    = "grafana"
  backend_url = "http://${module.monitoring.ip_address}:3000"

  internal_middlewares = ["security-headers"]

}

  internal_domain = "prometheus.${var.domain_internal}"

  traefik_host         = local.traefik_ip
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  # Middlewares - authentik provides SSO authentication

module "alertmanager_route" {

  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  internal_middlewares = ["security-headers", "authentik"]

  depends_on = [module.monitoring]

module "ntfy_route" {
  source = "../../modules/traefik-route"

  app_name    = "ntfy"
  backend_url = "http://${module.monitoring.ip_address}:8080"

  internal_domain = "ntfy.${var.domain_internal}"

  traefik_host         = local.traefik_ip
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  # ntfy has its own ACL-based authentication - no Authentik middleware
  internal_middlewares = ["security-headers"]

  depends_on = [module.monitoring]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Backup Configuration - PBS Client
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "monitoring_sidecars" {
  source = "../../modules/lxc-sidecars"

  container_id   = module.monitoring.container_id
  container_ip   = module.monitoring.ip_address
  container_name = "monitoring"

  proxmox_ssh_host             = local.proxmox_ssh_host
  proxmox_ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  backup = {
    enabled   = true

    retention = "4"          # Keep 4 weekly backups

# =============================================================================
# Network Services LXC - AdGuard + Cloudflared + DDNS
# =============================================================================
# Container ID: 101
#
# Core network infrastructure: DNS (AdGuard Home), Cloudflare tunnel, DDNS.
# Tailscale runs as systemd service (requires kernel access).
# =============================================================================

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Variables
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

variable "container_id" {
  type    = number
  default = 101
}

variable "cores" {
  type    = number
  default = 2
}

variable "memory" {
  type    = number
  default = 2048
}

variable "rootfs_size" {
  type    = number
  default = 4
}

variable "cloudflare_ddns_domains" {
  type    = string
  default = "homelab.rambtech.dev"
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Network Services Container
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "network_services" {
  source = "../../modules/docker-lxc"

  name         = "network-services"
  container_id = var.container_id
  proxmox_node = var.proxmox_node

  # Network (dual-NIC: container network + LAN for DNS service)
  container_ip = "${local.ip_registry.core.network_services}${local.network.container_netmask}"
  lan_ip       = "${local.lan_ips.network_services}${local.network.lan_netmask}"

  # Resources
  cores  = var.cores
  memory = var.memory
  swap   = 1024

  rootfs_storage = "nvme-containers"
  rootfs_size    = var.rootfs_size

  # Privileged for Tailscale kernel access
  unprivileged = false

  # Deployment
  deploy_dir  = "${path.module}/deploy"
  target_path = "/config"

  # Exclude AdGuard config - managed separately via templating for dns_mode toggle
  exclude_patterns = ["AdGuardHome\\.yaml$", "\\.tpl$"]

  # SSH
  ssh_public_key       = local.ssh_public_key
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path
  proxmox_ssh_host     = local.proxmox_ssh_host

  # Template
  template = var.lxc_template_docker

  # Proxmox Notes
  service_name        = "Network Services"
  service_description = "Core network infrastructure: DNS, tunnels, and VPN"

  service_urls = {
    adguard_internal = "https://dns.${var.domain_internal}"
    adguard_direct   = "http://${local.lan_ips.network_services}:3000"
  }

  services = [
    { name = "AdGuard Home", port = 53, info = "DNS server with ad blocking" },
    { name = "AdGuard UI", port = 3000, info = "Web management interface" },
    { name = "Cloudflared", port = 0, info = "Cloudflare tunnel (outbound only)" },
    { name = "Tailscale", port = 41641, info = "Mesh VPN (systemd service)" }
  ]

  custom_notes = <<-EOT
## Tailscale Management

Tailscale runs as a systemd service (not Docker) because it requires kernel-level network access.

**Check status:**
```bash
systemctl status tailscaled
tailscale status
```

**Restart if needed:**
```bash
systemctl restart tailscaled
```

## Docker Services

**View logs:**
```bash
cd /config && docker compose logs -f <service>
```

**Restart all services:**
```bash
cd /config && docker compose restart
```

## DNS Testing

**Test AdGuard (port 53):**
```bash
dig @${local.lan_ips.network_services} google.com
```

**Test internal DNS rewrites:**
```bash
dig @${local.lan_ips.network_services} traefik.homelab.rambtech.dev
```

## Managed by OpenTofu

Run `task tofu:apply APP=network-services` to update.
EOT

  tags = ["network-services", "dns", "adguard", "cloudflare"]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Create .env file with secrets
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Generate .env file locally with secrets from 1Password, then sync to container

resource "local_sensitive_file" "network_services_env" {
  content = <<-EOT
# Network Services Environment Variables
# Auto-generated by OpenTofu from 1Password
# DO NOT EDIT - changes will be overwritten

# Cloudflare Tunnel Token
CLOUDFLARE_TUNNEL_TOKEN=${local.op.cloudflare_tunnel_token}

# Cloudflare API Token for DDNS
CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN=${local.op.cloudflare_api_token}

# Domains to update with DDNS
CLOUDFLARE_DDNS_DOMAINS=${var.cloudflare_ddns_domains}
EOT

  filename        = "${path.module}/.terraform/network-services.env"
  file_permission = "0600"
}

resource "filesync_file" "network_services_env" {
  source      = local_sensitive_file.network_services_env.filename
  destination = "/config/.env"
  host        = module.network_services.ip_address

  mode = "0600"

  depends_on = [module.network_services]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# AdGuard Home Configuration (DNS Mode Toggle)
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Generates AdGuard config based on dns_mode variable:
# - home: Uses LAN IPs (192.168.1.x) - works on home network without Tailscale
# - travel: Uses container IPs (10.100.x.x) - routes through Tailscale, avoids subnet conflicts

locals {
  # Select IP based on dns_mode
  adguard_traefik_ip = var.dns_mode == "travel" ? local.ip_registry.dashboards.traefik : local.lan_ips.traefik
}

resource "local_file" "adguard_config" {
  content = templatefile("${path.module}/deploy/adguard/conf/AdGuardHome.yaml.tpl", {
    dns_mode   = var.dns_mode
    traefik_ip = local.adguard_traefik_ip
  })

  filename        = "${path.module}/.terraform/AdGuardHome.yaml"
  file_permission = "0644"
}

resource "filesync_file" "adguard_config" {
  source      = local_file.adguard_config.filename
  destination = "/config/adguard/conf/AdGuardHome.yaml"
  host        = module.network_services.ip_address

  mode = "0644"

  depends_on = [module.network_services]
}

# Restart AdGuard when config changes
resource "null_resource" "restart_adguard" {
  triggers = {
    config_hash = local_file.adguard_config.content_md5
  }

  provisioner "remote-exec" {
    inline = [
      "docker restart adguard || true"
    ]

    connection {
      type        = "ssh"
      user        = "root"
      host        = module.network_services.ip_address
      private_key = file(var.ssh_private_key_path)
    }
  }

  depends_on = [filesync_file.adguard_config]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Tailscale Service Management via Ansible
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Ensures Tailscale daemon is running and connected after deployment

resource "ansible_navigator_run" "manage_tailscale" {
  depends_on = [module.network_services]

  # Re-run when container is rebuilt or network config changes
  triggers = {
    container_id = var.container_id
    lan_ip       = local.lan_ips.network_services
  }

  execution_environment = {
    enabled = false  # Run ansible directly on host
  }

  ansible_options = {
    private_keys = [{
      name = "homelab"
      data = file(var.ssh_private_key_path)
    }]
  }

  playbook = <<-EOT
    - name: Manage Tailscale service on network-services
      hosts: lxc
      gather_facts: no
      vars:
        app_name: network-services

      tasks:
        # =====================================================================
        # Tailscale Service Management
        # =====================================================================
        - name: Ensure Tailscale daemon is running
          ansible.builtin.systemd:
            name: tailscaled
            state: started
            enabled: true
          register: tailscale_service

        - name: Wait for Tailscale to initialize
          ansible.builtin.pause:
            seconds: 3
          when: tailscale_service.changed

        # =====================================================================
        # Verify Tailscale Status
        # =====================================================================
        - name: Check Tailscale connection status
          ansible.builtin.command:
            cmd: tailscale status --json
          register: tailscale_status
          changed_when: false
          failed_when: false

        - name: Parse Tailscale status
          ansible.builtin.set_fact:
            tailscale_info: "{{ tailscale_status.stdout | from_json }}"
          when: tailscale_status.rc == 0

        - name: Display Tailscale connection info
          ansible.builtin.debug:
            msg: |
              Tailscale Status: {{ 'Connected' if (tailscale_info.BackendState | default('')) == 'Running' else 'Not Connected' }}
              Tailnet IP: {{ tailscale_info.Self.TailscaleIPs[0] | default('N/A') }}
              Hostname: {{ tailscale_info.Self.HostName | default('N/A') }}
          when: tailscale_status.rc == 0

        - name: Warn if Tailscale not connected
          ansible.builtin.debug:
            msg: "WARNING: Tailscale is not connected. Check authentication status with 'tailscale status'"
          when: tailscale_status.rc != 0 or (tailscale_info.BackendState | default('')) != 'Running'
  EOT

  inventory = yamlencode({
    lxc = {
      hosts = {
        "network-services" = {
          ansible_host = module.network_services.ip_address
          ansible_user = "root"
        }
      }
    }
  })
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Traefik Route for AdGuard Home UI
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "adguard_route" {
  source = "../../modules/traefik-route"

  app_name    = "dns"
  backend_url = "http://${module.network_services.ip_address}:3000"

  internal_domain = "dns.${var.domain_internal}"
  public_domain   = ""  # DNS admin UI should not be public

  traefik_host         = local.traefik_ip
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  # Middlewares - authentik provides SSO authentication
  internal_middlewares = ["security-headers", "authentik"]

  depends_on = [module.network_services]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Backup Configuration - PBS Client
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "network_services_sidecars" {
  source = "../../modules/lxc-sidecars"

  container_id   = module.network_services.container_id
  container_ip   = module.network_services.ip_address
  container_name = "network-services"

  proxmox_ssh_host             = local.proxmox_ssh_host
  proxmox_ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  backup = {
    enabled   = true
    schedule  = "Sun 03:00"  # Weekly backup
    retention = "4"          # Keep 4 weekly backups

    pre_backup_commands = []  # No database - config only

    include_paths = ["/config"]
    exclude_paths = ["/var/lib/docker/overlay2"]

    ntfy_priority = "default"
    ntfy_tags     = "backup,network-services"
    ntfy_user     = "pbs-backup"
    ntfy_password = local.op.ntfy_pbs_backup_password
  }

  # Container monitoring agents
  pulse_agent = {
    enabled     = true
    pulse_token = local.agent_tokens["network-services"].pulse_token
  }

  arcane_agent = {
    enabled         = true
    bootstrap_token = local.agent_tokens["network-services"].arcane_bootstrap_token
  }

  alloy_agent = {
    enabled  = true
    username = local.op.alloy_telemetry_username
    password = local.op.alloy_telemetry_password
  }

  depends_on = [module.network_services]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Outputs

output "ip_address" {
  value = module.network_services.ip_address
}

output "ssh_command" {
  value = module.network_services.ssh_command

output "urls" {
  value = {
    adguard_internal = module.adguard_route.internal_url
  }
}

output "traefik_config_path" {
  value = module.adguard_route.remote_config_path
}

output "dns_mode" {
  description = "Current DNS mode (home=LAN IPs, travel=container IPs for Tailscale)"
  value       = var.dns_mode
}

output "dns_traefik_ip" {
  description = "IP address that AdGuard returns for *.homelab.rambtech.dev"
  value       = local.adguard_traefik_ip

# =============================================================================
# Traefik LXC - Reverse Proxy & Ingress Controller
# =============================================================================
# Container ID: 200
#
# This deployment uses the docker-lxc module which handles:
#   1. LXC container creation with Docker pre-installed
#   2. File sync via rsync (file-sync module)
#   3. Docker Compose deployment
#   4. Proxmox notes generation
# =============================================================================

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# App-specific Variables
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

variable "container_id" {
  description = "Container ID for Traefik LXC"
  type        = number
  default     = 200
}

variable "cores" {
  description = "CPU cores"
  type        = number
  default     = 2
}

variable "memory" {
  description = "Memory in MB"
  type        = number
  default     = 2048
}

variable "swap" {
  description = "Swap in MB"
  type        = number
  default     = 1024
}

variable "rootfs_size" {
  description = "Root filesystem size in GB"
  type        = number
  default     = 8
}

variable "rootfs_storage" {
  description = "Storage pool for root filesystem"
  type        = string
  default     = "nvme-containers"
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Traefik Container
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "traefik" {
  source = "../../modules/docker-lxc"

  name         = "traefik"
  container_id = var.container_id
  proxmox_node = var.proxmox_node

  # Network (dual-NIC: container network + LAN for external access)
  container_ip = "${local.ip_registry.dashboards.traefik}${local.network.container_netmask}"
  lan_ip       = "${local.lan_ips.traefik}${local.network.lan_netmask}"

  # Resources
  cores  = var.cores
  memory = var.memory
  swap   = var.swap

  rootfs_storage = var.rootfs_storage
  rootfs_size    = var.rootfs_size

  # MUST be privileged for binding to ports 80/443
  unprivileged = false

  # Deployment
  deploy_dir  = "${path.module}/deploy"
  target_path = "/config"

  # Exclude migrated routes (managed by traefik-route module), env templates, and .tpl files
  exclude_patterns = ["^migrated-dynamic/", "^\\.env", "\\.tpl$"]

  # SSH
  ssh_public_key       = local.ssh_public_key
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path
  proxmox_ssh_host     = local.proxmox_ssh_host

  # Template with Docker pre-installed
  template = var.lxc_template_docker

  # Proxmox Notes
  service_name        = "Traefik"
  service_description = "Reverse proxy and ingress controller for all homelab services"

  service_urls = {
    dashboard_internal = "https://traefik.${var.domain_internal}/dashboard/"
    direct             = "http://${local.traefik_ip}:8080/dashboard/"
  }

  services = [
    { name = "HTTP", port = 80, info = "HTTP entrypoint (redirects to HTTPS)" },
    { name = "HTTPS", port = 443, info = "HTTPS entrypoint with Let's Encrypt" },
    { name = "Metrics", port = 8082, info = "Prometheus metrics endpoint" }
  ]

  custom_notes = file("${path.module}/notes.md")

  tags = ["traefik", "ingress", "reverse-proxy"]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Create .env file with secrets
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Generate .env file locally with secrets from 1Password, then sync to container

resource "local_sensitive_file" "traefik_env" {
  content = templatefile("${path.module}/deploy/.env.tpl", {
    cf_api_token = local.op.cloudflare_api_token
    cf_api_email = local.op.cloudflare_email
  })
  filename        = "${path.module}/.terraform/traefik.env"
  file_permission = "0600"
}

resource "filesync_file" "traefik_env" {
  source      = local_sensitive_file.traefik_env.filename
  destination = "/config/.env"
  host        = local.traefik_ip

  mode = "0600"

  depends_on = [module.traefik]
}

    domain        = var.domain_internal

  file_permission = "0600"

resource "filesync_file" "alloy_auth_config" {

  destination = "/config/dynamic/alloy-auth.yml"

  mode = "0644"

module "traefik_sidecars" {

  container_ip   = module.traefik.ip_address
  container_name = "traefik"

    enabled   = true

  }

    enabled     = true
    pulse_token = local.agent_tokens["traefik"].pulse_token
  }

    enabled         = true
    bootstrap_token = local.agent_tokens["traefik"].arcane_bootstrap_token
  }

  alloy_agent = {
    enabled  = true
    username = local.op.alloy_telemetry_username
    password = local.op.alloy_telemetry_password
  }

  depends_on = [module.traefik]
}

# Outputs

  value = module.traefik.container_id
}

output "ip_address" {
  value = module.traefik.ip_address
}

output "ssh_command" {
  value = module.traefik.ssh_command
}

output "urls" {
  value = {
    dashboard_internal = "https://traefik.${var.domain_internal}/dashboard/"
  }
}

# =============================================================================
# Container Management LXC - Pulse + Arcane
# =============================================================================
# Container ID: 104
#
# Uses the docker-lxc module - the gold standard pattern for Docker apps.
# Container monitoring (Pulse) and management (Arcane).
# =============================================================================

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Variables
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

variable "container_id" {
  type    = number
  default = 104
}

variable "cores" {
  type    = number
  default = 2
}

variable "memory" {
  type    = number
  default = 2048
}

variable "rootfs_size" {
  type    = number
  default = 16
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Container Management LXC
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "container_mgmt" {
  source = "../../modules/docker-lxc"

  name         = "container-mgmt"
  container_id = var.container_id
  proxmox_node = var.proxmox_node

  # Network (container network only - no LAN access needed)
  container_ip = "${local.ip_registry.core.container_mgmt}${local.network.container_netmask}"

  # Resources
  cores  = var.cores
  memory = var.memory
  swap   = 512

  rootfs_storage = "nvme-containers"
  rootfs_size    = var.rootfs_size

  # Unprivileged container (security hardened)
  unprivileged = true

  # Deployment
  deploy_dir  = "${path.module}/deploy"
  target_path = "/config"

  # Exclude runtime data directories from sync (they're managed by the apps)
  exclude_patterns = ["pulse/**", "arcane_data/**"]

  # SSH
  ssh_public_key       = local.ssh_public_key
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path
  proxmox_ssh_host     = local.proxmox_ssh_host

  # Template with Docker pre-installed
  template = var.lxc_template_docker

  # Proxmox Notes
  service_name        = "Container Management"
  service_description = "Pulse monitoring + Arcane container management"

  service_urls = {
    pulse  = "https://pulse.${var.domain_internal}"
    arcane = "https://arcane.${var.domain_internal}"
  }

  services = [
    { name = "Pulse", port = 7655, info = "Proxmox + Docker monitoring" },
    { name = "Arcane", port = 3552, info = "Docker container management" }
  ]

  custom_notes = <<-EOT
## Pulse - Container Monitoring

Real-time monitoring for Proxmox VE and Docker containers.
- Dashboard: https://pulse.${var.domain_internal}
- Proxmox metrics via PVE API
- Docker metrics via socket

## Arcane - Container Management

Docker container management with update detection.
- Dashboard: https://arcane.${var.domain_internal}

module "arcane_route" {
  source = "../../modules/traefik-route"

  app_name    = "arcane"
  backend_url = "http://${module.container_mgmt.ip_address}:3552"

#   - Centralized user/group management
#
# File Structure:
#   - main.tf:      Container, env, routes, sidecars
#   - providers.tf: OAuth sources, forward auth, OIDC providers
#   - users.tf:     User management (SOPS-encrypted)
#   - outputs.tf:   All outputs
# =============================================================================

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Variables
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

variable "container_id" {
  description = "Container ID for Authentik LXC"
  type        = number
  default     = 203
}

variable "cores" {
  description = "CPU cores"
  type        = number
  default     = 2
}

variable "memory" {
  description = "Memory in MB"
  type        = number
  default     = 4096  # Authentik recommended minimum
}

variable "swap" {
  description = "Swap in MB"
  type        = number
  default     = 1024
}

variable "rootfs_size" {
  description = "Root filesystem size in GB"
  type        = number
  default     = 16
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Authentik Container
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "authentik" {
  source = "../../modules/docker-lxc"

  name         = "authentik"
  container_id = var.container_id
  proxmox_node = var.proxmox_node

  # Network (container network only - Traefik handles external access)
  container_ip = "${local.ip_registry.dashboards.authentik}${local.network.container_netmask}"

  # Resources
  cores  = var.cores
  memory = var.memory
  swap   = var.swap

  rootfs_storage = "nvme-containers"
  rootfs_size    = var.rootfs_size

  # Unprivileged container (security hardened)
  unprivileged = true

  # Deployment
  deploy_dir  = "${path.module}/deploy"
  target_path = "/config"

  # Exclude .env template files (we generate .env from template)
  exclude_patterns = ["^\\.env"]

  # SSH
  ssh_public_key       = local.ssh_public_key
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path
  proxmox_ssh_host     = local.proxmox_ssh_host

  # Template with Docker pre-installed
  template = var.lxc_template_docker

  # Proxmox Notes
  service_name        = "Authentik"
  service_description = "Identity Provider - SSO, OIDC, and forward auth for all homelab services"

  service_urls = {
    admin    = "https://auth.${var.domain_internal}/if/admin/"
    user     = "https://auth.${var.domain_internal}/if/user/"
    direct   = "http://${local.ip_registry.dashboards.authentik}:9000"
  }

  services = [
    { name = "Authentik HTTP", port = 9000, info = "Web UI and API" },
    { name = "Authentik HTTPS", port = 9443, info = "HTTPS (self-signed)" },
    { name = "PostgreSQL", port = 5432, info = "Database (internal only)" }
  ]

  custom_notes = <<-EOT
## Initial Setup

1. Access the admin interface at https://auth.${var.domain_internal}/if/admin/
2. Login with credentials from 1Password (item: authentik)
3. Configure Google OAuth source for SSO

## Forward Auth Endpoint

Add this middleware to Traefik routes for protected services:
```yaml
middlewares:
  authentik:
    forwardAuth:
      address: https://auth.${var.domain_public}/outpost.goauthentik.io/auth/traefik
      trustForwardHeader: true
      authResponseHeaders:
        - X-authentik-username
        - X-authentik-groups
        - X-authentik-email
        - X-authentik-name
        - X-authentik-uid
        - X-authentik-jwt
        - X-authentik-meta-jwks
        - X-authentik-meta-outpost
        - X-authentik-meta-provider
        - X-authentik-meta-app
        - X-authentik-meta-version
```

## Quick Commands

```bash
# View server logs
docker logs -f authentik-server

# View worker logs
docker logs -f authentik-worker

# Database backup
docker exec authentik-postgres pg_dump -U authentik authentik > backup.sql

# Restart services
cd /config && docker compose restart
```

## OIDC Configuration

For apps with native OIDC support, create a Provider in Authentik:
1. Admin → Providers → Create OAuth2/OIDC Provider
2. Set redirect URI for the app
3. Create Application linking to the provider
4. Use client_id and client_secret in the app config

## Managed by OpenTofu

Run `task tofu:apply APP=authentik` to update.
EOT

  tags = ["authentik", "auth", "sso", "oidc", "identity"]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Create .env file with secrets
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Generate .env file locally with secrets from 1Password, then sync to container

resource "local_sensitive_file" "authentik_env" {
  content = templatefile("${path.module}/deploy/.env.tpl", {
    postgres_password = local.op.authentik_postgres_password
    secret_key        = local.op.authentik_secret_key
    admin_email       = "admin@${var.domain_internal}"
    admin_password    = local.op.authentik_admin_password
  })
  filename        = "${path.module}/.terraform/authentik.env"
  file_permission = "0600"
}

resource "filesync_file" "authentik_env" {
  source      = local_sensitive_file.authentik_env.filename
  destination = "/config/.env"
  host        = module.authentik.ip_address

  mode = "0600"

  depends_on = [module.authentik]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Traefik Route - Self-Service Route Registration
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "authentik_route" {
  source = "../../modules/traefik-route"

  app_name    = "authentik"
  backend_url = "http://${module.authentik.ip_address}:9000"

  # Internal route (HTTPS via Let's Encrypt)
  # Using "auth" subdomain to match Authelia for easier migration
  internal_domain = "auth.${var.domain_internal}"

  # Public route for external access (Google OAuth redirect)
  public_domain = "auth.${var.domain_public}"

  # Traefik config
  traefik_host         = local.traefik_ip
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  # No auth middleware on the auth service itself!
  internal_middlewares = ["security-headers"]
  # cloudflare-https sets X-Forwarded-Proto: https to fix mixed content issues
  public_middlewares   = ["cloudflare-https", "security-headers"]
  # Use "web" entrypoint for public - Cloudflare handles TLS and forwards HTTP to origin
  public_entrypoint    = ["web"]

  depends_on = [module.authentik]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Traefik Forward Auth Middleware
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Generates the forwardAuth middleware config and syncs to Traefik

resource "local_file" "traefik_middleware" {
  content = templatefile("${path.module}/deploy/traefik-middleware.yml.tpl", {
    authentik_ip = module.authentik.ip_address
  })
  filename = "${path.module}/.terraform/authentik-middleware.yml"
}

resource "filesync_file" "traefik_middleware" {
  source      = local_file.traefik_middleware.filename
  destination = "/config/dynamic/authentik-middleware.yml"
  host        = local.traefik_ip

  mode = "0644"

  depends_on = [module.authentik, local_file.traefik_middleware]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Backup Configuration - PBS Client + Sidecars
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "authentik_sidecars" {
  source = "../../modules/lxc-sidecars"

  container_id   = module.authentik.container_id
  container_ip   = module.authentik.ip_address
  container_name = "authentik"

  proxmox_ssh_host             = local.proxmox_ssh_host
  proxmox_ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  backup = {
    enabled   = true
    schedule  = "daily"
    retention = "4"          # Keep 4 weekly backups

    # Dump PostgreSQL before backup
    pre_backup_commands = [
      {
        name    = "Backup PostgreSQL database"
        command = "docker exec authentik-postgres pg_dump -U authentik authentik > /config/authentik-db-backup.sql"
        timeout = 120
      }
    ]

    include_paths = ["/config"]
    exclude_paths = ["/var/lib/docker/overlay2"]

    ntfy_priority = "default"
    ntfy_tags     = "backup,authentik"
    ntfy_user     = "pbs-backup"
    ntfy_password = local.op.ntfy_pbs_backup_password
  }

  # Container monitoring agents
  pulse_agent = {
    enabled     = true
    pulse_token = local.agent_tokens["authentik"].pulse_token
  }

  arcane_agent = {
    enabled         = true
    bootstrap_token = local.agent_tokens["authentik"].arcane_bootstrap_token
  }

  alloy_agent = {
    enabled  = true
    username = local.op.alloy_telemetry_username
    password = local.op.alloy_telemetry_password
  }

  depends_on = [module.authentik]
}
