# n8n Workflow Management Tasks
# Sync workflows between local JSON files and n8n API
#
# Usage:
#   task n8n:list              - List all workflows in n8n
#   task n8n:pull              - Pull all workflows to local files
#   task n8n:pull ID=xxx       - Pull specific workflow
#   task n8n:push              - Push all local workflows to n8n
#   task n8n:push ID=xxx       - Push specific workflow
#   task n8n:diff ID=xxx       - Show diff between local and remote
#
# Workflows are stored in: tofu/apps/n8n/workflows/<id>_<name>.json

version: '3'

vars:
  N8N_API_URL: "http://10.100.5.102:5678/api/v1"
  # Note: PROJECT_ROOT is passed from the main Taskfile
  WORKFLOWS_DIR: "{{.TASKFILE_DIR}}/../tofu/apps/n8n/workflows"

tasks:
  # ===========================================================================
  # List Workflows
  # ===========================================================================

  n8n:list:
    desc: "List all workflows in n8n"
    cmds:
      - |
        N8N_API_KEY=$(op read "op://homelab/n8n/security/claude_token")
        echo "=== n8n Workflows ==="
        echo ""
        curl -s -H "X-N8N-API-KEY: $N8N_API_KEY" "{{.N8N_API_URL}}/workflows" | \
          jq -r '.data[] | "[\(.id)] \(.name) (active: \(.active))"'

  # ===========================================================================
  # Pull Workflows (n8n -> local)
  # ===========================================================================

  n8n:pull:
    desc: "Pull workflows from n8n to local JSON files (ID=xxx for specific)"
    cmds:
      - mkdir -p "{{.WORKFLOWS_DIR}}"
      - |
        N8N_API_KEY=$(op read "op://homelab/n8n/security/claude_token")

        if [ -n "{{.ID}}" ]; then
          # Pull specific workflow
          echo "Pulling workflow {{.ID}}..."
          WORKFLOW=$(curl -s -H "X-N8N-API-KEY: $N8N_API_KEY" "{{.N8N_API_URL}}/workflows/{{.ID}}")

          if echo "$WORKFLOW" | jq -e '.id' > /dev/null 2>&1; then
            NAME=$(echo "$WORKFLOW" | jq -r '.name' | tr ' ' '_' | tr -cd '[:alnum:]_-')
            FILENAME="{{.WORKFLOWS_DIR}}/{{.ID}}_${NAME}.json"
            echo "$WORKFLOW" | jq '.' > "$FILENAME"
            echo "Saved: $FILENAME"
          else
            echo "Error: Workflow {{.ID}} not found"
            exit 1
          fi
        else
          # Pull all workflows
          echo "Pulling all workflows from n8n..."
          WORKFLOWS=$(curl -s -H "X-N8N-API-KEY: $N8N_API_KEY" "{{.N8N_API_URL}}/workflows")

          echo "$WORKFLOWS" | jq -r '.data[] | .id' | while read -r ID; do
            WORKFLOW=$(curl -s -H "X-N8N-API-KEY: $N8N_API_KEY" "{{.N8N_API_URL}}/workflows/$ID")
            NAME=$(echo "$WORKFLOW" | jq -r '.name' | tr ' ' '_' | tr -cd '[:alnum:]_-')
            FILENAME="{{.WORKFLOWS_DIR}}/${ID}_${NAME}.json"
            echo "$WORKFLOW" | jq '.' > "$FILENAME"
            echo "Saved: $FILENAME"
          done

          echo ""
          echo "All workflows saved to {{.WORKFLOWS_DIR}}"
        fi
    vars:
      ID: '{{.ID | default ""}}'

  # ===========================================================================
  # Push Workflows (local -> n8n)
  # ===========================================================================

  n8n:push:
    desc: "Push local workflows to n8n (ID=xxx for specific)"
    cmds:
      - |
        N8N_API_KEY=$(op read "op://homelab/n8n/security/claude_token")

        if [ -n "{{.ID}}" ]; then
          # Push specific workflow
          FILE=$(ls "{{.WORKFLOWS_DIR}}/{{.ID}}"_*.json 2>/dev/null | head -1)
          if [ -z "$FILE" ]; then
            echo "Error: No local file found for workflow {{.ID}}"
            exit 1
          fi

          echo "Pushing workflow from $FILE..."

          # Extract only the fields needed for update
          PAYLOAD=$(jq '{name, nodes, connections, settings, staticData, pinData}' "$FILE")

          RESULT=$(curl -s -X PUT "{{.N8N_API_URL}}/workflows/{{.ID}}" \
            -H "X-N8N-API-KEY: $N8N_API_KEY" \
            -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
            -d "$PAYLOAD")

          if echo "$RESULT" | jq -e '.id' > /dev/null 2>&1; then
            echo "Updated: $(echo "$RESULT" | jq -r '.name') ({{.ID}})"
          else
            echo "Error updating workflow:"
            echo "$RESULT" | jq '.'
            exit 1
          fi
        else
          # Push all workflows
          echo "Pushing all local workflows to n8n..."

          for FILE in "{{.WORKFLOWS_DIR}}"/*.json; do
            [ -f "$FILE" ] || continue

            # Extract ID from filename (format: ID_name.json)
            ID=$(basename "$FILE" | cut -d'_' -f1)
            NAME=$(jq -r '.name' "$FILE")

            echo "Pushing: $NAME ($ID)..."

            PAYLOAD=$(jq '{name, nodes, connections, settings, staticData, pinData}' "$FILE")

            RESULT=$(curl -s -X PUT "{{.N8N_API_URL}}/workflows/$ID" \
              -H "X-N8N-API-KEY: $N8N_API_KEY" \
              -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
              -d "$PAYLOAD")

            if echo "$RESULT" | jq -e '.id' > /dev/null 2>&1; then
              echo "  Updated successfully"
            else
              echo "  Error: $(echo "$RESULT" | jq -r '.message // "Unknown error"')"
            fi
          done

          echo ""
          echo "All workflows pushed"
        fi
    vars:
      ID: '{{.ID | default ""}}'

  # ===========================================================================
  # Diff Workflows (compare local vs remote)
  # ===========================================================================

  n8n:diff:
    desc: "Show diff between local and remote workflow (ID=xxx required)"
    cmds:
      - |
        if [ -z "{{.ID}}" ]; then
          echo "Usage: task n8n:diff ID=<workflow-id>"
          exit 1
        fi

        N8N_API_KEY=$(op read "op://homelab/n8n/security/claude_token")

        FILE=$(ls "{{.WORKFLOWS_DIR}}/{{.ID}}"_*.json 2>/dev/null | head -1)
        if [ -z "$FILE" ]; then
          echo "Error: No local file found for workflow {{.ID}}"
          exit 1
        fi

        echo "Comparing {{.ID}}..."
        echo "Local: $FILE"
        echo ""

        # Get remote workflow
        REMOTE=$(curl -s -H "X-N8N-API-KEY: $N8N_API_KEY" "{{.N8N_API_URL}}/workflows/{{.ID}}")

        # Compare key fields (ignore updatedAt, versionId, etc)
        LOCAL_COMPARE=$(jq '{name, nodes, connections, settings}' "$FILE" | jq -S '.')
        REMOTE_COMPARE=$(echo "$REMOTE" | jq '{name, nodes, connections, settings}' | jq -S '.')

        if [ "$LOCAL_COMPARE" = "$REMOTE_COMPARE" ]; then
          echo "No differences found"
        else
          echo "=== Differences ==="
          diff <(echo "$LOCAL_COMPARE") <(echo "$REMOTE_COMPARE") || true
        fi
    vars:
      ID: '{{.ID | default ""}}'

  # ===========================================================================
  # Status - Show sync status for all workflows
  # ===========================================================================

  n8n:status:
    desc: "Show sync status of all workflows"
    cmds:
      - |
        N8N_API_KEY=$(op read "op://homelab/n8n/security/claude_token")

        echo "=== Workflow Sync Status ==="
        echo ""

        # Get remote workflows
        REMOTE_IDS=$(curl -s -H "X-N8N-API-KEY: $N8N_API_KEY" "{{.N8N_API_URL}}/workflows" | jq -r '.data[] | .id')

        # Check each remote workflow
        for ID in $REMOTE_IDS; do
          FILE=$(ls "{{.WORKFLOWS_DIR}}/${ID}"_*.json 2>/dev/null | head -1)
          REMOTE=$(curl -s -H "X-N8N-API-KEY: $N8N_API_KEY" "{{.N8N_API_URL}}/workflows/$ID")
          NAME=$(echo "$REMOTE" | jq -r '.name')

          if [ -z "$FILE" ]; then
            echo "[$ID] $NAME"
            echo "  Status: NOT SYNCED (no local file)"
          else
            LOCAL_COMPARE=$(jq '{name, nodes, connections, settings}' "$FILE" 2>/dev/null | jq -S '.')
            REMOTE_COMPARE=$(echo "$REMOTE" | jq '{name, nodes, connections, settings}' | jq -S '.')

            if [ "$LOCAL_COMPARE" = "$REMOTE_COMPARE" ]; then
              echo "[$ID] $NAME"
              echo "  Status: IN SYNC"
            else
              echo "[$ID] $NAME"
              echo "  Status: DIFFERS (local vs remote)"
            fi
          fi
          echo ""
        done

        # Check for local-only workflows
        for FILE in "{{.WORKFLOWS_DIR}}"/*.json 2>/dev/null; do
          [ -f "$FILE" ] || continue
          ID=$(basename "$FILE" | cut -d'_' -f1)

          if ! echo "$REMOTE_IDS" | grep -q "^${ID}$"; then
            NAME=$(jq -r '.name' "$FILE")
            echo "[$ID] $NAME"
            echo "  Status: LOCAL ONLY (not in n8n)"
            echo ""
          fi
        done

set -euo pipefail

N8N_API_URL="${N8N_API_URL:-http://10.100.5.102:5678/api/v1}"

}

cmd_pull() {

    if [[ -n "$id" ]]; then

        if echo "$workflow" | jq -e '.id' > /dev/null 2>&1; then
            local name
            name=$(echo "$workflow" | jq -r '.name' | tr ' ' '_' | tr -cd '[:alnum:]_-')
            local filename="$WORKFLOWS_DIR/${id}_${name}.json"
            echo "$workflow" | jq '.' > "$filename"
            echo "Saved: $filename"

            exit 1
        fi

        echo "$workflows" | jq -r '.data[] | .id' | while read -r wf_id; do
            local workflow
            workflow=$(curl -s -H "X-N8N-API-KEY: $api_key" "$N8N_API_URL/workflows/$wf_id")
            local name
            name=$(echo "$workflow" | jq -r '.name' | tr ' ' '_' | tr -cd '[:alnum:]_-')
            local filename="$WORKFLOWS_DIR/${wf_id}_${name}.json"
            echo "$workflow" | jq '.' > "$filename"
            echo "Saved: $filename"
        done

        echo ""
        echo "All workflows saved to $WORKFLOWS_DIR"
    fi
}

# Push workflows to n8n
cmd_push() {
    local id="${1:-}"
    local api_key
    api_key=$(get_api_key)

    if [[ -n "$id" ]]; then
        local file
        file=$(ls "$WORKFLOWS_DIR/${id}"_*.json 2>/dev/null | head -1 || true)
        if [[ -z "$file" ]]; then
            echo "Error: No local file found for workflow $id"
            exit 1
        fi

        echo "Pushing workflow from $file..."
        local payload
        payload=$(jq '{name, nodes, connections, settings, staticData, pinData}' "$file")

        local result
        result=$(curl -s -X PUT "$N8N_API_URL/workflows/$id" \
            -H "X-N8N-API-KEY: $api_key" \
            -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
            -d "$payload")

        if echo "$result" | jq -e '.id' > /dev/null 2>&1; then
            echo "Updated: $(echo "$result" | jq -r '.name') ($id)"
        else
            echo "Error updating workflow:"
            echo "$result" | jq '.'
            exit 1
        fi
    else
        echo "Pushing all local workflows to n8n..."

        for file in "$WORKFLOWS_DIR"/*.json; do
            [[ -f "$file" ]] || continue

            local wf_id
            wf_id=$(basename "$file" | cut -d'_' -f1)
            local name
            name=$(jq -r '.name' "$file")

            echo "Pushing: $name ($wf_id)..."

            local payload
            payload=$(jq '{name, nodes, connections, settings, staticData, pinData}' "$file")

            local result
            result=$(curl -s -X PUT "$N8N_API_URL/workflows/$wf_id" \
                -H "X-N8N-API-KEY: $api_key" \
                -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
                -d "$payload")

            if echo "$result" | jq -e '.id' > /dev/null 2>&1; then
                echo "  Updated successfully"
            else
                echo "  Error: $(echo "$result" | jq -r '.message // "Unknown error"')"
            fi
        done

        echo ""
        echo "All workflows pushed"
    fi
}

# Show diff between local and remote
cmd_diff() {
    local id="${1:-}"
    if [[ -z "$id" ]]; then
        echo "Usage: $0 diff --id=<workflow-id>"
        exit 1
    fi

    local api_key
    api_key=$(get_api_key)

    local file
    file=$(ls "$WORKFLOWS_DIR/${id}"_*.json 2>/dev/null | head -1 || true)
    if [[ -z "$file" ]]; then
        echo "Error: No local file found for workflow $id"
        exit 1
    fi

    echo "Comparing $id..."
    echo "Local: $file"
    echo ""

    local remote
    remote=$(curl -s -H "X-N8N-API-KEY: $api_key" "$N8N_API_URL/workflows/$id")

    local local_compare remote_compare
    local_compare=$(jq '{name, nodes, connections, settings}' "$file" | jq -S '.')
    remote_compare=$(echo "$remote" | jq '{name, nodes, connections, settings}' | jq -S '.')

    if [[ "$local_compare" == "$remote_compare" ]]; then
        echo "No differences found"
    else
        echo "=== Differences ==="
        diff <(echo "$local_compare") <(echo "$remote_compare") || true
    fi
}

# Show sync status
cmd_status() {
    local api_key
    api_key=$(get_api_key)

    echo "=== Workflow Sync Status ==="
    echo ""

    local remote_data
    remote_data=$(curl -s -H "X-N8N-API-KEY: $api_key" "$N8N_API_URL/workflows")
    local remote_ids
    remote_ids=$(echo "$remote_data" | jq -r '.data[] | .id')

    for wf_id in $remote_ids; do
        local file
        file=$(ls "$WORKFLOWS_DIR/${wf_id}"_*.json 2>/dev/null | head -1 || true)
        local remote
        remote=$(curl -s -H "X-N8N-API-KEY: $api_key" "$N8N_API_URL/workflows/$wf_id")
        local name
        name=$(echo "$remote" | jq -r '.name')

        if [[ -z "$file" ]]; then
            echo "[$wf_id] $name"
            echo "  Status: NOT SYNCED (no local file)"
        else
            local local_compare remote_compare
            local_compare=$(jq '{name, nodes, connections, settings}' "$file" 2>/dev/null | jq -S '.')
            remote_compare=$(echo "$remote" | jq '{name, nodes, connections, settings}' | jq -S '.')

            if [[ "$local_compare" == "$remote_compare" ]]; then
                echo "[$wf_id] $name"
                echo "  Status: IN SYNC"
            else
                echo "[$wf_id] $name"
                echo "  Status: DIFFERS (local vs remote)"
            fi
        fi
        echo ""
    done

    # Check for local-only workflows
    for file in "$WORKFLOWS_DIR"/*.json; do
        [[ -f "$file" ]] || continue
        local wf_id
        wf_id=$(basename "$file" | cut -d'_' -f1)

        if ! echo "$remote_ids" | grep -q "^${wf_id}$"; then
            local name
            name=$(jq -r '.name' "$file")
            echo "[$wf_id] $name"
            echo "  Status: LOCAL ONLY (not in n8n)"
            echo ""
        fi
    done
}

# Parse command line
main() {
    local cmd="${1:-}"
    shift || true

    local id=""
    for arg in "$@"; do
        case "$arg" in
            --id=*)
                id="${arg#*=}"
                ;;
        esac
    done

    case "$cmd" in
        list)
            cmd_list
            ;;
        pull)
            cmd_pull "$id"
            ;;
        push)
            cmd_push "$id"
            ;;
        diff)
            cmd_diff "$id"
            ;;
        status)
            cmd_status
            ;;
        *)
            echo "Usage: $0 <command> [options]"
            echo ""
            echo "Commands:"
            echo "  list              - List all workflows in n8n"
            echo "  pull [--id=xxx]   - Pull workflows from n8n to local files"
            echo "  push [--id=xxx]   - Push local workflows to n8n"
            echo "  diff --id=xxx     - Show diff between local and remote"
            echo "  status            - Show sync status of all workflows"
            exit 1
            ;;
    esac
}

                echo "  Error: $(echo "$result" | jq -r '.message // "Unknown error"')"
            fi
        done

        echo ""
        echo "All workflows pushed"
    fi
}

# Show diff between local and remote
cmd_diff() {
    local id="${1:-}"
    if [[ -z "$id" ]]; then
        echo "Usage: $0 diff --id=<workflow-id>"
        exit 1
    fi

    local api_key
    api_key=$(get_api_key)

    local file
    file=$(ls "$WORKFLOWS_DIR/${id}"_*.json 2>/dev/null | head -1 || true)
    if [[ -z "$file" ]]; then
        echo "Error: No local file found for workflow $id"
        exit 1
    fi

    echo "Comparing $id..."
    echo "Local: $file"
    echo ""

    local remote
    remote=$(curl -s -H "X-N8N-API-KEY: $api_key" "$N8N_API_URL/workflows/$id")

    local local_compare remote_compare
    local_compare=$(jq '{name, nodes, connections, settings}' "$file" | jq -S '.')
    remote_compare=$(echo "$remote" | jq '{name, nodes, connections, settings}' | jq -S '.')

    if [[ "$local_compare" == "$remote_compare" ]]; then
        echo "No differences found"
    else
        echo "=== Differences ==="
        diff <(echo "$local_compare") <(echo "$remote_compare") || true
    fi
}

# Show sync status
cmd_status() {
    local api_key
    api_key=$(get_api_key)

    echo "=== Workflow Sync Status ==="
    echo ""

    local remote_data
    remote_data=$(curl -s -H "X-N8N-API-KEY: $api_key" "$N8N_API_URL/workflows")
    local remote_ids
    remote_ids=$(echo "$remote_data" | jq -r '.data[] | .id')

    for wf_id in $remote_ids; do
        local file
        file=$(ls "$WORKFLOWS_DIR/${wf_id}"_*.json 2>/dev/null | head -1 || true)
        local remote
        remote=$(curl -s -H "X-N8N-API-KEY: $api_key" "$N8N_API_URL/workflows/$wf_id")
        local name
        name=$(echo "$remote" | jq -r '.name')

        if [[ -z "$file" ]]; then
            echo "[$wf_id] $name"
            echo "  Status: NOT SYNCED (no local file)"
        else
            local local_compare remote_compare
            local_compare=$(jq '{name, nodes, connections, settings}' "$file" 2>/dev/null | jq -S '.')
            remote_compare=$(echo "$remote" | jq '{name, nodes, connections, settings}' | jq -S '.')

            if [[ "$local_compare" == "$remote_compare" ]]; then
                echo "[$wf_id] $name"
                echo "  Status: IN SYNC"
            else
                echo "[$wf_id] $name"
                echo "  Status: DIFFERS (local vs remote)"
            fi
        fi
        echo ""
    done

    # Check for local-only workflows
    for file in "$WORKFLOWS_DIR"/*.json; do
        [[ -f "$file" ]] || continue
        local wf_id
        wf_id=$(basename "$file" | cut -d'_' -f1)

        if ! echo "$remote_ids" | grep -q "^${wf_id}$"; then
            local name
            name=$(jq -r '.name' "$file")
            echo "[$wf_id] $name"
            echo "  Status: LOCAL ONLY (not in n8n)"
            echo ""
        fi
    done
}

# Parse command line
main() {
    local cmd="${1:-}"
    shift || true

    local id=""
    for arg in "$@"; do
        case "$arg" in
            --id=*)
                id="${arg#*=}"
                ;;
        esac
    done

    case "$cmd" in
        list)
            cmd_list
            ;;
        pull)
            cmd_pull "$id"
            ;;
        push)
            cmd_push "$id"
            ;;
        diff)
            cmd_diff "$id"
            ;;
        status)
            cmd_status
            ;;
        *)
            echo "Usage: $0 <command> [options]"
            echo ""
            echo "Commands:"
            echo "  list              - List all workflows in n8n"
            echo "  pull [--id=xxx]   - Pull workflows from n8n to local files"
            echo "  push [--id=xxx]   - Push local workflows to n8n"
            echo "  diff --id=xxx     - Show diff between local and remote"
            echo "  status            - Show sync status of all workflows"
            exit 1
            ;;
    esac
}

main "$@"

# n8n Workflow Management Tasks
# Sync workflows between local JSON files and n8n API
#
# Usage:
#   task n8n:list              - List all workflows in n8n
#   task n8n:pull              - Pull all workflows to local files
#   task n8n:pull ID=xxx       - Pull specific workflow
#   task n8n:push              - Push all local workflows to n8n
#   task n8n:push ID=xxx       - Push specific workflow
#   task n8n:diff ID=xxx       - Show diff between local and remote
#
# Workflows are stored in: tofu/apps/n8n/workflows/<id>_<name>.json

version: '3'

vars:
  N8N_API_URL: "http://10.100.5.102:5678/api/v1"
  # Note: PROJECT_ROOT is passed from the main Taskfile
  WORKFLOWS_DIR: "{{.TASKFILE_DIR}}/../tofu/apps/n8n/workflows"

tasks:
  # ===========================================================================
  # List Workflows
  # ===========================================================================

  n8n:list:
    desc: "List all workflows in n8n"
    cmds:
      - |
        N8N_API_KEY=$(op read "op://homelab/n8n/security/claude_token")
        echo "=== n8n Workflows ==="
        echo ""
        curl -s -H "X-N8N-API-KEY: $N8N_API_KEY" "{{.N8N_API_URL}}/workflows" | \
          jq -r '.data[] | "[\(.id)] \(.name) (active: \(.active))"'

  # ===========================================================================
  # Pull Workflows (n8n -> local)
  # ===========================================================================

  n8n:pull:
    desc: "Pull workflows from n8n to local JSON files (ID=xxx for specific)"
    cmds:
      - mkdir -p "{{.WORKFLOWS_DIR}}"
      - |
        N8N_API_KEY=$(op read "op://homelab/n8n/security/claude_token")

        if [ -n "{{.ID}}" ]; then
          # Pull specific workflow
          echo "Pulling workflow {{.ID}}..."
          WORKFLOW=$(curl -s -H "X-N8N-API-KEY: $N8N_API_KEY" "{{.N8N_API_URL}}/workflows/{{.ID}}")

          if echo "$WORKFLOW" | jq -e '.id' > /dev/null 2>&1; then
            NAME=$(echo "$WORKFLOW" | jq -r '.name' | tr ' ' '_' | tr -cd '[:alnum:]_-')
            FILENAME="{{.WORKFLOWS_DIR}}/{{.ID}}_${NAME}.json"
            echo "$WORKFLOW" | jq '.' > "$FILENAME"
            echo "Saved: $FILENAME"
          else
            echo "Error: Workflow {{.ID}} not found"
            exit 1
          fi
        else
          # Pull all workflows
          echo "Pulling all workflows from n8n..."
          WORKFLOWS=$(curl -s -H "X-N8N-API-KEY: $N8N_API_KEY" "{{.N8N_API_URL}}/workflows")

          echo "$WORKFLOWS" | jq -r '.data[] | .id' | while read -r ID; do
            WORKFLOW=$(curl -s -H "X-N8N-API-KEY: $N8N_API_KEY" "{{.N8N_API_URL}}/workflows/$ID")
            NAME=$(echo "$WORKFLOW" | jq -r '.name' | tr ' ' '_' | tr -cd '[:alnum:]_-')
            FILENAME="{{.WORKFLOWS_DIR}}/${ID}_${NAME}.json"
            echo "$WORKFLOW" | jq '.' > "$FILENAME"
            echo "Saved: $FILENAME"
          done

          echo ""
          echo "All workflows saved to {{.WORKFLOWS_DIR}}"
        fi
    vars:
      ID: '{{.ID | default ""}}'

  # ===========================================================================
  # Push Workflows (local -> n8n)
  # ===========================================================================

  n8n:push:
    desc: "Push local workflows to n8n (ID=xxx for specific)"
    cmds:
      - |
        N8N_API_KEY=$(op read "op://homelab/n8n/security/claude_token")

        if [ -n "{{.ID}}" ]; then
          # Push specific workflow
          FILE=$(ls "{{.WORKFLOWS_DIR}}/{{.ID}}"_*.json 2>/dev/null | head -1)
          if [ -z "$FILE" ]; then
            echo "Error: No local file found for workflow {{.ID}}"
            exit 1
          fi

          echo "Pushing workflow from $FILE..."

          # Extract only the fields needed for update
          PAYLOAD=$(jq '{name, nodes, connections, settings, staticData, pinData}' "$FILE")

          RESULT=$(curl -s -X PUT "{{.N8N_API_URL}}/workflows/{{.ID}}" \
            -H "X-N8N-API-KEY: $N8N_API_KEY" \
            -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
            -d "$PAYLOAD")

          if echo "$RESULT" | jq -e '.id' > /dev/null 2>&1; then
            echo "Updated: $(echo "$RESULT" | jq -r '.name') ({{.ID}})"
          else
            echo "Error updating workflow:"
            echo "$RESULT" | jq '.'
            exit 1
          fi
        else
          # Push all workflows
          echo "Pushing all local workflows to n8n..."

          for FILE in "{{.WORKFLOWS_DIR}}"/*.json; do
            [ -f "$FILE" ] || continue

            # Extract ID from filename (format: ID_name.json)
            ID=$(basename "$FILE" | cut -d'_' -f1)
            NAME=$(jq -r '.name' "$FILE")

            echo "Pushing: $NAME ($ID)..."

            PAYLOAD=$(jq '{name, nodes, connections, settings, staticData, pinData}' "$FILE")

            RESULT=$(curl -s -X PUT "{{.N8N_API_URL}}/workflows/$ID" \
              -H "X-N8N-API-KEY: $N8N_API_KEY" \
              -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
              -d "$PAYLOAD")

            if echo "$RESULT" | jq -e '.id' > /dev/null 2>&1; then
              echo "  Updated successfully"
            else
              echo "  Error: $(echo "$RESULT" | jq -r '.message // "Unknown error"')"
            fi
          done

          echo ""
          echo "All workflows pushed"
        fi
    vars:
      ID: '{{.ID | default ""}}'

  # ===========================================================================
  # Diff Workflows (compare local vs remote)
  # ===========================================================================

  n8n:diff:
    desc: "Show diff between local and remote workflow (ID=xxx required)"
    cmds:
      - |
        if [ -z "{{.ID}}" ]; then
          echo "Usage: task n8n:diff ID=<workflow-id>"
          exit 1
        fi

        N8N_API_KEY=$(op read "op://homelab/n8n/security/claude_token")

        FILE=$(ls "{{.WORKFLOWS_DIR}}/{{.ID}}"_*.json 2>/dev/null | head -1)
        if [ -z "$FILE" ]; then
          echo "Error: No local file found for workflow {{.ID}}"
          exit 1
        fi

        echo "Comparing {{.ID}}..."
        echo "Local: $FILE"
        echo ""

        # Get remote workflow
        REMOTE=$(curl -s -H "X-N8N-API-KEY: $N8N_API_KEY" "{{.N8N_API_URL}}/workflows/{{.ID}}")

# n8n Workflow Management Tasks
# Sync workflows between local JSON files and n8n API
#
# Usage:
#   task n8n:list              - List all workflows in n8n
#   task n8n:pull              - Pull all workflows to local files
#   task n8n:pull ID=xxx       - Pull specific workflow
#   task n8n:push              - Push all local workflows to n8n
#   task n8n:push ID=xxx       - Push specific workflow
#   task n8n:diff ID=xxx       - Show diff between local and remote
#
# Workflows are stored in: tofu/apps/n8n/workflows/<id>_<name>.json

version: '3'

vars:
  N8N_API_URL: "http://10.100.5.102:5678/api/v1"
  # Note: PROJECT_ROOT is passed from the main Taskfile
  WORKFLOWS_DIR: "{{.TASKFILE_DIR}}/../tofu/apps/n8n/workflows"

tasks:
  # ===========================================================================
  # List Workflows
  # ===========================================================================

  n8n:list:
    desc: "List all workflows in n8n"
    cmds:
      - |
        N8N_API_KEY=$(op read "op://homelab/n8n/security/claude_token")
        echo "=== n8n Workflows ==="
        echo ""
        curl -s -H "X-N8N-API-KEY: $N8N_API_KEY" "{{.N8N_API_URL}}/workflows" | \
          jq -r '.data[] | "[\(.id)] \(.name) (active: \(.active))"'

  # ===========================================================================
  # Pull Workflows (n8n -> local)
  # ===========================================================================

  n8n:pull:
    desc: "Pull workflows from n8n to local JSON files (ID=xxx for specific)"
    cmds:
      - mkdir -p "{{.WORKFLOWS_DIR}}"
      - |
        N8N_API_KEY=$(op read "op://homelab/n8n/security/claude_token")

        if [ -n "{{.ID}}" ]; then
          # Pull specific workflow
          echo "Pulling workflow {{.ID}}..."
          WORKFLOW=$(curl -s -H "X-N8N-API-KEY: $N8N_API_KEY" "{{.N8N_API_URL}}/workflows/{{.ID}}")

          if echo "$WORKFLOW" | jq -e '.id' > /dev/null 2>&1; then
            NAME=$(echo "$WORKFLOW" | jq -r '.name' | tr ' ' '_' | tr -cd '[:alnum:]_-')
            FILENAME="{{.WORKFLOWS_DIR}}/{{.ID}}_${NAME}.json"
            echo "$WORKFLOW" | jq '.' > "$FILENAME"
            echo "Saved: $FILENAME"
          else
            echo "Error: Workflow {{.ID}} not found"
            exit 1
          fi
        else
          # Pull all workflows
          echo "Pulling all workflows from n8n..."
          WORKFLOWS=$(curl -s -H "X-N8N-API-KEY: $N8N_API_KEY" "{{.N8N_API_URL}}/workflows")

          echo "$WORKFLOWS" | jq -r '.data[] | .id' | while read -r ID; do
            WORKFLOW=$(curl -s -H "X-N8N-API-KEY: $N8N_API_KEY" "{{.N8N_API_URL}}/workflows/$ID")
            NAME=$(echo "$WORKFLOW" | jq -r '.name' | tr ' ' '_' | tr -cd '[:alnum:]_-')
            FILENAME="{{.WORKFLOWS_DIR}}/${ID}_${NAME}.json"
            echo "$WORKFLOW" | jq '.' > "$FILENAME"
            echo "Saved: $FILENAME"
          done

          echo ""
          echo "All workflows saved to {{.WORKFLOWS_DIR}}"
        fi
    vars:
      ID: '{{.ID | default ""}}'

  # ===========================================================================
  # Push Workflows (local -> n8n)
  # ===========================================================================

  n8n:push:
    desc: "Push local workflows to n8n (ID=xxx for specific)"
    cmds:
      - |
        N8N_API_KEY=$(op read "op://homelab/n8n/security/claude_token")

        if [ -n "{{.ID}}" ]; then
          # Push specific workflow
          FILE=$(ls "{{.WORKFLOWS_DIR}}/{{.ID}}"_*.json 2>/dev/null | head -1)
          if [ -z "$FILE" ]; then
            echo "Error: No local file found for workflow {{.ID}}"
            exit 1
          fi

          echo "Pushing workflow from $FILE..."

          # Extract only the fields needed for update
          PAYLOAD=$(jq '{name, nodes, connections, settings, staticData, pinData}' "$FILE")

          RESULT=$(curl -s -X PUT "{{.N8N_API_URL}}/workflows/{{.ID}}" \
            -H "X-N8N-API-KEY: $N8N_API_KEY" \
            -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
            -d "$PAYLOAD")

          if echo "$RESULT" | jq -e '.id' > /dev/null 2>&1; then
            echo "Updated: $(echo "$RESULT" | jq -r '.name') ({{.ID}})"
          else
            echo "Error updating workflow:"
            echo "$RESULT" | jq '.'
            exit 1
          fi
        else
          # Push all workflows
          echo "Pushing all local workflows to n8n..."

          for FILE in "{{.WORKFLOWS_DIR}}"/*.json; do
            [ -f "$FILE" ] || continue

            # Extract ID from filename (format: ID_name.json)
            ID=$(basename "$FILE" | cut -d'_' -f1)
            NAME=$(jq -r '.name' "$FILE")

            echo "Pushing: $NAME ($ID)..."

            PAYLOAD=$(jq '{name, nodes, connections, settings, staticData, pinData}' "$FILE")

            RESULT=$(curl -s -X PUT "{{.N8N_API_URL}}/workflows/$ID" \
              -H "X-N8N-API-KEY: $N8N_API_KEY" \
              -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
              -d "$PAYLOAD")

            if echo "$RESULT" | jq -e '.id' > /dev/null 2>&1; then
              echo "  Updated successfully"
            else
              echo "  Error: $(echo "$RESULT" | jq -r '.message // "Unknown error"')"
            fi
          done

          echo ""
          echo "All workflows pushed"
        fi
    vars:
      ID: '{{.ID | default ""}}'

  # ===========================================================================
  # Diff Workflows (compare local vs remote)
  # ===========================================================================

  n8n:diff:
    desc: "Show diff between local and remote workflow (ID=xxx required)"
    cmds:
      - |
        if [ -z "{{.ID}}" ]; then
          echo "Usage: task n8n:diff ID=<workflow-id>"
          exit 1
        fi

        N8N_API_KEY=$(op read "op://homelab/n8n/security/claude_token")

        FILE=$(ls "{{.WORKFLOWS_DIR}}/{{.ID}}"_*.json 2>/dev/null | head -1)
        if [ -z "$FILE" ]; then
          echo "Error: No local file found for workflow {{.ID}}"
          exit 1
        fi

        echo "Comparing {{.ID}}..."
        echo "Local: $FILE"
        echo ""

        # Get remote workflow
        REMOTE=$(curl -s -H "X-N8N-API-KEY: $N8N_API_KEY" "{{.N8N_API_URL}}/workflows/{{.ID}}")

        # Compare key fields (ignore updatedAt, versionId, etc)
        LOCAL_COMPARE=$(jq '{name, nodes, connections, settings}' "$FILE" | jq -S '.')
        REMOTE_COMPARE=$(echo "$REMOTE" | jq '{name, nodes, connections, settings}' | jq -S '.')

        if [ "$LOCAL_COMPARE" = "$REMOTE_COMPARE" ]; then
          echo "No differences found"
        else
          echo "=== Differences ==="
          diff <(echo "$LOCAL_COMPARE") <(echo "$REMOTE_COMPARE") || true
        fi
    vars:
      ID: '{{.ID | default ""}}'

  # ===========================================================================
  # Status - Show sync status for all workflows
  # ===========================================================================

  n8n:status:
    desc: "Show sync status of all workflows"
    cmds:
      - |
        N8N_API_KEY=$(op read "op://homelab/n8n/security/claude_token")

        echo "=== Workflow Sync Status ==="
        echo ""

        # Get remote workflows
        REMOTE_IDS=$(curl -s -H "X-N8N-API-KEY: $N8N_API_KEY" "{{.N8N_API_URL}}/workflows" | jq -r '.data[] | .id')

        # Check each remote workflow
        for ID in $REMOTE_IDS; do
          FILE=$(ls "{{.WORKFLOWS_DIR}}/${ID}"_*.json 2>/dev/null | head -1)
          REMOTE=$(curl -s -H "X-N8N-API-KEY: $N8N_API_KEY" "{{.N8N_API_URL}}/workflows/$ID")
          NAME=$(echo "$REMOTE" | jq -r '.name')

          if [ -z "$FILE" ]; then
            echo "[$ID] $NAME"
            echo "  Status: NOT SYNCED (no local file)"
          else
            LOCAL_COMPARE=$(jq '{name, nodes, connections, settings}' "$FILE" 2>/dev/null | jq -S '.')
            REMOTE_COMPARE=$(echo "$REMOTE" | jq '{name, nodes, connections, settings}' | jq -S '.')

            if [ "$LOCAL_COMPARE" = "$REMOTE_COMPARE" ]; then
              echo "[$ID] $NAME"
              echo "  Status: IN SYNC"
            else
              echo "[$ID] $NAME"
              echo "  Status: DIFFERS (local vs remote)"
            fi
          fi
          echo ""
        done

        # Check for local-only workflows
        for FILE in "{{.WORKFLOWS_DIR}}"/*.json 2>/dev/null; do
          [ -f "$FILE" ] || continue
          ID=$(basename "$FILE" | cut -d'_' -f1)

          if ! echo "$REMOTE_IDS" | grep -q "^${ID}$"; then
            NAME=$(jq -r '.name' "$FILE")
            echo "[$ID] $NAME"
            echo "  Status: LOCAL ONLY (not in n8n)"
            echo ""
          fi
        done

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# n8n Workflow Sync Script
# Usage: n8n-workflows.sh <command> [options]
#
# Commands:
#   list              - List all workflows in n8n
#   pull [--id=xxx]   - Pull workflows from n8n to local files
#   push [--id=xxx]   - Push local workflows to n8n
#   diff --id=xxx     - Show diff between local and remote
#   status            - Show sync status of all workflows

set -euo pipefail

N8N_API_URL="${N8N_API_URL:-http://10.100.5.102:5678/api/v1}"
WORKFLOWS_DIR="${WORKFLOWS_DIR:-$(dirname "$0")/../tofu/apps/n8n/workflows}"

# Get API key from 1Password
get_api_key() {
    op read "op://homelab/n8n/security/claude_token"
}

# List all workflows
cmd_list() {
    local api_key
    api_key=$(get_api_key)

    echo "=== n8n Workflows ==="
    echo ""
    curl -s -H "X-N8N-API-KEY: $api_key" "$N8N_API_URL/workflows" | \
        jq -r '.data[] | "[\(.id)] \(.name) (active: \(.active))"'
}

# Pull workflows from n8n
cmd_pull() {
    local id="${1:-}"
    local api_key
    api_key=$(get_api_key)

    mkdir -p "$WORKFLOWS_DIR"

    if [[ -n "$id" ]]; then
        echo "Pulling workflow $id..."
        local workflow
        workflow=$(curl -s -H "X-N8N-API-KEY: $api_key" "$N8N_API_URL/workflows/$id")

        if echo "$workflow" | jq -e '.id' > /dev/null 2>&1; then
            local name
            name=$(echo "$workflow" | jq -r '.name' | tr ' ' '_' | tr -cd '[:alnum:]_-')
            local filename="$WORKFLOWS_DIR/${id}_${name}.json"
            echo "$workflow" | jq '.' > "$filename"
            echo "Saved: $filename"
        else
            echo "Error: Workflow $id not found"
            exit 1
        fi
    else
        echo "Pulling all workflows from n8n..."
        local workflows
        workflows=$(curl -s -H "X-N8N-API-KEY: $api_key" "$N8N_API_URL/workflows")

        echo "$workflows" | jq -r '.data[] | .id' | while read -r wf_id; do
            local workflow
            workflow=$(curl -s -H "X-N8N-API-KEY: $api_key" "$N8N_API_URL/workflows/$wf_id")
            local name
            name=$(echo "$workflow" | jq -r '.name' | tr ' ' '_' | tr -cd '[:alnum:]_-')
            local filename="$WORKFLOWS_DIR/${wf_id}_${name}.json"
            echo "$workflow" | jq '.' > "$filename"
            echo "Saved: $filename"
        done

        echo ""
        echo "All workflows saved to $WORKFLOWS_DIR"
    fi
}

# Push workflows to n8n
cmd_push() {
    local id="${1:-}"
    local api_key
    api_key=$(get_api_key)

    if [[ -n "$id" ]]; then
        local file
        file=$(ls "$WORKFLOWS_DIR/${id}"_*.json 2>/dev/null | head -1 || true)
        if [[ -z "$file" ]]; then
            echo "Error: No local file found for workflow $id"
            exit 1
        fi

        echo "Pushing workflow from $file..."
        local payload
        payload=$(jq '{name, nodes, connections, settings, staticData, pinData}' "$file")

        local result
        result=$(curl -s -X PUT "$N8N_API_URL/workflows/$id" \
            -H "X-N8N-API-KEY: $api_key" \
            -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
            -d "$payload")

        if echo "$result" | jq -e '.id' > /dev/null 2>&1; then
            echo "Updated: $(echo "$result" | jq -r '.name') ($id)"
        else
            echo "Error updating workflow:"
            echo "$result" | jq '.'
            exit 1
        fi
    else
        echo "Pushing all local workflows to n8n..."

        for file in "$WORKFLOWS_DIR"/*.json; do
            [[ -f "$file" ]] || continue

            local wf_id
            wf_id=$(basename "$file" | cut -d'_' -f1)
            local name
            name=$(jq -r '.name' "$file")

            echo "Pushing: $name ($wf_id)..."

            local payload
            payload=$(jq '{name, nodes, connections, settings, staticData, pinData}' "$file")

            local result
            result=$(curl -s -X PUT "$N8N_API_URL/workflows/$wf_id" \
                -H "X-N8N-API-KEY: $api_key" \
                -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
                -d "$payload")

            if echo "$result" | jq -e '.id' > /dev/null 2>&1; then
                echo "  Updated successfully"
            else
                echo "  Error: $(echo "$result" | jq -r '.message // "Unknown error"')"
            fi
        done

        echo ""
        echo "All workflows pushed"
    fi
}

# Show diff between local and remote
cmd_diff() {
    local id="${1:-}"
    if [[ -z "$id" ]]; then
        echo "Usage: $0 diff --id=<workflow-id>"
        exit 1
    fi

    local api_key
    api_key=$(get_api_key)

    local file
    file=$(ls "$WORKFLOWS_DIR/${id}"_*.json 2>/dev/null | head -1 || true)
    if [[ -z "$file" ]]; then
        echo "Error: No local file found for workflow $id"
        exit 1
    fi

    echo "Comparing $id..."
    echo "Local: $file"
    echo ""

    local remote
    remote=$(curl -s -H "X-N8N-API-KEY: $api_key" "$N8N_API_URL/workflows/$id")

    local local_compare remote_compare
    local_compare=$(jq '{name, nodes, connections, settings}' "$file" | jq -S '.')
    remote_compare=$(echo "$remote" | jq '{name, nodes, connections, settings}' | jq -S '.')

    if [[ "$local_compare" == "$remote_compare" ]]; then
        echo "No differences found"
    else
        echo "=== Differences ==="
        diff <(echo "$local_compare") <(echo "$remote_compare") || true
    fi
}

# Show sync status
cmd_status() {
    local api_key
    api_key=$(get_api_key)

    echo "=== Workflow Sync Status ==="
    echo ""

    local remote_data
    remote_data=$(curl -s -H "X-N8N-API-KEY: $api_key" "$N8N_API_URL/workflows")
    local remote_ids
    remote_ids=$(echo "$remote_data" | jq -r '.data[] | .id')

    for wf_id in $remote_ids; do
        local file
        file=$(ls "$WORKFLOWS_DIR/${wf_id}"_*.json 2>/dev/null | head -1 || true)
        local remote
        remote=$(curl -s -H "X-N8N-API-KEY: $api_key" "$N8N_API_URL/workflows/$wf_id")
        local name
        name=$(echo "$remote" | jq -r '.name')

        if [[ -z "$file" ]]; then
            echo "[$wf_id] $name"
            echo "  Status: NOT SYNCED (no local file)"
        else
            local local_compare remote_compare
            local_compare=$(jq '{name, nodes, connections, settings}' "$file" 2>/dev/null | jq -S '.')
            remote_compare=$(echo "$remote" | jq '{name, nodes, connections, settings}' | jq -S '.')

            if [[ "$local_compare" == "$remote_compare" ]]; then
                echo "[$wf_id] $name"
                echo "  Status: IN SYNC"
            else
                echo "[$wf_id] $name"
                echo "  Status: DIFFERS (local vs remote)"
            fi
        fi
        echo ""
    done

    # Check for local-only workflows
    for file in "$WORKFLOWS_DIR"/*.json; do
        [[ -f "$file" ]] || continue
        local wf_id
        wf_id=$(basename "$file" | cut -d'_' -f1)

        if ! echo "$remote_ids" | grep -q "^${wf_id}$"; then
            local name
            name=$(jq -r '.name' "$file")
            echo "[$wf_id] $name"
            echo "  Status: LOCAL ONLY (not in n8n)"
            echo ""
        fi
    done
}

# Parse command line
main() {
    local cmd="${1:-}"
    shift || true

    local id=""
    for arg in "$@"; do
        case "$arg" in
            --id=*)
                id="${arg#*=}"
                ;;
        esac
    done

    case "$cmd" in
        list)
            cmd_list
            ;;
        pull)
            cmd_pull "$id"
            ;;
        push)
            cmd_push "$id"
            ;;
        diff)
            cmd_diff "$id"
            ;;
        status)
            cmd_status
            ;;
        *)
            echo "Usage: $0 <command> [options]"
            echo ""
            echo "Commands:"
            echo "  list              - List all workflows in n8n"
            echo "  pull [--id=xxx]   - Pull workflows from n8n to local files"
            echo "  push [--id=xxx]   - Push local workflows to n8n"
            echo "  diff --id=xxx     - Show diff between local and remote"
            echo "  status            - Show sync status of all workflows"
            exit 1
            ;;
    esac
}

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# n8n Workflow Sync Script
# Usage: n8n-workflows.sh <command> [options]
#
# Commands:
#   list              - List all workflows in n8n
#   pull [--id=xxx]   - Pull workflows from n8n to local files
#   push [--id=xxx]   - Push local workflows to n8n
#   diff --id=xxx     - Show diff between local and remote
#   status            - Show sync status of all workflows

set -euo pipefail

N8N_API_URL="${N8N_API_URL:-http://10.100.5.102:5678/api/v1}"
WORKFLOWS_DIR="${WORKFLOWS_DIR:-$(dirname "$0")/../tofu/apps/n8n/workflows}"

# Get API key from 1Password
get_api_key() {
    op read "op://homelab/n8n/security/claude_token"
}

# List all workflows
cmd_list() {
    local api_key
    api_key=$(get_api_key)

    echo "=== n8n Workflows ==="
    echo ""
    curl -s -H "X-N8N-API-KEY: $api_key" "$N8N_API_URL/workflows" | \
        jq -r '.data[] | "[\(.id)] \(.name) (active: \(.active))"'
}

# Pull workflows from n8n
cmd_pull() {
    local id="${1:-}"
    local api_key
    api_key=$(get_api_key)

    mkdir -p "$WORKFLOWS_DIR"

    if [[ -n "$id" ]]; then
        echo "Pulling workflow $id..."
        local workflow
        workflow=$(curl -s -H "X-N8N-API-KEY: $api_key" "$N8N_API_URL/workflows/$id")

        if echo "$workflow" | jq -e '.id' > /dev/null 2>&1; then
            local name
            name=$(echo "$workflow" | jq -r '.name' | tr ' ' '_' | tr -cd '[:alnum:]_-')
            local filename="$WORKFLOWS_DIR/${id}_${name}.json"
            echo "$workflow" | jq '.' > "$filename"
            echo "Saved: $filename"
        else
            echo "Error: Workflow $id not found"
            exit 1
        fi
    else
        echo "Pulling all workflows from n8n..."
        local workflows
        workflows=$(curl -s -H "X-N8N-API-KEY: $api_key" "$N8N_API_URL/workflows")

        echo "$workflows" | jq -r '.data[] | .id' | while read -r wf_id; do
            local workflow
            workflow=$(curl -s -H "X-N8N-API-KEY: $api_key" "$N8N_API_URL/workflows/$wf_id")
            local name
            name=$(echo "$workflow" | jq -r '.name' | tr ' ' '_' | tr -cd '[:alnum:]_-')
            local filename="$WORKFLOWS_DIR/${wf_id}_${name}.json"
            echo "$workflow" | jq '.' > "$filename"
            echo "Saved: $filename"
        done

        echo ""
        echo "All workflows saved to $WORKFLOWS_DIR"
    fi
}

# Push workflows to n8n
cmd_push() {
    local id="${1:-}"
    local api_key
    api_key=$(get_api_key)

    if [[ -n "$id" ]]; then
        local file
        file=$(ls "$WORKFLOWS_DIR/${id}"_*.json 2>/dev/null | head -1 || true)
        if [[ -z "$file" ]]; then
            echo "Error: No local file found for workflow $id"
            exit 1
        fi

        echo "Pushing workflow from $file..."
        local payload
        payload=$(jq '{name, nodes, connections, settings}' "$file")

        local result
        result=$(curl -s -X PUT "$N8N_API_URL/workflows/$id" \
            -H "X-N8N-API-KEY: $api_key" \
            -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
            -d "$payload")

        if echo "$result" | jq -e '.id' > /dev/null 2>&1; then
            echo "Updated: $(echo "$result" | jq -r '.name') ($id)"
        else
            echo "Error updating workflow:"
            echo "$result" | jq '.'
            exit 1
        fi
    else
        echo "Pushing all local workflows to n8n..."

        for file in "$WORKFLOWS_DIR"/*.json; do
            [[ -f "$file" ]] || continue

            local wf_id
            wf_id=$(basename "$file" | cut -d'_' -f1)
            local name
            name=$(jq -r '.name' "$file")

            echo "Pushing: $name ($wf_id)..."

            local payload
            payload=$(jq '{name, nodes, connections, settings}' "$file")

            local result
            result=$(curl -s -X PUT "$N8N_API_URL/workflows/$wf_id" \
                -H "X-N8N-API-KEY: $api_key" \
                -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
                -d "$payload")

            if echo "$result" | jq -e '.id' > /dev/null 2>&1; then
                echo "  Updated successfully"
            else
                echo "  Error: $(echo "$result" | jq -r '.message // "Unknown error"')"
            fi
        done

        echo ""
        echo "All workflows pushed"
    fi
}

# Show diff between local and remote
cmd_diff() {
    local id="${1:-}"
    if [[ -z "$id" ]]; then
        echo "Usage: $0 diff --id=<workflow-id>"
        exit 1
    fi

    local api_key
    api_key=$(get_api_key)

    local file
    file=$(ls "$WORKFLOWS_DIR/${id}"_*.json 2>/dev/null | head -1 || true)
    if [[ -z "$file" ]]; then
        echo "Error: No local file found for workflow $id"
        exit 1
    fi

    echo "Comparing $id..."
    echo "Local: $file"
    echo ""

    local remote
    remote=$(curl -s -H "X-N8N-API-KEY: $api_key" "$N8N_API_URL/workflows/$id")

    local local_compare remote_compare
    local_compare=$(jq '{name, nodes, connections, settings}' "$file" | jq -S '.')
    remote_compare=$(echo "$remote" | jq '{name, nodes, connections, settings}' | jq -S '.')

    if [[ "$local_compare" == "$remote_compare" ]]; then
        echo "No differences found"
    else
        echo "=== Differences ==="
        diff <(echo "$local_compare") <(echo "$remote_compare") || true
    fi
}

# Show sync status
cmd_status() {
    local api_key
    api_key=$(get_api_key)

    echo "=== Workflow Sync Status ==="
    echo ""

    local remote_data
    remote_data=$(curl -s -H "X-N8N-API-KEY: $api_key" "$N8N_API_URL/workflows")
    local remote_ids
    remote_ids=$(echo "$remote_data" | jq -r '.data[] | .id')

    for wf_id in $remote_ids; do
        local file
        file=$(ls "$WORKFLOWS_DIR/${wf_id}"_*.json 2>/dev/null | head -1 || true)
        local remote
        remote=$(curl -s -H "X-N8N-API-KEY: $api_key" "$N8N_API_URL/workflows/$wf_id")
        local name
        name=$(echo "$remote" | jq -r '.name')

        if [[ -z "$file" ]]; then
            echo "[$wf_id] $name"
            echo "  Status: NOT SYNCED (no local file)"
        else
            local local_compare remote_compare
            local_compare=$(jq '{name, nodes, connections, settings}' "$file" 2>/dev/null | jq -S '.')
            remote_compare=$(echo "$remote" | jq '{name, nodes, connections, settings}' | jq -S '.')

            if [[ "$local_compare" == "$remote_compare" ]]; then
                echo "[$wf_id] $name"
                echo "  Status: IN SYNC"
            else
                echo "[$wf_id] $name"
                echo "  Status: DIFFERS (local vs remote)"
            fi
        fi
        echo ""
    done

    # Check for local-only workflows
    for file in "$WORKFLOWS_DIR"/*.json; do
        [[ -f "$file" ]] || continue
        local wf_id
        wf_id=$(basename "$file" | cut -d'_' -f1)

        if ! echo "$remote_ids" | grep -q "^${wf_id}$"; then
            local name
            name=$(jq -r '.name' "$file")
            echo "[$wf_id] $name"
            echo "  Status: LOCAL ONLY (not in n8n)"
            echo ""
        fi
    done
}

# Parse command line
main() {
    local cmd="${1:-}"
    shift || true

    local id=""
    for arg in "$@"; do
        case "$arg" in
            --id=*)
                id="${arg#*=}"
                ;;
        esac
    done

    case "$cmd" in
        list)
            cmd_list
            ;;
        pull)
            cmd_pull "$id"
            ;;
        push)
            cmd_push "$id"
            ;;
        diff)
            cmd_diff "$id"
            ;;
        status)
            cmd_status
            ;;
        *)
            echo "Usage: $0 <command> [options]"
            echo ""
            echo "Commands:"
            echo "  list              - List all workflows in n8n"
            echo "  pull [--id=xxx]   - Pull workflows from n8n to local files"
            echo "  push [--id=xxx]   - Push local workflows to n8n"
            echo "  diff --id=xxx     - Show diff between local and remote"
            echo "  status            - Show sync status of all workflows"
            exit 1
            ;;
    esac
}

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# n8n Workflow Sync Script
# Usage: n8n-workflows.sh <command> [options]
#
# Commands:
#   list              - List all workflows in n8n
#   pull [--id=xxx]   - Pull workflows from n8n to local files
#   push [--id=xxx]   - Push local workflows to n8n
#   diff --id=xxx     - Show diff between local and remote
#   status            - Show sync status of all workflows

set -euo pipefail

N8N_API_URL="${N8N_API_URL:-http://10.100.5.102:5678/api/v1}"
WORKFLOWS_DIR="${WORKFLOWS_DIR:-$(dirname "$0")/../tofu/apps/n8n/workflows}"

# Get API key from 1Password
get_api_key() {
    op read "op://homelab/n8n/security/claude_token"
}

# List all workflows
cmd_list() {
    local api_key
    api_key=$(get_api_key)

    echo "=== n8n Workflows ==="
    echo ""
    curl -s -H "X-N8N-API-KEY: $api_key" "$N8N_API_URL/workflows" | \
        jq -r '.data[] | "[\(.id)] \(.name) (active: \(.active))"'
}

# Pull workflows from n8n
cmd_pull() {
    local id="${1:-}"
    local api_key
    api_key=$(get_api_key)

    mkdir -p "$WORKFLOWS_DIR"

    if [[ -n "$id" ]]; then
        echo "Pulling workflow $id..."
        local workflow
        workflow=$(curl -s -H "X-N8N-API-KEY: $api_key" "$N8N_API_URL/workflows/$id")

        if echo "$workflow" | jq -e '.id' > /dev/null 2>&1; then
            local name
            name=$(echo "$workflow" | jq -r '.name' | tr ' ' '_' | tr -cd '[:alnum:]_-')
            local filename="$WORKFLOWS_DIR/${id}_${name}.json"
            echo "$workflow" | jq '.' > "$filename"
            echo "Saved: $filename"
        else
            echo "Error: Workflow $id not found"
            exit 1
        fi
    else
        echo "Pulling all workflows from n8n..."
        local workflows
        workflows=$(curl -s -H "X-N8N-API-KEY: $api_key" "$N8N_API_URL/workflows")

        echo "$workflows" | jq -r '.data[] | .id' | while read -r wf_id; do
            local workflow
            workflow=$(curl -s -H "X-N8N-API-KEY: $api_key" "$N8N_API_URL/workflows/$wf_id")
            local name
            name=$(echo "$workflow" | jq -r '.name' | tr ' ' '_' | tr -cd '[:alnum:]_-')
            local filename="$WORKFLOWS_DIR/${wf_id}_${name}.json"
            echo "$workflow" | jq '.' > "$filename"
            echo "Saved: $filename"
        done

        echo ""
        echo "All workflows saved to $WORKFLOWS_DIR"
    fi
}

# Push workflows to n8n
cmd_push() {
    local id="${1:-}"
    local api_key
    api_key=$(get_api_key)

    if [[ -n "$id" ]]; then
        local file
        file=$(ls "$WORKFLOWS_DIR/${id}"_*.json 2>/dev/null | head -1 || true)
        if [[ -z "$file" ]]; then
            echo "Error: No local file found for workflow $id"
            exit 1
        fi

        echo "Pushing workflow from $file..."
        # Only include valid settings fields per n8n API schema
        local payload
        payload=$(jq '{
            name,
            nodes,
            connections,
            settings: {
                saveExecutionProgress: .settings.saveExecutionProgress,
                saveManualExecutions: .settings.saveManualExecutions,
                saveDataErrorExecution: .settings.saveDataErrorExecution,
                saveDataSuccessExecution: .settings.saveDataSuccessExecution,
                executionTimeout: .settings.executionTimeout,
                errorWorkflow: .settings.errorWorkflow,
                timezone: .settings.timezone,
                executionOrder: .settings.executionOrder,
                callerPolicy: .settings.callerPolicy,
                callerIds: .settings.callerIds,
                timeSavedPerExecution: .settings.timeSavedPerExecution,
                availableInMCP: .settings.availableInMCP
            } | with_entries(select(.value != null))
        }' "$file")

        local result
        result=$(curl -s -X PUT "$N8N_API_URL/workflows/$id" \
            -H "X-N8N-API-KEY: $api_key" \
            -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
            -d "$payload")

        if echo "$result" | jq -e '.id' > /dev/null 2>&1; then
            echo "Updated: $(echo "$result" | jq -r '.name') ($id)"
        else
            echo "Error updating workflow:"
            echo "$result" | jq '.'
            exit 1
        fi
    else
        echo "Pushing all local workflows to n8n..."

        for file in "$WORKFLOWS_DIR"/*.json; do
            [[ -f "$file" ]] || continue

            local wf_id
            wf_id=$(basename "$file" | cut -d'_' -f1)
            local name
            name=$(jq -r '.name' "$file")

            echo "Pushing: $name ($wf_id)..."

            local payload
            payload=$(jq '{name, nodes, connections, settings}' "$file")

            local result
            result=$(curl -s -X PUT "$N8N_API_URL/workflows/$wf_id" \
                -H "X-N8N-API-KEY: $api_key" \
                -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
                -d "$payload")

            if echo "$result" | jq -e '.id' > /dev/null 2>&1; then
                echo "  Updated successfully"
            else
                echo "  Error: $(echo "$result" | jq -r '.message // "Unknown error"')"
            fi
        done

        echo ""
        echo "All workflows pushed"
    fi
}

# Show diff between local and remote
cmd_diff() {
    local id="${1:-}"
    if [[ -z "$id" ]]; then
        echo "Usage: $0 diff --id=<workflow-id>"
        exit 1
    fi

    local api_key
    api_key=$(get_api_key)

    local file
    file=$(ls "$WORKFLOWS_DIR/${id}"_*.json 2>/dev/null | head -1 || true)
    if [[ -z "$file" ]]; then
        echo "Error: No local file found for workflow $id"
        exit 1
    fi

    echo "Comparing $id..."
    echo "Local: $file"
    echo ""

    local remote
    remote=$(curl -s -H "X-N8N-API-KEY: $api_key" "$N8N_API_URL/workflows/$id")

    local local_compare remote_compare
    local_compare=$(jq '{name, nodes, connections, settings}' "$file" | jq -S '.')
    remote_compare=$(echo "$remote" | jq '{name, nodes, connections, settings}' | jq -S '.')

    if [[ "$local_compare" == "$remote_compare" ]]; then
        echo "No differences found"
    else
        echo "=== Differences ==="
        diff <(echo "$local_compare") <(echo "$remote_compare") || true
    fi
}

# Show sync status
cmd_status() {
    local api_key
    api_key=$(get_api_key)

    echo "=== Workflow Sync Status ==="
    echo ""

    local remote_data
    remote_data=$(curl -s -H "X-N8N-API-KEY: $api_key" "$N8N_API_URL/workflows")
    local remote_ids
    remote_ids=$(echo "$remote_data" | jq -r '.data[] | .id')

    for wf_id in $remote_ids; do
        local file
        file=$(ls "$WORKFLOWS_DIR/${wf_id}"_*.json 2>/dev/null | head -1 || true)
        local remote
        remote=$(curl -s -H "X-N8N-API-KEY: $api_key" "$N8N_API_URL/workflows/$wf_id")
        local name
        name=$(echo "$remote" | jq -r '.name')

        if [[ -z "$file" ]]; then
            echo "[$wf_id] $name"
            echo "  Status: NOT SYNCED (no local file)"
        else
            local local_compare remote_compare
            local_compare=$(jq '{name, nodes, connections, settings}' "$file" 2>/dev/null | jq -S '.')
            remote_compare=$(echo "$remote" | jq '{name, nodes, connections, settings}' | jq -S '.')

            if [[ "$local_compare" == "$remote_compare" ]]; then
                echo "[$wf_id] $name"
                echo "  Status: IN SYNC"
            else
                echo "[$wf_id] $name"
                echo "  Status: DIFFERS (local vs remote)"
            fi
        fi
        echo ""
    done

    # Check for local-only workflows
    for file in "$WORKFLOWS_DIR"/*.json; do
        [[ -f "$file" ]] || continue
        local wf_id
        wf_id=$(basename "$file" | cut -d'_' -f1)

        if ! echo "$remote_ids" | grep -q "^${wf_id}$"; then
            local name
            name=$(jq -r '.name' "$file")
            echo "[$wf_id] $name"
            echo "  Status: LOCAL ONLY (not in n8n)"
            echo ""
        fi
    done
}

# Parse command line
main() {
    local cmd="${1:-}"
    shift || true

    local id=""
    for arg in "$@"; do
        case "$arg" in
            --id=*)
                id="${arg#*=}"
                ;;
        esac
    done

    case "$cmd" in
        list)
            cmd_list
            ;;
        pull)
            cmd_pull "$id"
            ;;
        push)
            cmd_push "$id"
            ;;
        diff)
            cmd_diff "$id"
            ;;
        status)
            cmd_status
            ;;
        *)
            echo "Usage: $0 <command> [options]"
            echo ""
            echo "Commands:"
            echo "  list              - List all workflows in n8n"
            echo "  pull [--id=xxx]   - Pull workflows from n8n to local files"
            echo "  push [--id=xxx]   - Push local workflows to n8n"
            echo "  diff --id=xxx     - Show diff between local and remote"
            echo "  status            - Show sync status of all workflows"
            exit 1
            ;;
    esac
}

main "$@"

# Homelab Infrastructure

OpenTofu-managed homelab on Proxmox. All commands run from local machine.

## Beads - AI Issue Tracking

This repo uses [Beads](https://github.com/steveyegge/beads) for AI-native issue tracking. Beads helps AI agents manage complex, multi-step tasks by tracking dependencies between work items.
BEFORE ANYTHING ELSE: run 'bd onboard' and follow the instructions

### Quick Commands

```bash
# Find ready work (no blockers)
bd ready

# List all issues
bd list
bd list --status=in_progress

# Create an issue
bd create --title="Add new LXC container for XYZ" --type=task --priority=2

# View issue details
bd show <id>

# Update status
bd update <id> --status=in_progress
bd update <id> --status=done

# Close completed work
bd close <id>
bd close <id1> <id2> ...  # Close multiple at once

# Add dependencies (issue depends on depends-on)
bd dep add <issue> <depends-on>

# Sync with git
bd sync
```

### For AI Agents

When starting work on this repo:

1. Run `bd ready` to see available tasks
2. Pick an issue and run `bd update <id> --status in_progress`
3. Complete the work
4. Run `bd close <id>` when done

Use `bd prime` to generate context for your session. Dependencies are tracked automatically - issues marked as "blocking" others will show up in the `bd ready` output once completed.

## Quick Reference

```bash
# OpenTofu workflow
task tofu:init APP=dashboards
task tofu:plan APP=dashboards
task tofu:apply APP=dashboards

# Homelab Infrastructure

OpenTofu-managed homelab on Proxmox. All commands run from local machine.

## Beads - AI Issue Tracking

This repo uses [Beads](https://github.com/steveyegge/beads) for AI-native issue tracking. Beads helps AI agents manage complex, multi-step tasks by tracking dependencies between work items.
BEFORE ANYTHING ELSE: run 'bd onboard' and follow the instructions

### Quick Commands

```bash
# Find ready work (no blockers)
bd ready

# List all issues
bd list
bd list --status=in_progress

# Create an issue
bd create --title="Add new LXC container for XYZ" --type=task --priority=2

# View issue details
bd show <id>

# Update status
bd update <id> --status=in_progress
bd update <id> --status=done

# Close completed work
bd close <id>
bd close <id1> <id2> ...  # Close multiple at once

# Add dependencies (issue depends on depends-on)
bd dep add <issue> <depends-on>

# Sync with git
bd sync
```

### For AI Agents

When starting work on this repo:

1. Run `bd ready` to see available tasks
2. Pick an issue and run `bd update <id> --status in_progress`
3. Complete the work
4. Run `bd close <id>` when done

Use `bd prime` to generate context for your session. Dependencies are tracked automatically - issues marked as "blocking" others will show up in the `bd ready` output once completed.

## Quick Reference

```bash
# OpenTofu workflow
task tofu:init APP=dashboards
task tofu:plan APP=dashboards
task tofu:apply APP=dashboards

# PBS Backups (Proxmox Backup Server - incremental, in-container)
task pbs:backup APP=n8n          # Trigger manual PBS backup
task pbs:backup:all              # Backup all apps
task pbs:backup:list APP=n8n     # List PBS snapshots
task pbs:backup:status APP=n8n   # Show backup status
task pbs:backup:restore APP=n8n SNAPSHOT=latest  # Restore from PBS

# Cloud Backups (rclone to Backblaze B2 - encrypted)
task cloud:sync                  # Sync photos + documents to B2
task cloud:sync:photos           # Sync photos only (LXC 304)
task cloud:sync:documents        # Sync documents only (LXC 504)
task cloud:status                # Show B2 backup status
task cloud:dry-run               # Preview what would be synced

# DNS mode (for remote access via Tailscale)
task dns:status                  # Show current mode
task dns:travel                  # Switch to travel mode (Tailscale IPs)
task dns:home                    # Switch to home mode (LAN IPs)

# Desktop LXC (temporary GUI for downloads)
task desktop:create
task desktop:info
task desktop:destroy

# Beads issue tracking
bd ready                         # Show ready work (no blockers)
bd list                          # List all issues
bd create --title="..."          # Create new issue
bd show <id>                     # View issue details
bd close <id>                    # Complete an issue
```

## PBS Backups (Proxmox Backup Server)

PBS provides incremental, deduplicated backups of docker volumes from within containers.

### How it works

1. `lxc-sidecars` module installs `proxmox-backup-client` in each container
2. Creates systemd timer for scheduled backups (default: daily)
3. Backs up docker volumes to PBS (LXC 102) with deduplication
4. Sends notifications to ntfy `backup-alerts` channel

### Configuration (in app's main.tf)

```hcl
module "sidecars" {
  source = "../../modules/lxc-sidecars"

  backup = {
    enabled   = true
    schedule  = "02:00"      # Daily at 2 AM
    retention = 7            # Keep 7 backups
    include_paths = ["/config"]
    pre_backup_commands = [
      {
        name    = "Dump PostgreSQL"
        command = "docker exec postgres pg_dump -U user db > /config/db.sql"
        timeout = "5m"
      }
    ]
    notify_on_success = true
    notify_on_failure = true
  }
}
```

### Manual Operations

```bash
# Trigger backup
task pbs:backup APP=n8n

# List snapshots
task pbs:backup:list APP=n8n

# Restore (stops container, restores data, restarts)
task pbs:backup:restore APP=n8n SNAPSHOT=latest
```

## 1Password Integration

Secrets are managed via the 1Password OpenTofu provider.

### Key Files

- `tofu/onepassword.tf` - Data sources + `local.op` helper (symlinked to apps)
- `tofu/versions.tf` - Provider configs using `local.op.*`

### Available Secrets

local.op.cloudflare_tunnel_token # Cloudflare tunnel token
local.op.grafana_admin_password  # Grafana admin password
local.op.discord_webhook_url     # Discord alertmanager webhook
```

### Adding New Secrets

1. Create item in 1Password `homelab` vault
2. Add data source to `tofu/onepassword.tf`
3. Add to `local.op` map in same file
4. Use in modules: `local.op.myservice_password`

### Why TF_VAR for State Encryption

State encryption runs before providers initialize, so it cannot use the 1Password provider:

```yaml
# Taskfile.yml
env:
  TF_VAR_state_encryption_passphrase:
    sh: op read "op://homelab/opentofu/password"
```

## Important Notes

- SSH to Proxmox: `ssh root@homelab`
- Use container IPs (10.100.x.x) in provisioners when in travel mode
- State files are encrypted and committed to git
- Each app has independent state in `tofu/apps/<app>/`
- 1Password CLI v2.23.0+ required (uses biometric auth)

## Taskfile Usage

**ALWAYS prefer running tasks from the Taskfile over direct commands.**

This repository uses a Taskfile for all common operations. Before running any command directly, check if there's a task for it using `task --list`.

Examples:

- Use `task tofu:apply APP=immich` instead of `cd tofu && tofu apply`
- Use `task pbs:backup APP=n8n` instead of SSH commands to trigger backups
- Use `task dns:travel` instead of manually editing TF_VAR_dns_mode

## OpenTofu/Terraform Workflow

**CRITICAL: OpenTofu commands must ALWAYS follow this sequence with NO skips:**

1. `task tofu:init APP=<app>` - Initialize the workspace
2. `task tofu:plan APP=<app>` - Generate and review the execution plan
3. `task tofu:apply APP=<app>` - Apply the changes

Never skip steps. Always run init, then plan, then apply - even if you think init has already been run.

## File Transfer Restrictions

**CRITICAL: You are strictly forbidden to transfer files over to any remote server under any circumstance unless the user has explicitly given you permission.**

This includes but is not limited to:

- SSH file transfers (scp, rsync, sftp)
- Copying files to LXC containers
- Uploading files to cloud services
- Any form of remote file deployment

You must always ask for explicit permission before transferring any files to remote systems.

Looking at the current implementation, **no, the sync does not handle workflow deletes** in either direction.

Here's what happens currently:

| Scenario | What happens |
|----------|--------------|
| Delete workflow in n8n UI | Local JSON file remains orphaned |
| Delete local JSON file | Workflow remains in n8n |
| `task n8n:status` | Shows "LOCAL ONLY" for orphaned local files |

The `n8n:status` command will detect orphaned local files (showing "LOCAL ONLY"), but doesn't automatically delete them.

**Options to handle deletes:**

1. **Manual approach** (current) - User deletes files/workflows manually after checking `n8n:status`

2. **Add delete commands** - I can add:
   - `task n8n:delete ID=xxx` - Delete workflow from n8n
   - `task n8n:clean` - Remove local files for workflows that no longer exist in n8n
   - `task n8n:sync` - Full bidirectional sync with delete support (dangerous)

3. **Add `--delete` flag to push/pull**:
   - `task n8n:pull --delete` - Pull all and remove local files not in n8n
   - `task n8n:push --delete` - Push all and delete workflows not in local (dangerous!)

What approach would you prefer? I'd recommend option 2 with explicit delete commands, keeping push/pull non-destructive by default.
I think task n8n:clean will be perfect.

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# n8n Workflow Sync Script
# Usage: n8n-workflows.sh <command> [options]
#
# Commands:
#   list              - List all workflows in n8n
#   pull [--id=xxx]   - Pull workflows from n8n to local files
#   push [--id=xxx]   - Push local workflows to n8n
#   diff --id=xxx     - Show diff between local and remote
#   status            - Show sync status of all workflows

set -euo pipefail

N8N_API_URL="${N8N_API_URL:-http://10.100.5.102:5678/api/v1}"
WORKFLOWS_DIR="${WORKFLOWS_DIR:-$(dirname "$0")/../tofu/apps/n8n/workflows}"

# Get API key from 1Password
get_api_key() {
    op read "op://homelab/n8n/security/claude_token"
}

# List all workflows
cmd_list() {
    local api_key
    api_key=$(get_api_key)

    echo "=== n8n Workflows ==="
    echo ""
    curl -s -H "X-N8N-API-KEY: $api_key" "$N8N_API_URL/workflows" | \
        jq -r '.data[] | "[\(.id)] \(.name) (active: \(.active))"'
}

# Pull workflows from n8n
cmd_pull() {
    local id="${1:-}"
    local api_key
    api_key=$(get_api_key)

    mkdir -p "$WORKFLOWS_DIR"

    if [[ -n "$id" ]]; then
        echo "Pulling workflow $id..."
        local workflow
        workflow=$(curl -s -H "X-N8N-API-KEY: $api_key" "$N8N_API_URL/workflows/$id")

        if echo "$workflow" | jq -e '.id' > /dev/null 2>&1; then
            local name
            name=$(echo "$workflow" | jq -r '.name' | tr ' ' '_' | tr -cd '[:alnum:]_-')
            local filename="$WORKFLOWS_DIR/${id}_${name}.json"
            echo "$workflow" | jq '.' > "$filename"
            echo "Saved: $filename"
        else
            echo "Error: Workflow $id not found"
            exit 1
        fi
    else
        echo "Pulling all workflows from n8n..."
        local workflows
        workflows=$(curl -s -H "X-N8N-API-KEY: $api_key" "$N8N_API_URL/workflows")

        echo "$workflows" | jq -r '.data[] | .id' | while read -r wf_id; do
            local workflow
            workflow=$(curl -s -H "X-N8N-API-KEY: $api_key" "$N8N_API_URL/workflows/$wf_id")
            local name
            name=$(echo "$workflow" | jq -r '.name' | tr ' ' '_' | tr -cd '[:alnum:]_-')
            local filename="$WORKFLOWS_DIR/${wf_id}_${name}.json"
            echo "$workflow" | jq '.' > "$filename"
            echo "Saved: $filename"
        done

        echo ""
        echo "All workflows saved to $WORKFLOWS_DIR"
    fi
}

# Push workflows to n8n
cmd_push() {
    local id="${1:-}"
    local api_key
    api_key=$(get_api_key)

    if [[ -n "$id" ]]; then
        local file
        file=$(ls "$WORKFLOWS_DIR/${id}"_*.json 2>/dev/null | head -1 || true)
        if [[ -z "$file" ]]; then
            echo "Error: No local file found for workflow $id"
            exit 1
        fi

        echo "Pushing workflow from $file..."
        # Only include valid settings fields per n8n API schema
        local payload
        payload=$(jq '{
            name,
            nodes,
            connections,
            settings: {
                saveExecutionProgress: .settings.saveExecutionProgress,
                saveManualExecutions: .settings.saveManualExecutions,
                saveDataErrorExecution: .settings.saveDataErrorExecution,
                saveDataSuccessExecution: .settings.saveDataSuccessExecution,
                executionTimeout: .settings.executionTimeout,
                errorWorkflow: .settings.errorWorkflow,
                timezone: .settings.timezone,
                executionOrder: .settings.executionOrder,
                callerPolicy: .settings.callerPolicy,
                callerIds: .settings.callerIds,
                timeSavedPerExecution: .settings.timeSavedPerExecution,
                availableInMCP: .settings.availableInMCP
            } | with_entries(select(.value != null))
        }' "$file")

        local result
        result=$(curl -s -X PUT "$N8N_API_URL/workflows/$id" \
            -H "X-N8N-API-KEY: $api_key" \
            -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
            -d "$payload")

        if echo "$result" | jq -e '.id' > /dev/null 2>&1; then
            echo "Updated: $(echo "$result" | jq -r '.name') ($id)"
        else
            echo "Error updating workflow:"
            echo "$result" | jq '.'
            exit 1
        fi
    else
        echo "Pushing all local workflows to n8n..."

        for file in "$WORKFLOWS_DIR"/*.json; do
            [[ -f "$file" ]] || continue

            local wf_id
            wf_id=$(basename "$file" | cut -d'_' -f1)
            local name
            name=$(jq -r '.name' "$file")

            echo "Pushing: $name ($wf_id)..."

            # Only include valid settings fields per n8n API schema
            local payload
            payload=$(jq '{
                name,
                nodes,
                connections,
                settings: {
                    saveExecutionProgress: .settings.saveExecutionProgress,
                    saveManualExecutions: .settings.saveManualExecutions,
                    saveDataErrorExecution: .settings.saveDataErrorExecution,
                    saveDataSuccessExecution: .settings.saveDataSuccessExecution,
                    executionTimeout: .settings.executionTimeout,
                    errorWorkflow: .settings.errorWorkflow,
                    timezone: .settings.timezone,
                    executionOrder: .settings.executionOrder,
                    callerPolicy: .settings.callerPolicy,
                    callerIds: .settings.callerIds,
                    timeSavedPerExecution: .settings.timeSavedPerExecution,
                    availableInMCP: .settings.availableInMCP
                } | with_entries(select(.value != null))
            }' "$file")

            local result
            result=$(curl -s -X PUT "$N8N_API_URL/workflows/$wf_id" \
                -H "X-N8N-API-KEY: $api_key" \
                -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
                -d "$payload")

            if echo "$result" | jq -e '.id' > /dev/null 2>&1; then
                echo "  Updated successfully"
            else
                echo "  Error: $(echo "$result" | jq -r '.message // "Unknown error"')"
            fi
        done

        echo ""
        echo "All workflows pushed"
    fi
}

# Show diff between local and remote
cmd_diff() {
    local id="${1:-}"
    if [[ -z "$id" ]]; then
        echo "Usage: $0 diff --id=<workflow-id>"
        exit 1
    fi

    local api_key
    api_key=$(get_api_key)

    local file
    file=$(ls "$WORKFLOWS_DIR/${id}"_*.json 2>/dev/null | head -1 || true)
    if [[ -z "$file" ]]; then
        echo "Error: No local file found for workflow $id"
        exit 1
    fi

    echo "Comparing $id..."
    echo "Local: $file"
    echo ""

    local remote
    remote=$(curl -s -H "X-N8N-API-KEY: $api_key" "$N8N_API_URL/workflows/$id")

    local local_compare remote_compare
    local_compare=$(jq '{name, nodes, connections, settings}' "$file" | jq -S '.')
    remote_compare=$(echo "$remote" | jq '{name, nodes, connections, settings}' | jq -S '.')

    if [[ "$local_compare" == "$remote_compare" ]]; then
        echo "No differences found"
    else
        echo "=== Differences ==="
        diff <(echo "$local_compare") <(echo "$remote_compare") || true
    fi
}

# Show sync status
cmd_status() {
    local api_key
    api_key=$(get_api_key)

    echo "=== Workflow Sync Status ==="
    echo ""

    local remote_data
    remote_data=$(curl -s -H "X-N8N-API-KEY: $api_key" "$N8N_API_URL/workflows")
    local remote_ids
    remote_ids=$(echo "$remote_data" | jq -r '.data[] | .id')

    for wf_id in $remote_ids; do
        local file
        file=$(ls "$WORKFLOWS_DIR/${wf_id}"_*.json 2>/dev/null | head -1 || true)
        local remote
        remote=$(curl -s -H "X-N8N-API-KEY: $api_key" "$N8N_API_URL/workflows/$wf_id")
        local name
        name=$(echo "$remote" | jq -r '.name')

        if [[ -z "$file" ]]; then
            echo "[$wf_id] $name"
            echo "  Status: NOT SYNCED (no local file)"
        else
            local local_compare remote_compare
            local_compare=$(jq '{name, nodes, connections, settings}' "$file" 2>/dev/null | jq -S '.')
            remote_compare=$(echo "$remote" | jq '{name, nodes, connections, settings}' | jq -S '.')

            if [[ "$local_compare" == "$remote_compare" ]]; then
                echo "[$wf_id] $name"
                echo "  Status: IN SYNC"
            else
                echo "[$wf_id] $name"
                echo "  Status: DIFFERS (local vs remote)"
            fi
        fi
        echo ""
    done

    # Check for local-only workflows
    for file in "$WORKFLOWS_DIR"/*.json; do
        [[ -f "$file" ]] || continue
        local wf_id
        wf_id=$(basename "$file" | cut -d'_' -f1)

        if ! echo "$remote_ids" | grep -q "^${wf_id}$"; then
            local name
            name=$(jq -r '.name' "$file")
            echo "[$wf_id] $name"
            echo "  Status: LOCAL ONLY (not in n8n)"
            echo ""
        fi
    done
}

# Parse command line
main() {
    local cmd="${1:-}"
    shift || true

    local id=""
    for arg in "$@"; do
        case "$arg" in
            --id=*)
                id="${arg#*=}"
                ;;
        esac
    done

    case "$cmd" in
        list)
            cmd_list
            ;;
        pull)
            cmd_pull "$id"
            ;;
        push)
            cmd_push "$id"
            ;;
        diff)
            cmd_diff "$id"
            ;;
        status)
            cmd_status
            ;;
        *)
            echo "Usage: $0 <command> [options]"
            echo ""
            echo "Commands:"
            echo "  list              - List all workflows in n8n"
            echo "  pull [--id=xxx]   - Pull workflows from n8n to local files"
            echo "  push [--id=xxx]   - Push local workflows to n8n"
            echo "  diff --id=xxx     - Show diff between local and remote"
            echo "  status            - Show sync status of all workflows"
            exit 1
            ;;
    esac
}

main "$@"
